political.zh: 这项条约结束了他们的政治从属地位。

political.zh: 这份小册子诋毁其政治对手。

end.zh: 谈判结束了持续一周的罢工。

end.en: Her categorical refusal ended the discussion.
end.zh: 她断然的拒绝结束了讨论。

end.en: Their longstanding enmity ended after arbitration.
end.zh: 仲裁后，他们长久的敌意消除了。

end.en: I hope the end comes quickly.
Hold the string at both ends.
end.gloss: The most extreme point of an object, especially one that is longer than it is wide.

end.en: For what end should I toil?
end.zh: 我到底为了什么而劳苦？

among.en: Fecundity varies among different animal species.
among.zh: 不同动物物种的繁殖力存在差异。

among.en: The quail hid among the grasses.
The policy engendered antagonism among local residents.
among.zh: 这项政策引起了当地居民的敌意。

ever.zh: 他们从此过上了幸福的生活。

ever.en: I scarcely ever see you anymore!.
ever.zh: 我几乎再也见不到你了！

ever.en: Was I ever glad to see you!
ever.gloss: As intensifier following an interrogative word.

stand.en: This monument stands in homage to workers.
stand.zh: 这座纪念碑矗立于此，向工人致敬。

stand.en: The village stands at the rivers' confluence.
stand.zh: 这个村庄位于两条河的交汇处。

stand.en: The tower stands on a rocky eminence.
stand.zh: 这座塔矗立在一处岩石高地上。

stand.gloss: To position or be positioned physically:; To occupy or hold a place; to be set, placed, fixed, located, or situated.
To position or be positioned mentally:; To tolerate.

stand.en: What I said yesterday still stands.
stand.gloss: To position or be positioned socially:; To remain valid.
stand.zh: 我昨天说的话仍然有效。

lose.en: The hotel has lost its former glamour.
lose.zh: 这家酒店已失去昔日的魅力。

lose.en: We commiserate with those who lost homes.
lose.zh: 我们对失去家园的人们深表同情。

lose.gloss: To become a defeated competitor in (a game, competition, trial, etc).
lose.zh: 我们输掉了那场足球比赛。

lose.en: I’ve lost five pounds this week.
lose.gloss: To cease to have (something) in one's possession or capability.; To shed (weight).

lose.en: Lose that extra space on the left.
lose.gloss: To shed, remove, discard, or eliminate.

lose.en: My watch loses five minutes a week.
lose.gloss: Of a clock, to run slower than expected.
lose.zh: 我的手表每周慢五分钟。

however.en: Wear your hair however you want.
however.gloss: In any way in which; how.
however.zh: 随心所欲地穿你的头发。

however.en: She offered to help however she could.
however.gloss: In any way in which; how.
however.zh: 她主动提出尽其所能提供帮助。

however.en: I don't care; just do it however.
however.gloss: In any way that one likes or chooses; in a haphazard or spontaneous way.
however.zh: 我不在乎；不过就这么做吧。

member.en: Fractious members prolonged the committee's deliberations.
member.zh: 不听协调的成员拖延了委员会的讨论。

member.en: Few members demurred at the proposal.
member.zh: 几乎没有成员对这个提议表示异议。

member.en: The agreement allows incorporation of new members.
member.zh: 这份协议允许吸收新成员。

pay.en: The poet paid homage to her forebears.
pay.zh: 这位诗人向她的先辈致敬。

pay.en: The annuity pays a fixed yearly amount.
pay.zh: 这份年金每年支付固定金额。

pay.en: We paid the toll at the turnpike.
pay.zh: 我们在收费公路处付了通行费。

pay.gloss: To be profitable; to be worth it.

pay.en: He wasted his pay on drink.

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

pay.zh: 他把工资浪费在喝酒上了。

pay.en: How much will the job pay?
pay.gloss: To give money or other compensation to in exchange for goods or services.
pay.zh: 这份工作的薪水是多少？

law.en: The rule cannot contravene national law.
law.zh: 这条规定不能违反国家法律。

law.en: He is conversant with maritime law.
She supported the abolition of discriminatory laws.
law.zh: 她支持废除歧视性法律。

law.gloss: A person or group that act(s) with authority to uphold such rules and order (for example, one or more police officers).

law.en: In theory, entrapment is against the law.
law.gloss: The body of binding rules and regulations, customs, and standards established in a community by its legislative and judicial authorities.
law.zh: 从理论上讲，诱捕是违法的。

law.en: There is a law against importing wallabies.
law.gloss: A binding regulation or custom established in a community in this way.
law.zh: 有一项法律禁止进口小袋鼠。

meet.en: The committee customarily meets on Mondays.
meet.zh: 委员会惯例在周一开会。

meet.en: The cabal met behind closed doors.
One persistent malcontent disrupted every meeting.
meet.zh: 一个不断抱怨的人搅乱了每次会议。

meet.en: Let's meet at the station at 9 o'clock.
meet.gloss: To make contact (with someone) while in proximity.; To come face to face with someone by arrangement.
meet.zh: 我们九点在车站见面吧。

meet.en: England and Holland will meet in the final.
meet.gloss: To come together.; To play a match.
meet.zh: 英格兰队和荷兰队将在决赛中相遇。

car.en: Someone jacked my car last night!
I'm saving up for a car.
He drove his car to the theatre.
car.gloss: A wheeled vehicle that moves independently, with at least three wheels, powered mechanically, steered by a driver and mostly for personal transportation but relatively smaller than a truck/lorry and a bus.

car.en: We ordered five hundred cars of gypsum.
car.gloss: Any vehicle designed to run on rails, especially an unpowered one towed by being connected to others.; A rough unit of quantity approximating the amount which would fill a railroad car.
car.zh: 我们订购了五百车石膏。

car.en: The conductor coupled the cars to the locomotive.
car.gloss: Any vehicle designed to run on rails, especially an unpowered one towed by being connected to others.; An unpowered unit in a railroad train, used to hold either passengers or cargo.
car.zh: 列车员将车厢与机车连接起来。

city.en: Outlying villages lie on the city's periphery.
city.zh: 外围村庄位于城市边缘。

city.en: We witnessed an exodus from the city.
city.zh: 我们目睹了人们大批离开这座城市。

city.en: The hinterland supplies timber to coastal cities.
city.zh: 内陆腹地向沿海城市供应木材。

almost.gloss: Very close to, but not quite.
almost.zh: 几乎所有的人都去了那里。

almost.gloss: Very close to, but not quite.

include.en: The anthology includes several illustrious writers.
include.zh: 这部选集收录了几位著名作家的作品。

include.en: The treatise includes an extensive glossary.
include.zh: 这部专著附有详尽的术语表。

include.en: The report includes supplementary statistical tables.
include.zh: 这份报告附有补充统计表。

include.en: The vacation package includes car rental.
include.gloss: To consider as part of something; to comprehend.
include.zh: 假期套餐包括汽车租赁。

continue.en: The pendulum continued to oscillate steadily.
She avowed her determination to continue.
continue.zh: 她公开表明了继续下去的决心。

continue.en: He continued to equivocate about his involvement.
continue.zh: 他对自己的参与仍含糊其辞。

set.en: Please set the alarm for six.
The sun sets early in winter.
The team set a new record.
set.zh: 这支队伍创造了新纪录。

later.en: The postmaster sorted the late deliveries.
later.zh: 邮政局长整理了晚到的邮件。

later.en: This antecedent event influenced the later conflict.
later.zh: 这一先前事件影响了后来的冲突。

later.en: The memorial oration honored the late reformer.
later.zh: 这篇悼念演说纪念了已故的改革者。

later.gloss: What if (something problematic or unanticipated happens); if not (something undesirable will happen).
comparative form of late: more late

later.en: I arrived later than my roommate.
later.gloss: Afterward in time (used with than when comparing with another time).

community.zh: 族群冲突使这个社区陷入分裂。

community.en: Her unselfish conduct earned the community's respect.
community.zh: 她无私的行为赢得了社区的尊重。
我们有一个多种族的社区。

community.en: Volunteering gave me a sense of community.
community.gloss: A feeling of togetherness or connectedness, common identity or of possessing a similar outlook, perspective and purpose with some group of people.
community.zh: 志愿服务给了我一种社区意识。

name.en: Forbes is the author's family name.
name.zh: 福布斯是这位作者的姓。

name.en: Her name aptly describes her cheerful personality.
name.zh: 她的名字贴切地体现了她开朗的性格。

name.en: Her name is a byword for probity.
name.zh: 她的名字是正直的代名词。

name.en: The painter was named as an accomplice.

five.en: Can anyone here change a five?
five.gloss: A banknote with a denomination of five units of currency.
A short rest, especially one of five minutes.

once.en: Such a turnaround once seemed inconceivable.
once.zh: 这样的逆转曾经令人难以想象。

once.gloss: Formerly; during some period in the past.
once.zh: 我曾经有过一辆摩托车。
石棉绝缘材料曾经无处不在。

once.en: I have only once eaten pizza.

once.gloss: Multiplied by one: indicating that a number is multiplied by one.

white.en: The pirate flag bore white crossbones.
white.zh: 海盗旗上画着白色交叉骨。

white.en: Each feather had a small white fleck.
white.zh: 每根羽毛上都有一个小白点。
浴室铺有白色大理石瓷砖。

white.en: Write in black ink on white paper.
white.gloss: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.
white.zh: 用黑色墨水在白纸上书写。

least.en: It was the least surprising thing.
least.gloss: Used to form superlatives of adjectives, especially those that do not form the superlative by adding -est.
least.zh: 这是最不令人惊讶的事情。

least.en: He's gotta be at least 60, min!
Were you in the least upset yesterday?
least.zh: 昨天你有没有最不高兴的时候？

least.en: He earns the least money in his family.
least.gloss: Chiefly preceded by the: superlative form of little: most little.; Smallest in amount or extent.
least.zh: 他在家里挣的钱是最少的。

least.en: That decision rewards those who least deserve it.
least.gloss: In a degree below all others; in the lowest or smallest degree.
least.zh: 这一决定奖励了那些最不值得的人。

least.en: I’m giving least of all towards her present.
least.gloss: Chiefly preceded by the: superlative form of little: most little; the smallest amount or extent of something.
least.zh: 我对她的礼物贡献最少。

president.en: Choosing the cabinet is the president's prerogative.
president.zh: 选择内阁成员是总统的特权。

president.en: The vast majority of presidents have been male.
president.gloss: The head of state of a republic, sometimes also the head of government as well, particularly (US politics) the head of the executive branch of the federal government of the United States of America.
president.zh: 绝大多数总统都是男性。

learn.en: This paradigm emphasizes learning through experience.
learn.zh: 这种范式强调通过经验学习。

learn.en: Rote learning cannot replace genuine understanding.
learn.zh: 机械记忆无法代替真正的理解。

learn.en: She learned to modulate her resonant voice.
learn.zh: 她学会了调节自己洪亮的嗓音。

learn.en: He just learned that he will be sacked.
learn.gloss: To come to know; to become informed of; to find out.
learn.zh: 他刚刚得知自己将被解雇。

real.gloss: Genuine, not artificial, counterfeit, or fake.
Signifying meritorious qualities or actions, especially with regard to genuineness, groundedness, and true success rather than poser imitations of success.

real.en: Se looked at me real strange.
No one has ever seen a real unicorn.
real.zh: 没有人见过真正的独角兽。

change.zh: 加热会改变这种聚合物的结构。
气候变化影响物种分布。
同时发生的变化影响了两个组别。

change.en: This bus ride requires exact change.
change.gloss: An amount of cash, usually in the form of coins, but sometimes inclusive of paper money.
change.zh: 这次乘坐巴士需要准确的零钱。

change.en: The fairy changed the frog into a prince.
change.gloss: To make something into something else.
change.zh: 仙女把青蛙变成了王子。

team.zh: 这支队伍展现了出色的素质。

team.en: Their team drubbed the visitors yesterday.
team.zh: 他们的队伍昨天大胜客队。

team.en: They teamed to complete the project.
team.gloss: To form a group, as for sports or work.
team.zh: 他们联手完成了这个项目。

team.en: We need more volunteers for the netball team.
team.gloss: Any group of people involved in the same activity, especially sports or work.
team.zh: 我们需要更多的无板篮球队志愿者。

minute.en: Infuse the tea for three minutes.
He talks a mile a minute.
Wait a minute, I’m not ready yet!
minute.gloss: A short but unspecified time period.

minute.en: You have twenty minutes to complete the test.
minute.gloss: A unit of time which is one sixtieth of an hour (sixty seconds).
minute.zh: 您有二十分钟的时间来完成测试。

minute.en: I conked out the minute I got home.
minute.gloss: A point in time; a moment.

best.en: The treaty was a good auspice.
best.zh: 这项条约是一个好兆头。

best.en: Good animal husbandry improves livestock health.
best.zh: 良好的畜牧管理改善牲畜健康。

best.en: The appraisal will exemplify good evaluation practice.
best.zh: 这份评估将体现良好的评价做法。

best.gloss: The supreme effort one can make, or has made.

best.en: Unpacking took the best part of a week.

several.en: The anthology includes several illustrious writers.
several.zh: 这部选集收录了几位著名作家的作品。

several.en: Company incorporation requires several legal documents.
several.zh: 公司注册需要若干法律文件。

several.en: Several of the members were absent.
several.gloss: Consisting of a number more than one (especially, more than two) but not very many.

idea.en: The treatise propounds several controversial ideas.
idea.zh: 这部专著提出了几个有争议的观点。

idea.en: These ideas cohere into a consistent theory.
idea.zh: 这些观点结合成了一套一致的理论。

idea.en: The coalescence of ideas produced a new theory.
idea.zh: 这些观点的汇聚产生了新理论。

kid.en: Only '90s kids will remember this toy.
kid.gloss: A child, adolescent, or (loosely) a young adult.; A person whose childhood took place in a particular time period or area.
kid.zh: 只有90后的孩子才会记得这个玩具。

kid.en: This is Bobby, he is our youngest kid.
kid.gloss: A child, adolescent, or (loosely) a young adult.; One's son or daughter, regardless of age.
kid.zh: 这是鲍比，他是我们最小的孩子。

body.en: Metabolic changes can affect body temperature.
The turtle's carapace protected its body.
body.zh: 龟的甲壳保护了它的身体。

body.en: The spined fish inflated its body.
body.zh: 这条带刺的鱼鼓起了身体。

body.en: The red wine, sadly, lacked body.
body.gloss: Material entity.; Comparative viscosity, solidity or substance (in wine, colours etc.).
body.zh: 遗憾的是，红酒缺乏酒体。

body.en: His gun had two bodies on it.
body.gloss: Physical frame.; A corpse.; A murder.

body.en: The boxer took a blow to the body.
body.gloss: Main section.; The torso, the main structure of a human or animal frame excluding the extremities (limbs, head, tail).
body.zh: 拳击手的身体受到了重击。

information.en: The campaign will disseminate health information.
information.zh: 这次活动将传播健康信息。

information.en: Researchers glean information from fragmentary records.
information.zh: 研究人员从零碎记录中搜集信息。

information.en: Long-range planning requires reliable demographic information.
information.zh: 长期规划需要可靠的人口信息。

information.en: I need some more information about this issue.
information.gloss: Things that are or can be known about a given topic; communicable knowledge of something.
information.zh: 我需要有关此问题的更多信息。

nothing.zh: 她无动于衷的表情没有透露任何情绪。

nothing.en: Nothing could extenuate the harm they caused.
nothing.zh: 没有什么能减轻他们所造成的伤害。

nothing.en: Nothing bad will happen, will it?
nothing.zh: 不会有什么不好的事情发生吧？

nothing.en: The cricketer played a nothing shot.
nothing.zh: 板球运动员没有打出一球。

ago.en: Her forebear settled here centuries ago.
ago.zh: 她的一位祖先在几个世纪前定居于此。

ago.en: The school introduced coeducation decades ago.
ago.zh: 这所学校几十年前引入了男女同校制。

ago.en: The theater enjoyed its heyday decades ago.
ago.zh: 这家剧院的鼎盛时期在几十年前。

ago.en: I got married ten years ago.
ago.gloss: Before now, before the present time

lead:guide.zh: 我们的队伍取得了领先。

lead:guide.en: This path leads to the beach.

social.en: The arrangement observes every social nicety.
social.zh: 这项安排顾及了每一处社交礼节。

social.en: The act transgressed established social conventions.
social.zh: 这种行为违背了既定的社会惯例。

understand.en: Rote learning cannot replace genuine understanding.
understand.zh: 机械记忆无法代替真正的理解。

understand.en: Retrospection gave her a clearer understanding.
understand.zh: 回顾往事使她理解得更清楚。

understand.en: The teacher combined firmness with sympathetic understanding.

understand.gloss: To be thoroughly familiar with; to be able to undertake properly.

whether.en: They questioned whether the solution was practicable.
whether.zh: 他们质疑这个解决方案是否可行。

whether.en: They questioned whether such expenditure was warrantable.
whether.zh: 他们质疑这笔支出是否正当。

whether.en: The form asks whether you have a dependant.
whether.zh: 表格询问你是否有受扶养人。

whether.en: Do you know whether he's coming?
whether.gloss: Introduces a simple indirect question (with no correlative).

whether.en: He's coming, whether you like it or not.
whether.gloss: Introduces a disjunctive adverbial clause qualifying the main clause (with correlative or).
whether.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，他都会来。

watch.en: They watched an old videocassette together.
watch.zh: 他们一起看了一盘旧录像带。

watch.en: We watched the foals gambol at dawn.
watch.zh: 黎明时我们看着小马驹欢跳。

watch.en: We watched a quail cross the path.
watch.zh: 我们看着一只鹌鹑穿过小路。

watch.gloss: To attend to dangers to or regarding.

watch.en: Please watch my suitcase for a minute.

watch.gloss: To observe over a period of time; to notice or pay attention.

together.zh: 这些部件巧妙地拼合在一起。

together.en: The interdependent systems must operate together.
together.zh: 相互依赖的系统必须协同运行。

together.en: Together, we can surmount these obstacles.
together.zh: 我们齐心协力就能克服这些障碍。

together.gloss: At the same time, in the same place; in close association or proximity.

together.en: He put all the parts together.
together.gloss: Into one place; into a single thing; combined.
together.zh: 他把所有的部分放在一起。

follow.en: We followed a precipitous path downhill.
follow.zh: 我们沿着一条陡峭的小路下山。

follow.en: They scrupulously followed the prescribed procedure.
follow.zh: 他们一丝不苟地遵循了规定流程。

follow.en: Each instrumentalist followed the conductor's gestures.
follow.zh: 每位器乐演奏者都跟随指挥的手势。

follow.en: B follows A in the alphabet.
follow.gloss: To go or come after in a sequence.
follow.zh: B 在字母表中位于 A 之后。

follow.en: Follow these instructions to the letter.
follow.zh: 请严格按照这些说明进行操作。

follow.gloss: To understand, to pay attention to.

centre.en: He hit the target dead in the centre.
Jones, the centre forward, started the game sharply.
centre.zh: 比赛一开始，中锋琼斯就表现出色。

parent.en: Parents inculcate values through everyday behavior.
parent.zh: 父母通过日常行为灌输价值观。

parent.en: The overwrought parent needed calm reassurance.
parent.zh: 这位心烦意乱的家长需要平静的安慰。

parent.en: The baby-sitter arrived before the parents left.
parent.zh: 保姆在父母离开之前到了。

stop.gloss: To cause (something) to come to an end.
To quit partaking in the use of or participation in (something).
An action of stopping; interruption of travel.

stop.en: I stopped at the traffic lights.
stop.zh: 我在红绿灯处停了下来。

face.en: His wan face revealed his exhaustion.
face.zh: 他苍白的脸显露出他的疲惫。

face.en: We faced an onslaught of criticism.
The departmental budget faces a shortfall.
That girl has a pretty face.
face.gloss: The front part of the head of a human or other animal, featuring the eyes, nose, and mouth, and the surrounding area.
face.zh: 那个女孩有一张漂亮的脸。

face.en: We are facing an uncertain future.
face.gloss: To be presented or confronted with; to have in prospect.
face.zh: 我们面临着一个不确定的未来。

anything.zh: 除了肛交，我什么都会做。

anything.en: That isn't anything like a car.
anything.gloss: In any way, any extent or any degree.

anything.en: I would not do it for anything.
anything.gloss: Any object, act, state, event, or fact whatsoever; a thing of any kind; something or other.
anything.zh: 我不会为了任何事而这样做。

create.en: The illustrator created fanciful animal characters.
create.zh: 插画师创造了奇特的动物角色。

create.en: The chord creates a deliberate dissonance.
create.zh: 这个和弦营造了刻意的不协和感。

create.en: The children created a cheerful hubbub.
create.zh: 孩子们发出了欢快的喧闹声。

create.en: Couturiers create exclusive garments for an affluent clientele.
create.gloss: To bring into existence; (sometimes in particular:); To make or produce from other (e.g. raw, unrefined or scattered) materials or combinable elements or ideas; to design or invest with a new form, shape, function, etc.
create.zh: 时装设计师为富裕的客户打造独特的服装。

public.en: Such policies can engender public resentment.
public.zh: 这样的政策可能引起公众的不满。

public.en: The campaign will galvanize public support.
public.zh: 这次活动将激发公众的支持。

public.en: Food adulteration can endanger public health.
public.zh: 食品掺假可能危害公共健康。

already.gloss: Marks a change in state, more or less in the same manner as the inchoative aspect.

clear.en: The instructions are clear and succinct.
Stars spangle the clear night sky.
clear.zh: 星星点缀着清朗的夜空。

clear.gloss: Better than, superior to. (usually with points, votes, etc.)
clear.zh: 热刺队客场击败阿森纳。

clear.en: The windshield was clear and clean.
clear.gloss: Bright; luminous; not dark or obscured.

clear.en: The steamer cleared for Liverpool today.
clear.zh: 轮船今天放行前往利物浦。

practice.zh: 教学研究为课堂实践提供参考。

practice.en: The appraisal will exemplify good evaluation practice.
practice.zh: 这份评估将体现良好的评价做法。

practice.en: The instrumentalist practiced the difficult passage repeatedly.
practice.zh: 这位器乐演奏者反复练习那段困难的乐句。

practice.en: She ran a thriving medical practice.
practice.gloss: The ongoing pursuit of a craft or profession, particularly in medicine or the fine arts.; A place where a professional service is provided, such as a general practice.
practice.zh: 她经营着一家蓬勃发展的医疗机构。

practice.en: I have choir practice every Sunday after church.
practice.gloss: Repetition of an activity to improve a skill.; An organized event for the purpose of performing such repetition.
practice.zh: 我每周日做完礼拜后都会进行唱诗班练习。

piece.zh: 这些部件巧妙地拼合在一起。

piece.en: Interlocking pieces make the structure stable.
piece.zh: 相互咬合的构件使结构稳定。

piece.gloss: A structured practice row, often used for performance evaluation.

piece.en: I’d like another piece of pie.
piece.gloss: A part of a larger whole, usually in such a form that it is able to be separated from other parts.

piece.en: The announcer is wearing a new piece.
piece.gloss: A toupee or wig, especially when worn by a man.
piece.zh: 播音员穿着一件新衣服。

land.en: Land reclamation altered the coastal landscape.
land.zh: 土地开垦改变了沿海地貌。

land.en: The project promotes reclamation of polluted land.
land.zh: 这个项目推动受污染土地的整治恢复。

land.en: A grasshopper landed on the green leaf.
land.zh: 一只蚱蜢落在了绿叶上。

land.gloss: The part of Earth which is not covered by oceans or other bodies of water.
land.zh: 大多数昆虫生活在陆地上。

land.en: They come from a faraway land.

recent.en: The term is a recent coinage.
recent.zh: 这个术语是新近创造的词。

recent.en: The population boomed in recent years.
The camera was of recent make.
The cause has several hundred recent donors.
recent.gloss: Having done something a short while ago that distinguishes them as what they are called.
recent.zh: 该事业最近有数百名捐赠者。

describe.en: She elaborately described the intricate design.
describe.zh: 她详尽描述了这个复杂的设计。

describe.en: The report describes the manifold benefits.
describe.zh: 这份报告描述了多方面的益处。

describe.en: The report describes each alteration minutely.
describe.zh: 报告详尽地描述了每一项改动。

describe.en: The fungus was first described by a botanist.
describe.gloss: To introduce a new taxon to science by explaining its characteristics and particularly how it differs from other taxa.
describe.zh: 这种真菌首先由植物学家描述。

product.en: He unscrupulously concealed the product's defects.
product.zh: 他毫无顾忌地隐瞒了产品缺陷。

product.en: Wash excess product out of your hair.
product.gloss: Ellipsis of beauty product: any preparation to be applied to the hair, skin, nails, etc. Often specifically a preparation used to hold one's hair in a desired arrangement.
product.zh: 洗掉头发上多余的产品。

product.en: I got some product here — you buying?
product.gloss: A commodity offered for sale.; Illegal drugs, especially cocaine, when viewed as a commodity.
product.zh: 我这里有一些产品——你买吗？

doctor.en: The doctor examined the glandular tissue.
The village faces a dearth of doctors.
doctor.zh: 这个村庄面临医生短缺的问题。

doctor.en: Doctors may transfuse compatible blood when necessary.
doctor.zh: 必要时，医生可能输注相容的血液。

doctor.en: Her children doctored her back to health.
doctor.gloss: To act as a medical doctor to.
doctor.zh: 她的孩子们让她恢复了健康。

doctor.en: The students asked to see Doctor Jones.
doctor.gloss: The title of an academic or medical doctor; used before or instead of the doctor's name.
doctor.zh: 学生们要求见琼斯医生。

wall.en: One remnant of the wall remains.
wall.zh: 这面墙还留有一处残迹。

wall.en: They whitewash the walls each spring.
wall.zh: 他们每年春天都用石灰水刷墙。

wall.en: Moss covered the damp stone wall.
wall.zh: 苔藓覆盖了潮湿的石墙。

wall.en: He walled the study with books.
wall.gloss: To enclose with, or as if with, a wall or walls.

wall.en: The town wall was surrounded by a moat.
wall.gloss: A structure built for defense surrounding a city, castle etc.

patient.en: The patient required tertiary medical care.
patient.zh: 这位病人需要三级医疗服务。

patient.en: The treatment improved the patient's continence.
patient.zh: 这种治疗改善了患者的控尿能力。

patient.en: Modern dentistry emphasizes prevention and patient comfort.
patient.zh: 现代牙科学强调预防和患者舒适。

worker.en: Workers maintained the hatchery's water supply.
worker.zh: 工人们维护了孵化场的供水系统。

worker.en: Automation freed workers from repetitive drudgery.
worker.zh: 自动化使工人摆脱了重复而辛苦的劳动。

worker.en: They unscrupulously exploited the vulnerable workers.
worker.zh: 他们肆无忌惮地剥削弱势工人。

news.en: She greeted the news with rapture.
news.zh: 她听到这个消息时欣喜若狂。

news.en: She grew sulky after the unwelcome news.
news.zh: 听到坏消息后，她闷闷不乐。
他对这个消息的反应很糟糕。

news.en: Did you hear/read/see the latest news?
news.gloss: Information about current events disseminated by the media.
news.zh: 您听到/读到/看到最新消息了吗？

news.en: Is there any news about the storm?
news.zh: 有关于暴风雨的消息吗？

test.zh: 研究人员检验了这种疗法的功效。
这项测试衡量听觉理解能力。
这个假设经过了实验检验。

test.gloss: To be shown to be by test.

test.en: Climbing the mountain tested our stamina.
test.gloss: To challenge, to put a strain on (something).
test.zh: 爬山考验的是我们的体力。

test.en: He survived the great test of battle.

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

test.zh: 他经受住了战斗的巨大考验。

movie.zh: 我们都很喜欢这部电影。

movie.en: Every night with you is a movie!
movie.gloss: An extremely fun and exciting experience.
movie.zh: 和你在一起的每个夜晚都是一部电影！

certain.en: Heat can inactivate certain microbial enzymes.
certain.zh: 加热可以使某些微生物酶失活。

certain.en: Strong heat can demagnetize certain materials.
certain.zh: 强热可以使某些材料退磁。

certain.en: The biologist studied cannibalism among certain insects.
certain.zh: 生物学家研究了某些昆虫的同类相食现象。

certain.en: I was certain of my decision.
certain.gloss: Sure in one's mind, positive; absolutely confident in the truth of something.

certain.en: Certain people are good at running.
certain.gloss: Having been determined but not specified.

personal.zh: 定性研究探究个人体验。
节制指导着他的个人行为。

personal.en: Her introspective diary explores personal ambivalence.
personal.zh: 她内省的日记探讨了个人的矛盾心理。

personal.en: You can't read my diary—it is personal.
personal.gloss: Dealing with subjects about which one wishes (or people usually wish) to maintain privacy or discretion; not for public view; sensitive, intimate.
personal.zh: 你不能读我的日记——它是私人的。

personal.en: Only factual argumentation, no need to get personal.
personal.gloss: Relating to an individual, their character, conduct, motives, or private affairs, in an invidious and offensive manner
personal.zh: 仅就事实进行论证，无需个人化。

simply.zh: 很简单，他刚刚解雇了你。

simply.en: I was simply asking a question.
That was a simply wonderful dessert.
simply.zh: 那真是一道美妙的甜点。

third.gloss: Ellipsis of third gear (of a gearbox).
The person or thing in the third position.
An interval consisting of the first and third notes in a scale.

third.en: The play ended with Jones standing on third.
third.zh: 这场比赛以琼斯排名第三而结束。

technology.en: The emergence of cellular technology transformed communication.
technology.zh: 蜂窝通信技术的出现改变了通信方式。

technology.en: Applicants should be conversant with modern technology.
technology.zh: 申请人应该熟悉现代技术。

technology.en: It leads in the information technology sector.
technology.zh: 它在信息技术领域处于领先地位。

catch.en: The diamond's brilliance caught her eye.
catch.zh: 钻石的光彩吸引了她的目光。

catch.en: The osprey caught a fish near shore.
catch.zh: 这只鱼鹰在岸边附近抓到了一条鱼。

catch.gloss: To seize hold of.; To germinate and set down roots.
To take in with one's senses or intellect.; To grasp mentally: perceive and understand.

catch.en: The player made an impressive catch.
catch.gloss: The act of catching an object in motion, especially a ball.
catch.zh: 该球员完成了一次令人印象深刻的接球。

catch.en: The kids love to play catch.
catch.gloss: The game of catching a ball.
catch.zh: 孩子们喜欢玩接球游戏。

step.en: Critics called the policy a retrograde step.
step.zh: 批评者称这项政策是一种倒退。

step.en: Don't step too close to the ledge.
step.zh: 不要走得太靠近岩架边缘。

step.gloss: To move the foot in walking; to advance or recede by raising and moving one of the feet to another resting place, or by moving both feet in succession.; To don with a stepping action.

step.en: He improved step by step, or by steps.
step.gloss: A distinct part of a process; stage; phase.
step.zh: 他是一步步进步的，或者说是一步步进步的。

baby.gloss: A very young human, particularly from birth to a couple of years old or until walking is fully mastered.; A very young human, even if not yet born.
baby.zh: 你的宝宝预产期是什么时候？

baby.en: Adam is the baby of the family.
baby.gloss: The lastborn of a family; the youngest sibling, irrespective of age.

baby.en: Hey baby, what are you doing later?
baby.gloss: A form of address to a person considered to be attractive.
baby.zh: 嘿宝贝，你稍后要做什么？

baby.gloss: A person's romantic partner; a term of endearment used to refer to or address e.g. one's girlfriend, boyfriend, or spouse.

computer.gloss: A programmable electronic device that performs mathematical calculations and logical operations, especially one that can process, store and retrieve large amounts of data very quickly; now especially, a small one for personal or home use employed for manipulating text or graphics, accessing the Internet, or playing games or media.
computer.zh: 大卫是一位计算机专家。
这台计算机拥有人工智能。

type.gloss: Preferred sort of person; sort of person that one is attracted to.

type.en: My blood type is A negative.
Please type up our monthly report.
type.zh: 请输入我们的月度报告。

type.en: The headline was set in bold type.
type.gloss: A letter or character used for printing, historically a cast or engraved block.; Text printed with such type, or imitating its characteristics.

attention.en: This neurotransmitter influences mood and attention.
attention.zh: 这种神经递质影响情绪和注意力。

attention.en: He approached the shrine with reverent attention.
attention.zh: 他带着虔敬走近了神龛。

attention.en: Her entrance attracted no attention whatsoever.
attention.zh: 她的出现并没有引起任何注意。

attention.en: The company will now come to attention.
attention.gloss: A state of alertness in the standing position.
attention.zh: 该公司现在将引起人们的注意。

attention.en: Please direct your attention to the following words.
attention.zh: 请大家注意以下几句话。

draw.zh: 这次袭击遭到了广泛谴责。

draw.en: Draw a diagonal across the quadrilateral.
draw.zh: 在这个四边形中画一条对角线。

draw.en: The dancer's gyration drew enthusiastic applause.
draw.zh: 舞者的旋转赢得了热烈掌声。

draw.gloss: The act of drawing:; The procedure by which the result of a lottery is determined.

draw.en: The cat scratched her, drawing blood.
draw.gloss: Senses relating to extracting or selecting.; To pull (something) out; to extract, to remove.; To extract (a small amount of liquid, especially blood) by puncturing a surface, or by using a pipette, syringe, or other suction device.

draw.en: The circuit draws three hundred watts.
draw.gloss: Senses relating to extracting or selecting.; To consume (power).
draw.zh: 该电路消耗三百瓦功率。

film.zh: 这部影片中有不必要的暴力内容。

film.en: Critics flayed the film's hackneyed plot.
film.zh: 评论家猛烈抨击了影片陈腐的情节。

film.en: The film provides light escapist entertainment.
film.zh: 这部电影提供了轻松的消遣娱乐。

republican.en: The historian compared continental conservatism with republican ideals.
republican.zh: 这位历史学家将大陆保守主义与共和理想进行了比较。

republican.en: He is the Republican boss in Kentucky.
republican.zh: 他是肯塔基州的共和党领袖。
共和党领导人否认了这一指控。

organization.en: These rules encompass every constituent organization.
organization.zh: 这些规定涵盖每一个成员组织。

organization.en: The report follows a systematical organization.
organization.zh: 这份报告采用了系统的组织方式。

organization.en: This is a nonreporting political organization.
organization.zh: 这是一个不报告的政治组织。

organization.en: The organization of the book is as follows.
organization.gloss: The way in which something is organized, such as a book or an article.

organization.en: He's been in the Dodgers' organization since 2003.
organization.gloss: A major league club and all its farm teams.
organization.zh: 他自 2003 年起就加入道奇队。

tree.en: Petrifaction preserved the tree's original structure.
tree.zh: 石化作用保存了树木的原有结构。

tree.en: A hazel tree shaded the quiet garden.
tree.zh: 一棵榛树为安静的花园遮阴。

tree.gloss: To chase (an animal or person) up a tree.

tree.en: We’ll show it as a tree list.
tree.gloss: A display or listing of entries or elements such that there are primary and secondary entries shown, usually linked by drawn lines or by indenting to the right.
tree.zh: 我们将其显示为树列表。

source.en: The company sources its materials ethically.
source.zh: 这家公司以符合伦理的方式采购材料。

source.en: This claim remains a source of contention.
source.zh: 这一说法仍是争论的起因。

source.en: Her research examines the painting's iconographic sources.
source.zh: 她的研究考察了这幅画的图像学来源。

red.en: The wound looked red and tumid.
The lights flashed alternately red and blue.
red.zh: 灯光交替闪烁着红色和蓝色。

red.en: His red bandanna lay beside the saddle.
red.zh: 他的红色花巾放在马鞍旁边。

red.gloss: Having an orange-brown or orange-blond colour; ginger.

red.en: The girl wore a red skirt.
red.zh: 那女孩穿着一条红色的裙子。

red.en: Red can be seen as hot or angry.
red.gloss: The color of the setting sun, blood, and strawberries; the color which is evoked by the longest visible wavelengths (between about 625–740 nm), and a primary additive color.
red.zh: 红色可以被视为炎热或愤怒。

nearly.en: She nearly overbalanced while reaching for it.
nearly.zh: 她伸手去拿它时差点失去平衡。

nearly.en: I've nearly completely finished reading it.

choose.zh: 这位不饮酒的人选择了气泡水。

choose.en: She chose a nontraditional career path.
choose.zh: 她选择了一条非传统职业道路。

choose.en: Choose keywords relevant to your enquiry.
choose.zh: 选择与你的查询相关的关键词。

choose.en: He was chosen as president in 1990.
I chose to walk to work today.
choose.gloss: To decide to act in a certain way.
choose.zh: 今天我选择步行去上班。

cause.zh: 他的影射让人十分尴尬。
这项公告引起了广泛的惊愕。
过大压力导致了永久变形。

cause.en: There is no cause for alarm.

cause.gloss: To set off an event or action; to bring about; to produce.

hair.en: Rain left his lank hair plastered flat.
hair.zh: 雨水使他细软的头发贴平了。

hair.en: The gust disarranged her freshly styled hair.
hair.zh: 一阵风吹乱了她刚梳好的头发。

hair.gloss: Any very small distance, or degree; a hairbreadth.

century.en: Her forebear settled here centuries ago.
century.zh: 她的一位祖先在几个世纪前定居于此。

century.en: The centennial marked a century of progress.
century.zh: 百年纪念标志着一个世纪的发展。

century.en: The volcano has remained quiescent for centuries.
century.zh: 这座火山几个世纪以来一直处于休眠状态。

century.en: That was his tenth professional century.
century.gloss: A score of one hundred points.
century.zh: 那是他职业生涯的第十个世纪。

century.gloss: A hundred runs scored either by a single player in one innings, or by two players in a partnership.
century.zh: 他已获得 44 个限赛百分。

evidence.en: Empirical evidence challenged the existing paradigm.
evidence.zh: 实证证据挑战了现有范式。

evidence.en: Her main contention concerns the evidence.
evidence.zh: 她的主要论点涉及证据。

evidence.en: The arbitrator considered both parties' evidence.
evidence.zh: 仲裁人考虑了双方的证据。

window.en: A tiny flyspeck marked the window.
window.zh: 窗上有一个小小的苍蝇斑点。

difficult.en: His ambivalence made the decision difficult.
difficult.zh: 他的矛盾心理使决定变得困难。

difficult.en: The instrumentalist practiced the difficult passage repeatedly.
difficult.zh: 这位器乐演奏者反复练习那段困难的乐句。

difficult.en: The trumpeter rehearsed the difficult chromatic passage.
difficult.zh: 小号手排练了那段困难的半音乐句。

listen.zh: 她越听越觉得难以置信。

listen.en: The sagacious leader listened before deciding.
listen.zh: 这位明智的领导者先倾听，再决策。

listen.en: Please listen carefully as I explain.
listen.gloss: To use one's sense of hearing and auditory cognition in an intentional way; to make deliberate use of one's ears; to pay attention to or wait for a specific sound.

listen.en: Good children listen to their parents.
listen.gloss: To accept advice or obey instruction; to agree or assent.

soon.en: You will doubtless hear from her soon.
soon.zh: 你无疑很快会收到她的消息。

soon.en: I need the soonest date you have available.
soon.gloss: Short in length of time from the present.
soon.zh: 我需要你能安排的最快日期。

soon.en: Hurry up, the wedding is soon to start!
soon.gloss: Used as an alternative to express 'to be going to' in the form 'to be soon to'.
soon.zh: 快点吧，婚礼马上就要开始了！

culture.en: Different cultures commingle in this maritime city.
culture.zh: 不同文化在这座海港城市交融。

culture.en: Achilles is a legend in Greek culture.
culture.zh: 阿喀琉斯是希腊文化中的传奇人物。

culture.en: Religious adherence can shape a community’s culture.
culture.zh: 宗教信仰可以塑造社区文化。

billion.en: There were billions of people at the concert.
billion.zh: 音乐会现场有数十亿人。

chance.en: You shouldn't leave that to chance.
We've mitigated against the chance of flooding.
chance.zh: 我们已经降低了发生洪水的可能性。

brother.zh: 阿万嫁给了她的兄弟该隐。

brother.en: Brother, can you spare a dime?
brother.gloss: A form of address to a man.
A male fellow member of a religious community, church, trades union etc.

brother.en: At the monastery, Brother Stephen supervises the kitchen.
brother.gloss: Title of respect for an adult male member of a religious or fraternal order.
brother.zh: 在修道院里，斯蒂芬修士负责监督厨房。

energy.zh: 这套系统追踪能源利用情况。

energy.en: Don't expend all your energy immediately.
energy.zh: 不要一下子耗尽所有精力。

energy.en: The music evokes a primal energy.
energy.zh: 这段音乐唤起了一种原始的力量。

energy.en: Higher electricity prices should help promote energy efficiency.
energy.gloss: Energy is the ability to do work: move, give off heat, give off light, etc.
energy.zh: 较高的电价应有助于提高能源效率。

realize.zh: 我们的计划完全实现了。

realize.en: At length, my wish was realized.
At last, he realized his mistakes.
realize.zh: 最后，他认识到了自己的错误。

period.zh: 童年是一个性格形成的时期。

period.en: The strata reveal successive geologic periods.
period.zh: 这些地层显示了连续的地质时期。

period.en: This assemblage includes objects from several periods.
period.zh: 这批藏品包括几个时期的物件。

period.en: Food rationing continued in the post-war period.
period.gloss: A length of time in history seen as a single coherent entity; an epoch, era.
period.zh: 战后时期，粮食配给仍在继续。

period.en: I have math class in second period.
period.gloss: Each of the divisions into which a school day is split, allocated to a given subject or activity.

period.en: They won in the first overtime period.
period.gloss: One or more additional intervals to decide a tied game, an overtime period.
period.zh: 他们在第一个加时赛中获胜。

summer.en: The blue frock suited the summer weather.
summer.zh: 这条蓝色连衣裙适合夏天穿。

summer.en: He was barely eighteen summers old.
summer.gloss: year; used to give the age of a person, usually a young one.

summer.en: We went barefoot in the summer.
I'm going to the Gambia in the summer.
summer.gloss: One of four seasons, traditionally the second, marked by the longest and typically hottest days of the year due to the inclination of the Earth and thermal lag. Typically regarded as spanning either the period between the summer solstice to the autumnal equinox, or the months of June, July, and August in the Northern Hemisphere and the months of December, January and February in the Southern Hemisphere.

hundred.en: The numbers totaled in the hundreds.
hundred.gloss: A numerical value equal to 100 (10²), occurring after ninety-nine; ten times ten.

hundred.en: The circuit draws three hundred watts.
hundred.zh: 该电路消耗三百瓦功率。

hundred.en: Can you count to a hundred?
He made a hundred in the historic match.
hundred.gloss: A score of one hundred runs or more scored by a batsman.
hundred.zh: 他在这场历史性的比赛中打出了一百分。

available.en: We assessed the sufficiency of available resources.
available.zh: 我们评估了现有资源是否充足。

available.en: The dietitian assessed the food's available nutriment.
available.zh: 营养师评估了食物中可利用的养分。

available.gloss: Such as one may avail oneself of; capable of being used for the accomplishment of a purpose.
available.zh: 我们有一个可用的候选人。

plant.en: This pollutant can inhibit plant growth.
plant.zh: 这种污染物会抑制植物生长。

plant.en: Plants obtain nourishment from the soil.
plant.zh: 植物从土壤中获取养分。

plant.en: Climbing plants covered the wooden lattice.
plant.zh: 攀缘植物爬满了木格架。

plant.en: The company has production plants in three countries.
plant.gloss: A factory or other industrial or institutional building or facility.
plant.zh: 该公司在三个国家设有生产工厂。

likely.en: Rain is likely later this afternoon.
likely.gloss: Probable; having a greater-than-even chance of occurring.
likely.zh: 今天下午晚些时候可能会下雨。

likely.en: Jones is a likely candidate for management.
likely.gloss: Appropriate, suitable; believable; promising, having a good potential.
likely.zh: 琼斯可能是管理层的候选人。

likely.en: Live a persecutor, likely die a persecutor.
likely.zh: 生于迫害者，也可能死于迫害者。

likely.en: Do you think there's likely to be snow?
likely.gloss: Reasonably to be expected; apparently destined, probable.

likely.en: Likely he’ll win the election in this economy.
likely.zh: 在这种经济形势下，他很可能会赢得选举。

opportunity.en: A confluence of events created this opportunity.
opportunity.zh: 一系列事件的汇合创造了这个机会。

opportunity.en: A canny investor noticed the opportunity early.
opportunity.zh: 一位精明的投资者很早就发现了机会。

opportunity.en: I availed myself of the opportunity.

term.en: The glossary explains every technical term.
term.zh: 术语表解释了每个技术术语。

term.en: The term is a recent coinage.
term.zh: 这个术语是新近创造的词。

term.en: These terms are conventionally printed in italics.
term.zh: 这些术语按惯例用斜体印刷。

short.en: The pianist played a short prelude.
short.zh: 钢琴家演奏了一首短小的前奏曲。

short.en: The route is comparatively short and unobstructed.
short.zh: 这条路线相对较短，而且畅通无阻。

short.en: A short musical interlude separated the scenes.
short.zh: 一小段间奏音乐将这些场景分隔开。

short.en: He gave a short answer to the question.
short.zh: 他对这个问题作了简短的回答。

short.en: He cut me short repeatedly in the meeting.
short.zh: 他在会议上多次打断我的话。

short.en: The recent developments at work caught them short.
short.zh: 最近的工作进展让他们措手不及。

letter.en: The machine can emboss raised lettering.
letter.zh: 这台机器能压印出凸起的字母。

letter.en: She customarily signs each letter by hand.
letter.zh: 她通常亲笔在每封信上签名。

letter.en: There are twenty-six letters in the English alphabet.
letter.zh: 英文字母表中有二十六个字母。

letter.en: Letter (b) constitutes an exception to this provision.
letter.gloss: A division unit of a piece of law marked by a letter of the alphabet.
letter.zh: (b) 项构成本规定的例外情况。

condition.en: The region experiences harsh climatic conditions.
condition.zh: 这个地区的气候条件恶劣。

condition.en: Mammalian cells require suitable growth conditions.
condition.zh: 哺乳动物细胞需要合适的生长条件。

condition.en: The seedlings grew uniformly under controlled conditions.
condition.zh: 幼苗在受控条件下均匀生长。

condition.en: Environmental protection is a condition for sustainability.
condition.zh: 环境保护是可持续发展的条件。

choice.en: Income is a determinant of housing choice.
choice.zh: 收入是决定住房选择的因素之一。

choice.en: She didn't leave us much choice.
choice.zh: 她没有给我们留下太多选择。

choice.en: Are you against freedom of choice?
You have three choices: vanilla, strawberry or chocolate.
choice.zh: 您有三种选择：香草、草莓或巧克力。

single.en: These contiguous plots form a single field.
single.zh: 这些相邻地块组成了一整片田。

single.en: The island forms a single large landmass.
single.zh: 这座岛构成了一整块大陆地。

single.en: The groups amalgamated into a single consortium.
single.zh: 这些团体合并成了一个联合体。

single.en: The vase contained a single long-stemmed rose.
single.gloss: Not accompanied by anything else; one in number.
single.zh: 花瓶里有一朵长茎玫瑰。

rule.en: These rules encompass every constituent organization.
rule.zh: 这些规定涵盖每一个成员组织。

rule.en: We need rules whereby everyone benefits.
rule.zh: 我们需要让所有人受益的规则。

rule.en: Adherence to safety rules remains essential.
rule.zh: 遵守安全规则依然至关重要。

rule.en: All participants must adhere to the rules.
rule.zh: 所有参与者都必须遵守规则。

rule.en: My rule is to rise at six o'clock.
rule.gloss: A normal condition or state of affairs.

daughter.zh: 他把他的女儿托付给了我。

daughter.en: His daughter was petted and spoiled.
My daughter strolled through the exam.
daughter.zh: 我女儿悠闲地参加了考试。

administration.en: The company went into voluntary administration last week.
administration.gloss: An arrangement whereby an insolvent company can continue trading under supervision.
administration.zh: 该公司上周进入自愿托管。

administration.en: The administration is jumping back from that message.
administration.zh: 政府正在从这一信息中跳出来。

administration.en: The antidrug administration cracked down on cocaine sales.
administration.zh: 禁毒管理局严厉打击可卡因销售。

south.gloss: The direction towards the pole to the right-hand side of someone facing east, specifically 180°, or (on another celestial object) the direction towards the pole lying on the southern side of the invariable plane.

husband.en: Her German husband has blond hair.
husband.zh: 她的德国丈夫有一头金发。

husband.en: George is a loyal and loving husband.
husband.zh: 乔治是一位忠诚而充满爱心的丈夫。

husband.en: I hereby declare you husband and wife.
husband.zh: 我特此宣布你们为夫妻。

congress.gloss: A congress is a formal meeting that is held to discuss or decide on a specific question.
(often capitalized: Congress) A Congress is a legislative body of a state.

congress.en: We congressed in the meeting room.
congress.gloss: If you congress with some people, you meet with them.

congress.en: He pitched his budget proposal to Congress.
congress.gloss: The two legislative bodies of the United States: the House of Representatives and the Senate.
congress.zh: 他向国会提交了预算提案。

floor.zh: 不要把抛光地板蹭出划痕。

floor.en: Geometrical patterns adorn the tiled floor.
floor.zh: 几何图案装饰着瓷砖地面。

floor.en: Polygonal shapes cover the tiled floor.
floor.zh: 多边形图形覆盖着瓷砖地面。

floor.en: The room has a wooden floor.
floor.gloss: The interior bottom or surface of a house or building; the supporting surface of a room.
The largest integer less than or equal to a given number.

floor.en: We were floored by his confession.
floor.zh: 他的坦白让我们大吃一惊。

campaign.zh: 这位废奴主义者开展了反对奴隶制的运动。

campaign.en: The campaign will disseminate health information.
campaign.zh: 这次活动将传播健康信息。

campaign.en: Her idealism inspired a nonviolent campaign.
campaign.zh: 她的理想主义激发了一场非暴力运动。

campaign.en: She campaigned for better social security.
campaign.gloss: To take part in a campaign.
campaign.zh: 她致力于改善社会保障。

campaign.en: His campaign for Hampshire was very good.
campaign.gloss: A player or team's efforts during a sporting season.
campaign.zh: 他在汉普郡的竞选活动非常出色。

material.zh: 这种颗粒状材料吸收水分。

material.en: Material stiffness determines resistance to bending.
material.zh: 材料刚度决定其抗弯能力。

material.en: You've made several material contributions to this project.
material.gloss: Having real importance or great consequences; significant; substantial.
material.zh: 您为本项目做出了多项物质贡献。

material.en: The material of his character was basically good.
material.gloss: The elements, constituents or substance of which something physical or non-physical composed of or can be made of.
material.zh: 他的角色素材基本上是好的。

population.en: The war caused massive population displacement.
population.zh: 战争导致了大规模的人口流离失所。

population.en: Demography examines population size and composition.
population.zh: 人口学研究人口规模和构成。

population.en: The group contains a heterogeneous student population.
population.zh: 这个团体包含背景各异的学生。

population.gloss: A count of the number of residents within a political or geographical boundary such as a town, a nation or the world.

economy.en: Shipbuilding supports the region's maritime economy.
economy.zh: 造船业支撑着该地区的海洋经济。

economy.en: The abolition of slavery transformed the economy.
economy.zh: 废除奴隶制改变了经济。

economy.gloss: Cheap to run; using minimal resources; representing good value for money; economical.
economy.zh: 他买了一辆经济型轿车。

medical.en: Recurrent headaches prompted a medical examination.
medical.zh: 反复头痛促使他去做了医学检查。

medical.en: The patient required tertiary medical care.
medical.zh: 这位病人需要三级医疗服务。

medical.en: The old medical account describes a distent abdomen.
medical.zh: 旧医学记述描述了腹部膨胀。

medical.en: Do you have any medical experience?
medical.gloss: Of or pertaining to the practice of medicine.

hospital.en: Her philanthropic bequest supported the local hospital.
hospital.zh: 她的慈善遗赠资助了当地医院。

hospital.en: His bequest funded a new hospital ward.
hospital.zh: 他的遗赠资助建成了一间新病房。

church.en: The church occupies a position of prominence.
church.zh: 这座教堂位于显眼的位置。

church.en: The modern chair looked incongruous in church.
church.zh: 这把现代椅子在教堂里显得不协调。

church.en: The church choir practices Thursday nights.
church.zh: 教堂唱诗班周四晚上练习。

church.en: These worshippers make up the Church of Christ.
church.gloss: Christians collectively seen as a single spiritual community; Christianity; Christendom.
church.zh: 这些崇拜者组成了基督教会。

close.en: The clubs maintain close fraternal relations.
close.zh: 这些俱乐部保持着亲密友好的关系。

close.en: The cabal met behind closed doors.
Enrolment closes at the end of September.
close.zh: 入学登记在九月底截止。

close.gloss: To remove or block an opening, gap or passage through.; To move a thing, or part of a thing, nearer to another so that the gap or opening between the two is removed.
To make or become non-operational or unavailable for use.; To cease operation or cease to be available.
close.zh: 我们的选择很快就结束了。

close.gloss: Having little difference or distance in place, position, or abstractly; see also close to.; Almost, but not quite (getting to an answer, goal, or other state); near.

risk.en: Heedless driving puts other people at risk.
risk.zh: 不留心驾驶会使他人面临风险。

risk.en: Strict inspections reduce the risk of adulteration.
risk.zh: 严格检查降低了掺假风险。

risk.en: Those stairs are a major risk.
risk.gloss: A thing (from the perspective of how likely or unlikely it is to cause an adverse effect).
risk.zh: 这些楼梯是一个重大风险。

thousand.en: One kilowatt equals one thousand watts.
The company earned fifty thousand dollars last month.
thousand.gloss: A numerical value equal to 1,000; ten times a hundred (1 E+3 exactly—in scientific E notation)
thousand.zh: 该公司上个月赚了五万美元。

current.en: The insulator prevents current from escaping.
The current measured exactly one ampere.
current.zh: 测得的电流恰好为一安培。

current.en: The converter changes alternating current into direct current.
current.zh: 这个转换器把交流电变成直流电。

current.gloss: Something that is current is up to date.

current.en: It has a current of nine amperes.
There is a strong current in that water.
current.gloss: Current is movement in a fluid.
current.zh: 那水中有一股强大的水流。

fire.en: The kiln fires clay at high temperatures.
fire.zh: 这座窑在高温下烧制黏土。

fire.en: We dominated the battlespace with our fires.
fire.gloss: A planned bombardment by artillery or similar weapons, or the capability to deliver such.
fire.zh: 我们用火力统治了战场。

fire.en: When a neuron fires, it transmits information.
fire.gloss: To cause an action potential in a cell.
fire.zh: 当神经元放电时，它会传输信息。

fire.en: I fired on that train until August.
fire.gloss: To work as a fireman, one who keeps the fire under a steam boiler on a steam-powered ship or train.
fire.zh: 我在那列火车上开枪直到八月。

future.en: The momentous decision changed their future.
future.zh: 这个重大决定改变了他们的未来。

future.en: We are facing an uncertain future.
future.zh: 我们面临着一个不确定的未来。

future.en: She has a bright future ahead.

wrong.gloss: In a way that isn't right; incorrectly, wrongly.
Something that is immoral or not good.
wrong.zh: 不公正是令人发指的错误。

wrong.en: Something is wrong with my cellphone.

involve.en: My job involves forecasting economic trends.
involve.gloss: To have (something) as a component or a related part; to comprise, to include.
involve.zh: 我的工作涉及预测经济趋势。

involve.en: Many English folk etymologies involve backronyms.
involve.zh: 许多英语民间词源都涉及反义词。

involve.en: Some speech errors involve consonant misorderings.
involve.zh: 一些言语错误涉及辅音顺序错误。

defense.zh: 辩护人休息了，法官大人。

defense.en: Their defense ranked third in the league.
defense.zh: 他们的防守排名联盟第三。

defense.en: Airplanes attacked the Ministry of Defense in Tehran.
defense.gloss: Defense is the process of protecting.
defense.zh: 飞机袭击了德黑兰国防部。

behavior.en: Optics explains the behavior of light.
The study examines mammalian reproductive behavior.
behavior.zh: 这项研究考察哺乳动物的繁殖行为。

behavior.en: Parents inculcate values through everyday behavior.
behavior.zh: 父母通过日常行为灌输价值观。

anyone.en: His glib explanation failed to convince anyone.
anyone.zh: 他油嘴滑舌的解释没能说服任何人。

anyone.en: His insipid speech failed to interest anyone.
anyone.zh: 他平淡乏味的演讲没能引起任何人的兴趣。

anyone.en: The teacher refused to call anyone a dunce.
anyone.zh: 老师拒绝称任何人是笨蛋。

anyone.en: Almost anyone can change a light bulb.
anyone.zh: 几乎任何人都可以更换灯泡。

increase.zh: 这颗恒星的光度显著增加了。

increase.en: Lateral movement increases traction on slopes.
increase.zh: 横向移动会增加斜坡上的抓地力。

increase.en: The increase is proportional to demand.
increase.zh: 增长幅度与需求成正比。

increase.gloss: To become more nearly full; to show more of the surface; to wax.

security.en: Thriftless habits can undermine financial security.
security.zh: 挥霍的习惯可能损害财务保障。

security.en: Better security reduced pilferage from the warehouse.
security.zh: 更好的安保减少了仓库失窃。

security.gloss: An organization or department responsible for providing security by enforcing laws, rules, and regulations as well as maintaining order.

myself.zh: 我通过冥想让自己扎根。

myself.en: I myself have witnessed the event.
myself.gloss: Personally, for my part; used in apposition to I, sometimes for simple emphasis and sometimes with implicit exclusion of any others performing the activity described.
myself.zh: 我本人亲眼目睹了这一事件。

myself.gloss: In my normal state of body or mind.
myself.zh: 我感觉就像我自己一样。

myself.en: Give the ball to John or myself.
myself.gloss: Me, as the object of a verb or preposition without a reflexive trigger. Sometimes used for intensifying the pronoun of oneself.
myself.zh: 把球交给约翰或我自己。

bank.en: We sat on the river bank.
She banks her savings every month.
bank.zh: 她每月把积蓄存入银行。

bank.en: You can bank on my help.

certainly.en: That was certainly sweet of him.
I certainly can't sing that high.
She's certainly taken a shine to you.

west.en: They rode the trades going west.
west.zh: 他们乘着贸易往西行进。

west.en: Portugal lies to the west of Spain.
west.gloss: The direction opposite to that of the earth's rotation, specifically 270°.
west.zh: 葡萄牙位于西班牙西部。

sport.zh: 皮划艇是奥林匹克运动项目。
网球不是一项花哨的运动。

sport.en: Slalom is her strongest Olympic sport.
sport.zh: 回转是她最强的奥运项目。

board.en: Who heads the board of trustees?
The chalk grated against the board.
board.zh: 粉笔在木板上发出摩擦声。

board.en: The board retired the old major.
It is time to board the aircraft.
board.gloss: To step or climb onto or otherwise enter a ship, aircraft, train or other conveyance.

seek.en: Fatalism discouraged him from seeking redress.
seek.zh: 宿命论使他不愿寻求补救。

seek.en: They sought requital for the injury.
seek.zh: 他们为所受伤害寻求报偿。

seek.en: The mediator sought an end to strife.

seek.gloss: To try to find; to look for; to search for.

seek.en: I sought my fortune on the goldfields.
seek.gloss: To try to acquire or gain; to strive after.

per.en: They compared energy consumption per capita.
per.zh: 他们比较了人均能源消耗。

per.en: Income per capita increased after the reform.
per.zh: 改革后，人均收入提高了。

per.en: The region uses less water per capita.
per.zh: 该地区的人均用水量较少。
入场费为每人 10 英镑。

per.gloss: By the, through the (with name of body part in Latin).

subject.en: She treated the subject with playful irreverence.
subject.zh: 她以俏皮而不拘敬意的态度对待这个话题。

subject.en: Her limpid prose clarified the abstruse subject.
subject.zh: 她清晰的文字阐明了深奥的话题。
她最喜欢的科目是物理。

subject.en: Menu listings and prices are subject to change.
subject.gloss: Likely to be affected by or to experience something; liable.
subject.zh: 菜单列表和价格可能会发生变化。

officer.en: The officer unlocked the prisoner's manacle.
officer.zh: 警员打开了囚犯的手铐。
一名军官背叛了这座城市。

officer.en: The immigration officer stamped my passport.
officer.zh: 移民官在我的护照上盖了章。

officer.en: A soldier must obey his commanding officer.
officer.gloss: An officer is a person in an army who has much authority. A general and a captain are two types of officers.
officer.zh: 士兵必须服从他的指挥官。

officer.en: He was arrested for hitting an officer.
officer.gloss: An officer is a policeman, often called a "police officer." (Note, "officer" is often better than "policeman" because the officer could be a woman or a man.)
officer.zh: 他因殴打一名警官而被捕。

private.en: This book is her private journal.
private.gloss: Relating to an individual or group of individuals outside of their official roles; often, sensitive or personal.
private.zh: 这本书是她的私人日记。

private.en: Can we go somewhere more private?
private.gloss: Protected from view or disturbance by others; secluded; not publicly accessible.
private.zh: 我们可以去更私密的地方吗？

private.en: He is a very private person.
private.zh: 他是一个非常注重隐私的人。

rest.en: Please recline the seat before resting.
rest.zh: 休息前请把座椅向后放倒。

rest.en: The flounder rested on the sandy seabed.
rest.zh: 这条比目鱼停在沙质海底上。

rest.en: The interlude gave the musicians a rest.
rest.zh: 幕间休息让音乐家们歇了一会儿。

rest.gloss: To complete one's active advocacy in a trial or other proceeding, and thus to wait for the outcome (however, one is still generally available to answer questions, etc.)
rest.zh: 辩护人休息了，法官大人。

rest.en: The ocean was finally at rest.
rest.gloss: A state of inactivity; a state of little or no motion; a state of completion.

deal.gloss: To distribute cards to the players in a game.
To handle, to manage, to cope.
The distribution of cards to players; a player's turn for this.

deal.en: He made a deal with the devil.
deal.gloss: An agreement between parties; an arrangement.
deal.zh: 他与恶魔做了一笔交易。

deal.en: I don't think that's such a big deal.
deal.zh: 我认为这没什么大不了的。

performance.en: An impromptu performance delighted the guests.
performance.zh: 一场即兴表演使宾客们十分高兴。

performance.en: The performance will enthral the audience.
performance.zh: 这场表演会令观众着迷。

performance.en: The performance will enrapture music lovers.
performance.zh: 这场演出会使音乐爱好者陶醉。

fight.en: The kingdom fought for maritime supremacy.
fight.zh: 这个王国争夺海上霸权。

fight.en: The government pledged to fight corruption.
fight.gloss: To try to overpower; to fiercely counteract.

throw.en: The teens were throwing gang signs.
throw.gloss: To make a shape or gesture with the hands.
throw.zh: 青少年们扔着帮派标语。

throw.en: The pitcher threw a perfect game.
throw.gloss: (of a game where one’s role is throwing something) To perform in a specified way in (a match).
throw.zh: 投手投出了一场完美的比赛。

throw.en: He’s always had a pretty decent throw.
throw.zh: 他的投球总是相当不错。

throw.en: With an accurate throw, he lassoed the cow.
throw.zh: 他准确地一扔，套住了牛。

throw.en: The deliberate red herring threw me at first.
throw.zh: 起初，我故意转移注意力。

top.gloss: The highest or uppermost part of something.; A garment worn to cover the torso.
Very good, of high quality, power, or rank.

top.en: Stand on top and look down.
We flipped the machine onto its top.
top.gloss: The highest or uppermost part of something.; The part of something that is usually highest or uppermost.
top.zh: 我们把机器翻转到顶部。

top.en: Headings appear at the tops of pages.
top.gloss: The highest or uppermost part of something.; The uppermost part of a page, picture, viewing screen, etc.

top.en: Depression causes many people to top themselves.
top.zh: 抑郁症导致许多人自我超越。

quickly.zh: 一切都进行得快得可怕。

democratic.zh: 西班牙裔选民的选票倾向于民主党。

democratic.en: Freedom of speech is a basic democratic value.
democratic.zh: 言论自由是基本的民主价值观。

check.en: The editor scrupulously checked every citation.
check.zh: 编辑认真仔细地核查了每一处引文。

check.en: The packer checks items before shipment.
check.zh: 包装工在装运前检查物品。

check.en: The engineer checked for refrigerant leakage.
check.zh: 工程师检查了制冷剂是否泄漏。

check.en: Check your enthusiasm during a negotiation.
check.zh: 在谈判过程中检查你的热情。

check.en: Check your data against known values.
check.gloss: To verify or compare with a source of information.
check.zh: 根据已知值检查您的数据。

check.gloss: To make checks or chinks in; to cause to crack.

environment.en: His nonconformity challenged the regimented environment.
environment.zh: 他不墨守成规的态度挑战了整齐划一的环境。

environment.en: The excitable dog needed a quiet environment.
environment.zh: 这只容易兴奋的狗需要安静的环境。

environment.en: This is a poisoned work environment.
environment.zh: 这是一个有毒的工作环境。

environment.en: That program uses the Microsoft Windows environment.
environment.gloss: The software or hardware existing on any particular computer system.
environment.zh: 该程序使用 Microsoft Windows 环境。

leg.gloss: A limb or appendage that an animal uses for support or locomotion on land.

leg.en: The vicious tackle corked his leg.
leg.zh: 凶狠的铲球堵住了他的腿。

dark.zh: 乌云预示着又一阵狂风。
乌云凶险地在头顶聚集。

dark.gloss: A complete or (more often) partial absence of light.

dark.en: We kept him in the dark.
The room was too dark for reading.
dark.gloss: Having an absolute or (more often) relative lack of light.
dark.zh: 房间太暗了，不适合看书。

various.gloss: More than one (of an indeterminate set of things).

various.zh: 多种真菌可以分解木材。

various.gloss: Having a broad range (of different elements).

rather.en: The negotiator relied on patience rather than guile.
rather.zh: 这位谈判者依靠耐心，而非诡计。

rather.en: The debate concerned aesthetical rather than practical values.
rather.zh: 这场辩论涉及审美价值，而非实用价值。

rather.en: We had some rather worse news today.
rather.gloss: Somewhat, quite; to an unexpected degree.
rather.zh: 今天我们有一些更糟糕的消息。

rather.en: They'd rather've spent the money on a holiday.
rather.gloss: Used to specify a choice or preference; preferably, in preference to. (Now usually followed by than)
rather.zh: 他们宁愿把钱花在度假上。

laugh.en: The children laughed gaily during the procession.
laugh.zh: 孩子们在游行期间欢快地笑着。

laugh.en: Laugh in the face of adversity.
His deep laughs boomed through the room.
laugh.gloss: An expression of mirth particular to the human species; the sound heard in laughing; laughter.
laugh.zh: 他低沉的笑声在房间里回荡。

laugh.en: Don't laugh at my new hat, man!
laugh.gloss: To make an object of laughter or ridicule; to make fun of; to deride; to mock.

guess.gloss: To solve by a correct conjecture; to conjecture rightly.

guess.en: I could guess her unvoiced opinon.
guess.zh: 我可以猜到她无声的意见。

guess.en: But I guess that's life, y'know?
guess.zh: 但我想这就是生活，你知道吗？

executive.en: There are several existing limits to executive power.
executive.zh: 行政权力存在一些现有限制。

executive.en: That executive tackles problems right when they start.
executive.zh: 这位高管在问题一开始就解决问题。

executive.en: The executive pay gap is opening up again.
executive.zh: 高管薪酬差距再次拉大。

prove.zh: 她合乎常识的建议很有用。
所承诺的解决方案被证明虚幻不实。

prove.en: These documents purport to prove ownership.
prove.zh: 这些文件声称能证明所有权。

prove.gloss: To put to the test, to make trial of.

prove.en: It proved to be a cold day.
prove.zh: 事实证明这是一个寒冷的日子。

prove.en: The hope that he’d react proved utterly unfounded.
prove.zh: 希望他做出反应的希望被证明是完全没有根据的。

hang.en: Hang the wet mackintosh near the door.
Dripstone formations hang from the cave ceiling.
The weaverbird built an intricate hanging nest.
hang.zh: 这只织巢鸟筑了一个精巧的悬巢。

hang.gloss: An instance of ceasing to respond to input.
hang.zh: 我们有时会遇到系统挂起的情况。

hang.gloss: The smallest amount of concern or consideration; a damn.

hang.en: Hang those lights from the ceiling.
hang.gloss: To cause (something) to be suspended, as from a hook, hanger, hinges, or the like.
hang.zh: 把这些灯挂在天花板上。

entire.en: The cataclysm altered the entire landmass.
entire.zh: 这场灾变改变了整块陆地。

entire.en: Her rendition enraptured the entire audience.
entire.zh: 她的演绎使全体观众如痴如醉。

entire.en: His effrontery astonished the entire subcommittee.
entire.zh: 他的厚颜无耻使整个小组委员会震惊。

rock.en: Limestone forms a porous rock layer.
rock.zh: 石灰岩形成了多孔的岩层。

rock.en: Lichen grows on the exposed rocks.
rock.zh: 地衣生长在裸露的岩石上。

rock.en: Cooling magma eventually solidifies into rock.
rock.zh: 冷却的岩浆最终凝固成岩石。

rock.gloss: To move gently back and forth.
To sway or tilt violently back and forth.

forget.gloss: Euphemism for fuck, screw (a mild oath).
forget.zh: 忘了这个吧，我已经完成了！

forget.en: He forgot having already visited this city.
forget.zh: 他忘记了自己已经来过这座城市了。

claim.en: Credulous readers accepted the fallacious claim.
claim.zh: 轻信的读者接受了这个错误说法。

claim.en: This claim remains a source of contention.
claim.zh: 这一说法仍是争论的起因。

claim.en: A preponderance of evidence supports the claim.
claim.zh: 占优势的证据支持这一主张。
一场大火烧毁了两所房屋。

claim.en: He claimed $100 after winning the top spot.
claim.gloss: To win as a prize in a sport or competition.
claim.zh: 赢得第一名后，他获得了 100 美元奖金。

remove.zh: 水净化去除有害污染物。

remove.en: Guests customarily remove their shoes here.
remove.zh: 客人在这里通常会脱鞋。

remove.en: Remove the outermost wrapping before use.
remove.zh: 使用前去掉最外层包装。

remove.gloss: To dismiss or discharge (someone) from an official position or office.
remove.zh: 总统罢免了许多邮政局长。

remove.en: He removed the marbles from the bag.
remove.gloss: To move from one place to another, especially to take away.

manager.en: The manager reprimanded him for insubordinate conduct.
manager.zh: 经理因他不服从管理的行为训斥了他。

manager.en: The manager investigated repeated incidents of pilferage.
manager.zh: 经理调查了反复发生的小额盗窃。

enjoy.en: They enjoyed a convivial evening together.
enjoy.zh: 他们一起度过了一个欢乐的夜晚。

enjoy.en: They enjoyed an occasional evening tipple.
enjoy.zh: 他们偶尔在晚上喝一杯。

enjoy.en: The theater enjoyed its heyday decades ago.
enjoy.zh: 这家剧院的鼎盛时期在几十年前。

enjoy.gloss: To be satisfied or receive pleasure; to have fun.

network.zh: 这个网络具有很强的互联性。

network.en: A network of roads crisscrossed the country.
These criminals operate through an underground network.
network.zh: 这些犯罪分子通过地下网络进行活动。

legal.en: Company incorporation requires several legal documents.
legal.zh: 公司注册需要若干法律文件。

legal.en: Legal safeguards circumscribe the autocrat's power.
legal.zh: 法律保障限制了独裁者的权力。

legal.en: The judge cited a familiar legal dictum.
legal.zh: 法官引用了一条常见的法律格言。

legal.gloss: The legal department of a company or organization.

religious.en: Theological debate shaped this religious revival.
religious.zh: 神学辩论影响了这次宗教复兴。

religious.en: The iconographic details suggest religious symbolism.
religious.zh: 这些图像学细节暗示着宗教象征意义。

religious.en: Religious observance shaped the town's daily life.
religious.zh: 宗教仪式影响了小镇的日常生活。

cold.en: The material remains rubbery when cold.
cold.zh: 这种材料低温下仍像橡胶一样有弹性。

cold.en: Cold springwater helped slake their thirst.
cold.zh: 清凉的泉水帮助他们解渴。

cold.en: Water vapour condensed on the cold glass.
cold.zh: 水蒸气在冰冷的玻璃上凝结了。

cold.gloss: Unconscious or deeply asleep; deprived of the metaphorical heat associated with life or consciousness.

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

final.en: The provisional agreement awaits final approval.
final.zh: 这份临时协议正等待最终批准。

final.en: Her vacillation delayed the final decision.
final.zh: 她的犹豫不决拖延了最终决定。

final.en: Reservior has its final vowels reversed.
final.zh: Reservior把词尾的两个元音颠倒了。

main.en: Her main contention concerns the evidence.
main.zh: 她的主要论点涉及证据。

main.en: Supplementary exercises reinforce the main lesson.
main.zh: 补充练习巩固了主要课程内容。

main.en: Her succinct summary clarified the main argument.
main.zh: 她简洁的概述阐明了主要论点。

main.en: His main got banned after his last post.
main.gloss: That which is chief or principal; the chief or main portion; the bulk, the greater part, gross.; A main account.
main.zh: 他的主力在他上一篇文章后就被禁止了。

science.en: Dietetics applies nutrition science to daily eating.
science.zh: 营养学把营养科学应用于日常饮食。

science.en: His contributions to science went unnoted.
science.zh: 他对科学的贡献并未引起人们的注意。

green.en: A grasshopper landed on the green leaf.
green.zh: 一只蚱蜢落在了绿叶上。
我们正在把绿色海洋带上船。

green.en: He is wearing a green shirt.

memory.en: Her prodigious memory impressed the academician.
memory.zh: 她惊人的记忆力令那位院士赞叹。

memory.en: She has a remarkably retentive memory.
memory.zh: 她的记忆保持力非常出色。

memory.en: He aptly compared memory to a library.
memory.zh: 他恰当地把记忆比作图书馆。

memory.en: I have no memory of that event.
memory.gloss: A record of a thing or an event stored and available for later use by an organism.

memory.en: Memory is a facility common to all animals.
memory.gloss: The ability of the brain to record information or impressions with the facility of recalling them later, usually at will.
memory.zh: 记忆是所有动物共有的一种能力。

card.en: He played cards with his friends.
card.gloss: Any game using playing cards; a card game.

card.en: He accused them of playing the race card.
card.gloss: A resource or argument, used to achieve a purpose. (See play the something card.)

above.en: An osprey hovered above the river.
above.zh: 一只鱼鹰在河流上方盘旋。

above.en: The chromosphere lies above the solar photosphere.
above.zh: 色球层位于太阳光球层上方。

above.gloss: Higher than; superior to in any respect; surpassing; higher in measure, degree, volume, or pitch, etc. than; out of reach; not exposed to; not likely to be affected by; incapable of negative actions or thoughts.

above.en: He appealed to the court above.
above.gloss: Higher in rank, power, or position.
above.zh: 他向上述法院提出上诉。

above.en: That amount is way above our asking price.
above.gloss: Surpassing in number or quantity; more than.
above.zh: 这个金额远远高于我们的要价。

seat.en: Please recline the seat before resting.
seat.zh: 休息前请把座椅向后放倒。

seat.en: The passengers drowsed in their reclining seats.
seat.zh: 乘客们在斜放的座位上打盹。

seat.en: Please buckle your seat belt before departure.

seat.gloss: To cause to occupy a post, site, or situation; to station; to establish; to fix; to settle.

seat.en: This classroom seats two hundred students.
seat.gloss: To provide with a place to sit.
seat.zh: 这间教室可容纳两百名学生。

seat.en: There are two hundred seats in this classroom.
seat.gloss: Something to be sat upon.; A place in which to sit.
seat.zh: 这间教室有两百个座位。

cell.zh: 这种组织含有未分化的细胞。

cell.en: Explain the process whereby cells divide.
Mammalian cells require suitable growth conditions.
cell.zh: 哺乳动物细胞需要合适的生长条件。

cell.en: The combatants spent the night in separate cells.
cell.gloss: A room in a prison or jail for one or more inmates.
cell.zh: 战斗人员在不同的牢房里过夜。

cell.en: This MP3 player runs on 2 AAA cells.
cell.gloss: A device which stores electrical power; used either singly or together in batteries; the basic unit of a battery.
cell.zh: 这款 MP3 播放器使用 2 节 AAA 电池运行。

establish.en: His subversive humor challenged established conventions.
establish.zh: 他颠覆性的幽默挑战了既定惯例。

establish.en: The act transgressed established social conventions.
establish.zh: 这种行为违背了既定的社会惯例。

establish.en: Anecdotal evidence cannot establish a causal relationship.
establish.zh: 轶闻证据无法确立因果关系。

nice.en: The soup is nice and hot.
nice.gloss: Shows that the given adjective is desirable, or acts as a mild intensifier; pleasantly, quite.

nice.en: You weren’t nice to me this morning.

trial.en: The exclusion of evidence changed the trial.
trial.zh: 这项证据被排除，改变了审判进程。

trial.gloss: An occasion on which a person or thing is tested to find out how well they perform or how suitable they are.; A research study to test the effectiveness and safety of a drug, medical procedure, etc.

trial.en: That boy was a trial to his parents.
trial.gloss: A difficult or annoying experience or person; (especially religion) such an experience seen as a test of faith and piety.
trial.zh: 那个男孩对他的父母来说是一个考验。

expert.zh: 这个问题需要专业知识。
大卫是一位计算机专家。
她是一位定向运动专家。

expert.en: My cousin is an expert pianist.
expert.zh: 我的表弟是一位专业钢琴家。

spring.en: They whitewash the walls each spring.
spring.zh: 他们每年春天都用石灰水刷墙。

spring.en: The flock migrated northwards in spring.
spring.zh: 这群鸟在春天向北迁徙。

spring.en: Spring brings the emergence of new leaves.

spring.gloss: To move or burst forth.; To be born, descend, or originate from
To deform owing to excessive pressure, to become warped; to intentionally deform in order to position and then straighten in place.
To cause to spring (all senses).; To cause to work or open by sudden application of pressure.

firm.en: Those kids need a firm hand.
firm.zh: 这些孩子需要强有力的帮助。

firm.en: She studied accountancy before joining a firm.
firm.zh: 在加入一家公司之前，她学习了会计专业。

democrat.zh: 他是一位中间路线的民主党人。
民主党人和共和党人共同努力。

radio.en: The old radio worked only sporadically.
radio.zh: 那台旧收音机只是偶尔能正常工作。

radio.en: Radio waves interact with the ionosphere.
radio.zh: 无线电波与电离层相互作用。

radio.en: Radio interference caused a deviation in readings.
radio.zh: 无线电干扰导致读数偏差。

radio.en: We heard the news over the radio.
radio.gloss: A device that can capture (receive) the signal sent over radio waves and render the modulated signal as sound.
radio.zh: 我们通过广播听到了这个消息。

visit.en: We visited a venerable old temple.
visit.zh: 我们参观了一座古老而庄严的寺庙。

visit.en: The landscape enraptured the visiting naturalist.
visit.zh: 这片风景使来访的博物学家陶醉。

visit.en: Her gentility impressed the visiting dignitaries.
visit.zh: 她文雅的举止给来访贵宾留下了深刻印象。

visit.en: She decided to visit her grandparents for Christmas.
visit.gloss: To go and meet (a person) as an act of friendliness or sociability.
visit.zh: 她决定圣诞节去看望她的祖父母。

management.en: She studied forestry and environmental management.
management.zh: 她学习林业和环境管理。

management.en: Jones is a likely candidate for management.
management.zh: 琼斯可能是管理层的候选人。

avoid.en: Avoid interference with the control equipment.
She consciously avoided a misleading portrayal.
avoid.zh: 她有意识地避免了误导性的描绘。

avoid.en: An impersonal report avoids subjective judgments.
avoid.zh: 客观的报告避免主观判断。

avoid.gloss: To stay out of the way of (something harmful).
avoid.zh: 我轻松躲过了这一巴掌。

avoid.en: I try to avoid the company of gamblers.
avoid.gloss: To keep away from; to keep clear of; to stay away from.
avoid.zh: 我尽量避免与赌徒为伍。

imagine.zh: 想象一下我们是兄弟姐妹。

imagine.gloss: Used to mock an idea by suggesting that it is ridiculous or ill thought through.
imagine.zh: 想象一下这样的想法会起作用。

imagine.en: Try to imagine a pink elephant.
imagine.gloss: To form a mental image of something; to envision or create something in one's mind.
imagine.zh: 尝试想象一头粉红色的大象。

tonight.en: The station will rebroadcast the concert tonight.
tonight.zh: 电台今晚将重播这场音乐会。

tonight.gloss: During the night following the current day; during the evening of today.

tonight.zh: 老兄，我们今晚会吵架吗？

tonight.gloss: The nighttime of the current day or date; this night.

huge.en: I'm suffocating under this huge workload.
huge.zh: 这么巨大的工作量我快要窒息了。

huge.en: In our league our coach is huge!
huge.zh: 在我们的联赛中，我们的教练是伟大的！

huge.en: He busted huge air off that jump!
huge.zh: 他那次跳跃腾出了巨大的空气！

ball.gloss: To form or wind into a ball.

ball.en: George played his college ball at Stanford.
ball.gloss: An object that is the focus of many sports and games, in which it may be thrown, caught, kicked, bounced, rolled, chased, retrieved, hit with an instrument, spun, etc., usually roughly spherical or ovoid but whose size, weight, bounciness, colour, etc. differ according to the game; Any sport or game involving a ball; its play, literally or figuratively.
ball.zh: 乔治在斯坦福大学打了他的大学舞会。

ball.en: I had a ball at that concert.
ball.zh: 我在那场音乐会上玩得很开心。

yourself.en: Do not overtire yourself during recovery.
yourself.zh: 恢复期间不要过度劳累。
您已经超越了自己——又一个个人最好成绩！

yourself.en: No one understands me like yourself.
yourself.gloss: You (singular); even when "you" has not been used previously; see usage notes.
yourself.zh: 没有人像你一样理解我。

finish.en: The machinist measured the finished workpiece.
finish.zh: 机械加工工人测量了加工完成的工件。

finish.en: The silk has a smooth, lustrous finish.
finish.zh: 这种丝绸表面光滑而有光泽。

finish.en: The French equipe crossed the finish line first.
finish.zh: 法国队率先冲过终点线。

finish.en: These rumours could finish your career.
finish.gloss: To put an end to; to destroy.
finish.zh: 这些谣言可能会终结你的职业生涯。

finish.en: The furniture was finished in teak veneer.
finish.gloss: To apply a treatment to (a surface or similar).

finish.en: The car's finish was so shiny and new.
finish.gloss: A protective coating given to wood or metal and other surfaces.
finish.zh: 这辆车的表面是如此闪亮和崭新。

theory.en: He will expound his theory tomorrow.
theory.zh: 他明天将详细阐述自己的理论。

theory.en: She will propound a new theory tomorrow.
theory.zh: 她明天将提出一种新理论。

theory.en: The theory describes gravitation between massive bodies.
theory.zh: 这个理论描述大质量物体之间的引力。

impact.en: We must quantify the environmental impact.
impact.zh: 我们必须量化环境影响。

impact.gloss: To stamp or impress onto something.

impact.en: The hatchet cut the wood on impact.
impact.gloss: The force or energy of a collision of two objects.
impact.zh: 斧头在撞击时砍断了木头。

impact.en: When the hammer impacts the nail, it bends.
impact.gloss: To collide or strike, the act of impinging.
impact.zh: 当锤子撞击钉子时，钉子就会弯曲。

respond.en: Our bodies respond to our feelings.
respond.zh: 我们的身体会对我们的感受做出反应。

respond.en: Please respond at your earliest convenience.
respond.zh: 请在您方便的时候尽早回复。

respond.en: He didn't respond to my question.

statement.en: Each depositor receives an annual statement.
statement.zh: 每位储户每年都会收到账户结单。

statement.en: Their inflammatory statements fomented further antagonism.
statement.zh: 他们煽动性的言论激起了更多敌意。

statement.en: Use the indicative mood for factual statements.
statement.zh: 陈述事实时使用陈述语气。

statement.en: I don't agree with that statement.
statement.gloss: A statement is a claim someone makes that is true or false.

maintain.en: The villages maintained a tenuous connection.
maintain.zh: 这些村庄维持着微弱的联系。

maintain.en: She maintained a semblance of calm.
maintain.zh: 她保持着表面上的镇静。

maintain.en: Workers maintained the hatchery's water supply.
maintain.zh: 工人们维护了孵化场的供水系统。

maintain.en: No matter what, you gotta maintain.
maintain.gloss: To keep composed; to keep one's head up; to stay confident, strong, self-assured; to avoid being a victim; to keep oneself from falling apart.
maintain.zh: 不管怎么样，一定要坚持。

maintain.en: She struggled to maintain her composure under pressure.
maintain.gloss: To keep up; to preserve; to uphold (a state, condition etc.).
maintain.zh: 她在压力下努力保持镇定。

charge.en: They charge ten dollars for delivery.
charge.zh: 他们收取十美元配送费。

charge.en: I need to charge my phone.
She is in charge of sales.
The battery holds an electrical charge.

popular.en: The old story remains perennially popular.
popular.zh: 这个古老的故事一直广受欢迎。
电子学是一门热门学科。
大豆是一种受欢迎的油料作物。

traditional.zh: 这个展览展示了传统针线工艺。

traditional.en: He prefers traditional, sometimes stodgy food.
traditional.zh: 他偏爱传统、有时偏厚重的食物。

traditional.en: The clergy performed a traditional religious rite.
traditional.zh: 神职人员举行了传统的宗教仪式。

traditional.gloss: Of, relating to, or derived from tradition.; Observant of tradition; old-fashioned.
traditional.zh: 她的传统价值观已经过时了。

onto.en: She splashed water onto her face.
The car eased onto the motorway.
onto.zh: 汽车缓缓驶上高速公路。

onto.en: The egg splatted onto the floor.
My cat just jumped onto the keyboard.
onto.gloss: Arriving upon or on top of (speaking of a physical or metaphorical movement).
onto.zh: 我的猫刚刚跳到键盘上。

reveal.zh: 她无动于衷的表情没有透露任何情绪。

reveal.en: His wan face revealed his exhaustion.
reveal.zh: 他苍白的脸显露出他的疲惫。

reveal.en: Better screening revealed its true prevalence.
reveal.zh: 更好的筛查揭示了它的真实流行程度。

reveal.en: The actress won't reveal how old she is.
reveal.gloss: make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized
