direction.en: Adventitious circumstances altered the project's direction.
direction.zh: 偶然情况改变了项目的方向。

direction.en: Keep going in the same direction.
direction.gloss: A theoretical line (physically or mentally) followed from a point of origin or towards a destination. May be relative (e.g. up, left, outbound, dorsal), geographical (e.g. north), rotational (e.g. clockwise), or with respect to an object or location (e.g. toward Boston).
direction.zh: 继续朝同一个方向前进。

direction.en: Door swing indicates direction the door opens.
direction.zh: 门摆动指示门打开的方向。

direction.en: The trombonist looked to the bandleader for direction.
direction.zh: 长号手向乐队指挥寻求方向。

weapon.en: A depth charge is an antisubmarine weapon.
weapon.zh: 深水炸弹是一种反潜武器。

weapon.en: Money is the main weapon of modern oligarchs.
weapon.gloss: An instrument or other means of harming or exerting control over another.
weapon.zh: 金钱是现代寡头的主要武器。

employee.en: New employees attend an induction course.
employee.zh: 新员工参加入职培训课程。

employee.en: No employee should feel merely dispensable.
employee.zh: 任何员工都不应觉得自己可有可无。

contain.zh: 这部影片中有不必要的暴力内容。
这种组织含有未分化的细胞。
这盘录像带包含档案影像。

contain.en: Most of the meals they offer contain meat.
contain.zh: 他们提供的大部分餐点都含有肉类。

contain.en: I'm so excited, I can hardly contain myself!
contain.gloss: To put constraints upon; to restrain; to confine; to keep within bounds.
contain.zh: 我太兴奋了，简直无法自抑！

cultural.en: The cultural milieu shaped his artistic outlook.
cultural.zh: 文化环境塑造了他的艺术观。
文化灭绝先于物质灭绝。

cultural.en: The city’s cultural vitality impressed the visitors.
cultural.zh: 这座城市的文化活力给游客留下了深刻的印象。

peace.en: They regarded peace as a favorable auspice.
He made an impassioned plea for peace.
The confederacy negotiated a new peace treaty.
peace.zh: 这个联盟谈成了一项新的和平条约。

peace.en: May there be peace in our time.
peace.gloss: A state free of war, in particular war between different countries.

pain.en: Your mother is a right pain.
pain.zh: 你妈妈真是个痛苦的人。

pain.gloss: To hurt; to put to bodily uneasiness or anguish; to afflict with uneasy sensations of any degree of intensity; to torment; to torture.

pain.en: Please help me: I am paining hard.
The pain of departure was difficult to bear.
pain.gloss: The condition or fact of suffering or anguish especially mental, as opposed to pleasure; torment; distress
pain.zh: 离开的痛苦是难以承受的。

apply.en: Everyone may apply, irrespective of age.
apply.zh: 无论年龄大小，所有人都可以申请。

apply.en: The rule applies irrespective of nationality.
apply.zh: 这条规定不受国籍影响，普遍适用。

apply.en: Apply the cream liberally to dry skin.
apply.zh: 把乳霜充分涂抹在干燥皮肤上。

apply.en: That rule only applies to foreigners.

wide.en: These changes may presage a wider recovery.

wide.en: We walked down a wide corridor.
wide.gloss: Having a large physical extent from side to side.

wide.gloss: Operating at the side of the playing area.

measure.zh: 这项测试衡量听觉理解能力。

measure.gloss: A prescribed quantity or extent.; A limit that cannot be exceeded; a bound. (Now chiefly in set phrases.)

measure.en: The window measured two square feet.
measure.gloss: To be of (a certain size), to have (a certain measurement).
To estimate the unit size of something.

shake.gloss: To lose, evade, or get rid of (something).
shake.zh: 没有什么能够动摇他的信念。
好吧，让我们来讨论一下。

shake.gloss: To cause (something) to move rapidly in opposite directions alternatingly.

shake.en: Her father’s death shook her terribly.
shake.zh: 父亲的去世对她造成了极大的震撼。

shake.gloss: To move from side to side.

shake.en: The experience shook my religious belief.
shake.zh: 这次经历动摇了我的宗教信仰。

fly.en: The flock flew southwards before winter.
fly.zh: 这群鸟在入冬前向南飞去。

fly.gloss: To wave or flutter; to cause to wave or flutter.; To display (a flag) on a flagpole; to be displayed on a flagpole.
To drain away or be expended quickly.; To vanish; to fade away.

fly.en: Let's see if that idea flies.
fly.gloss: To travel through the air, another gas, or a vacuum, without being in contact with a grounded surface.; To be accepted, come about or work out.
fly.zh: 让我们看看这个想法是否可行。

fly.en: The probe flew beyond the solar system.
fly.gloss: To travel through the air, another gas, or a vacuum, without being in contact with a grounded surface.

fly.en: She's really letting the freak flag fly.
fly.gloss: To wave or flutter; to cause to wave or flutter.; To display (a flag) on a flagpole; to be displayed on a flagpole.; To proudly and openly make one's allegiances or viewpoint apparent.
fly.zh: 她真的让那面怪异的旗帜飘扬起来。

interview.en: They rebroadcast the interview with added subtitles.
interview.zh: 他们重播了这段采访，并添加了字幕。
这次面试会花很长时间吗？

interview.gloss: To ask questions of (somebody); to have an interview.
To be interviewed; to attend an interview.

interview.en: The reporter gave the witness an interview.
interview.gloss: A conversation in person (or, by extension, over the telephone, Internet etc.) between a journalist and someone whose opinion or statements he or she wishes to record for publication, broadcast etc.
interview.zh: 记者对目击者进行了采访。

manage.zh: 这家子公司负责管理农业径流。

manage.en: They managed to extricate the trapped aviator.
manage.zh: 他们设法救出了被困的飞行员。

manage.en: He managed to climb the tower.
manage.gloss: To succeed at an attempt in spite of difficulty.

manage.en: The government managed the inflation very poorly.

chair.en: An eminent academician chaired the conference.
chair.zh: 一位杰出的院士主持了会议。

chair.en: The modern chair looked incongruous in church.
chair.zh: 这把现代椅子在教堂里显得不协调。

chair.en: The chair allows him to recline fully.
chair.zh: 这把椅子让他可以完全躺下。

chair.gloss: To act as chairperson at; to preside over.

chair.en: Please address all questions through the Chair.
chair.zh: 请通过主席回答所有问题。

chair.en: I sat on my chair to have dinner.
chair.gloss: An item of furniture used to sit on or in, comprising a seat, legs or wheels, back, and sometimes arm rests, for use by one person.

fish.en: The fish's roe contains developing embryos.
fish.zh: 鱼卵中含有发育中的胚胎。

fish.zh: 这条带刺的鱼鼓起了身体。

fish.gloss: A typically cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills; any vertebrate that is not a tetrapod.

fish.en: Why are you fishing through my things?
fish.gloss: To (attempt to) find or get hold of an object by searching among other objects.
fish.zh: 你为什么要翻我的东西？

particular.zh: 其中一件特别有价值的是宝石马赛克。

particular.gloss: Specialised; characteristic of a specific person or thing.

particular.en: These women are more particular about their appearance.

camera.gloss: A machine that records or broadcasts moving pictures.

structure.en: Seismic waves revealed the subterranean structure.
structure.zh: 地震波揭示了地下结构。

structure.en: Interlocking pieces make the structure stable.
structure.zh: 相互咬合的构件使结构稳定。

structure.gloss: The underlying shape of a solid.

structure.gloss: Several pieces of data treated as a unit.

politics.zh: 她一直处于政治活动的边缘。

politics.zh: 这篇文章比较了改良主义与革命政治。

politics.en: He made a career out of politics.
politics.gloss: The profession of conducting political affairs.

bit.gloss: A gag or put-on; a humorous conceit, especially when insistently presented as true.

bit.en: She acted her bit in the opening scene.

suddenly.en: They've suddenly decided to sell the house.
suddenly.gloss: Happening quickly and with little or no warning; in a sudden manner.

discover.zh: 矿工们发现了一条丰富的铜矿脉。

discover.zh: 他们发现了他如何侵吞公款。

production.zh: 这部作品提供了一种全新的诠释。

production.zh: 罢工使生产中断了两天。

production.zh: 他们计划对生产设施重新装备。

production.en: Each production is implemented with a function.

production.zh: 每个产生式都是通过一个函数来实现的。

treat.zh: 她以俏皮而不拘敬意的态度对待这个话题。

treat.zh: 她拒绝把任何工作看作低贱的。

treat.gloss: To handle, deal with or behave towards in a specific way.

inside.en: The piston moves inside the cylinder.

inside.zh: 超声技术帮助探测金属内部缺陷。

inside.gloss: Within or towards the interior of something; within the scope or limits of a place, especially a building.; On the inner side of something.

conference.zh: 这次会议在大学的支持下进行。

conference.en: An eminent academician chaired the conference.
conference.zh: 一位杰出的院士主持了会议。

conference.zh: 会议将与他的假期同时举行。

unit.en: Each rentable unit has a separate entrance.
unit.zh: 每个可出租单元都有独立入口。

unit.en: The centimetre is a unit of length.
unit.gloss: A standard measure of a quantity or magnitude.

unit.en: This pill provides 500 units of Vitamin E.
unit.zh: 该药丸提供 500 单位的维生素 E。

unit.en: The new apartment complex will have 50 units.
unit.gloss: A measure of housing equivalent to the living quarters of one household; an apartment where a group of apartments is contained in one or more multi-storied buildings or a group of dwellings is in one or more single storey buildings, usually arranged around a driveway.
unit.zh: 新公寓大楼将拥有 50 个单元。

style.en: Her paintings exemplify the naturalistic style.
style.zh: 她的绘画体现了自然主义风格。

style.en: These buildings typify the neoclassical style.
style.zh: 这些建筑体现了新古典主义风格。

style.en: The artist developed a distinctively naturalistic style.
style.zh: 这位艺术家形成了鲜明的自然主义风格。

style.gloss: To call or give a name or title to.

adult.zh: 这个项目支持识字不多的成年学习者。

adult.zh: 他的成年子女每年都会来看望他。

worry.en: Your dog’s been worrying sheep again.
worry.gloss: To seize or shake by the throat, especially of a dog or wolf.
worry.zh: 你的狗又开始担心羊了。

worry.en: Your tone of voice worries me.
worry.gloss: Disturb the peace of mind of; afflict with mental agitation or distress; to exercise.

worry.en: I'm afflicted by worry throughout the night.
worry.zh: 我整个晚上都被忧虑折磨着。

mention.zh: 旧记述提到了肿胀的腹部。

mention.zh: 他碰巧向我提到了你的名字。

range.gloss: The maximum distance or reach of capability (of a weapon, radio, detector, etc.).

range.en: Primates range from lemurs to gorillas.
range.zh: 灵长类动物的范围从狐猴到大猩猩。

range.en: We sell a wide range of cars.

range.gloss: The distance a vehicle (e.g., a car, bicycle, lorry, or aircraft) can travel without refueling.
range.zh: 这架飞机的航程为 15 000 公里。

range.en: The peba ranges from Texas to Paraguay.
range.gloss: To be native to, or live in, a certain district or region.
range.zh: 佩巴分布范围从德克萨斯州到巴拉圭。

range.en: Jones has good range for a big man.
range.gloss: The defensive area that a player can cover.
range.zh: 对于大个子来说，琼斯拥有良好的射程。

deep.zh: 他的虚张声势掩盖着内心的犹疑。

deep.en: The bell produced a deep, resonant tone.
deep.zh: 钟发出了低沉而洪亮的声音。

deep.en: The ostensible reason concealed a deeper motive.
deep.zh: 表面的理由掩盖了更深的动机。

deep.gloss: Extending, reaching or positioned far from a point of reference, especially downwards.; Extending far down from the top, or surface, to the bottom, literally or figuratively.

deep.gloss: Far, especially far down through something or into something, physically or figuratively.

edge.en: The worker sharpened the auger's cutting edge.

edge.en: The earthquake altered the landmass's coastal edge.
edge.zh: 地震改变了这片陆地的海岸边缘。

edge.zh: 小浪轻轻拍打着海湾边缘。

edge.en: I have the edge on him.

edge.gloss: To move an object slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

specific.en: The gene is inducible under specific conditions.
specific.zh: 这个基因在特定条件下可以被诱导表达。

specific.en: Quinine is a specific for malaria.

specific.zh: 他的目光从不集中在任何具体的事物上。

writer.zh: 这部选集收录了几位著名作家的作品。

writer.zh: 作者引用了总统的讲话。

trouble.zh: 他奴性的服从使其他成员不安。

trouble.zh: 他不加分辨各种说法，使编辑困扰。

touch.gloss: Primarily physical senses.; To make physical contact with; to bring the hand, finger or other part of the body into contact with.

touch.gloss: Primarily physical senses.; To cause to be briefly in physical contact with something.

touch.gloss: the act of putting two things together with no space between them

please.gloss: To make happy or satisfy; to give pleasure to.

please.gloss: To desire; to will; to be pleased by.
Used to make a polite request.

attend.en: New employees attend an induction course.

attend.gloss: Senses relating to caring for or waiting on someone, or accompanying or being present.; To be present at (an event or place) in order to take part in some action or proceedings; also, to regularly go to (an event or place).

attend.gloss: Senses relating to caring for or waiting on someone, or accompanying or being present.; Followed by to: to look after someone or something.

attend.en: Servants attend the king day and night.
attend.gloss: Senses relating to caring for or waiting on someone, or accompanying or being present.; To wait on (someone or their instructions) as an attendant, servant, etc.; also (specifically of a gentleman-in-waiting or lady-in-waiting to a member of royalty), to accompany (someone) in order to assist or wait upon them; to escort.

completely.gloss: To the fullest extent or degree; totally.

variety.en: Variety is the spice of life.
variety.gloss: The quality of being varied; diversity.

sleep.zh: 睡眠影响生理和代谢过程。

sleep.en: The ceaseless noise disrupted their sleep.

sleep.gloss: The state of reduced consciousness during which a human or animal rests in a daily rhythm.

sleep.gloss: To rest in a state of reduced consciousness.

sleep.en: This caravan can sleep four people comfortably.

involved.en: He got/was involved in a bar fight.
involved.gloss: Associated with others, be a participant or make someone be a participant (in a crime, process, etc.)

involved.gloss: simple past and past participle of involve
involved.zh: 解释涉及土豆、松鼠和赛车。

investigation.zh: 财务违规引发了独立调查。

investigation.zh: 这个异常读数需要进一步调查。

investigation.gloss: The act of investigating; the process of inquiring into or following up; research, especially patient or thorough inquiry or examination

nuclear.en: Nuclear fission releases a considerable amount of energy.
nuclear.zh: 核裂变释放出大量能量。

researcher.zh: 研究人员检验了这种疗法的功效。

researcher.en: Researchers glean information from fragmentary records.
researcher.zh: 研究人员从零碎记录中搜集信息。

researcher.en: The researchers examined the animal's carcase.

conflict.en: Military armament increased before the conflict.
conflict.zh: 冲突爆发前，军备增加了。

conflict.en: This antecedent event influenced the later conflict.
conflict.zh: 这一先前事件影响了后来的冲突。

conflict.zh: 序幕介绍了故事的核心冲突。

conflict.en: It appears that our schedules conflict.
conflict.gloss: To overlap (with), as in a schedule.
conflict.zh: 看来我们的日程有冲突。

spirit.en: Careerism undermined the department's fraternal spirit.
spirit.zh: 名利主义损害了部门的友爱精神。

spirit.en: Their indomitable spirit sustained the rescue effort.
spirit.zh: 他们不屈不挠的精神支撑了救援行动。

spirit.en: Her dauntless spirit inspired the weary team.
spirit.zh: 她无畏的精神鼓舞了疲惫的队伍。

spirit.gloss: A supernatural being, often but not exclusively without physical form; ghost, fairy, angel.
spirit.zh: 岛上有一个游荡的灵魂。

replace.en: Rote learning cannot replace genuine understanding.
replace.zh: 机械记忆无法代替真正的理解。

replace.en: The technician replaced the damaged anode.

replace.en: Replace uptodate with the hyphenated form.

replace.en: I replaced my car with a newer model.
replace.gloss: To supply or substitute an equivalent with.
replace.zh: 我把我的车换成了新型号。

这个吉兆鼓舞了双方重启谈判。

encourage.en: I encouraged him during his race.
encourage.gloss: To mentally support; to motivate, give courage, hope or spirit.

argument.zh: 她有说服力的论点说服了小组委员会。

argument.en: His tenuous argument failed to convince us.

argument.gloss: A quantity on which the calculation of another quantity depends.

camp.en: Go and camp the flag for the win.
camp.gloss: To stay beside (something) to gain an advantage.

brain.gloss: An intelligent person.; A person who provides the intelligence required for something.

feature.en: The mural features stylized animal figures.
feature.zh: 这幅壁画描绘了风格化的动物形象。

slowly.zh: 沉重的货车缓慢地爬上坡。

introduce.zh: 让我介绍一下我们的演讲嘉宾。

attempt.zh: 他们拒绝了利用他人困境的卑劣企图。

lack.zh: 这栋旧出租公寓楼缺乏足够的卫生设施。

drink.zh: 过滤器去除饮用水中的污染物。

critic.en: Critics laud the novel's subtle characterization.
critic.zh: 评论家赞扬这部小说细腻的人物刻画。

critic.en: Critics flayed the film's hackneyed plot.
critic.zh: 评论家猛烈抨击了影片陈腐的情节。

warm.zh: 在对流过程中，暖空气上升。

warm.en: Warm light suffused the dingy room.
warm.zh: 温暖的光充满了这间昏暗的房间。

warm.en: The warm room made him drowse.
warm.zh: 温暖的房间使他昏昏欲睡。

warm.gloss: Of a somewhat high temperature, often but not always connoting that the high temperature is pleasant rather than uncomfortable.

warm.en: He is warming to the idea.
warm.gloss: (sometimes in the form warm up) To favour increasingly.
warm.zh: 他对这个想法很感兴趣。

aspect.en: Vowel harmony is an important aspect of Mongolian.
aspect.zh: 元音和谐是蒙古语的一个重要方面。

insist.en: The martinet insisted on strict regimentation.
insist.zh: 这个严苛的管教者坚持严格管理。
用户坚持使用无油脂的化妆品。

insist.en: The defendant insisted on his innocence.
insist.gloss: To hold up a claim emphatically.

insist.en: I insist that my secretary dress nicely.
insist.gloss: To demand continually that something happen or be done; to reiterate a demand despite requests to abandon it.
insist.zh: 我坚持要求我的秘书穿得漂亮。

failure.en: They imputed the failure to poor planning.
failure.zh: 他们把失败归因于规划不善。
他是一个彻头彻尾的失败者。

failure.en: I was a failure at my first job.
failure.gloss: A failure is someone or something that fails, or does not achieve a goal.
failure.zh: 我的第一份工作很失败。

annual.en: Each depositor receives an annual statement.
annual.zh: 每位储户每年都会收到账户结单。

annual.en: Our neighbourhood organizes an annual festival.
annual.zh: 我们街区每年组织一次节庆。

annual.en: The contract stipulates an annual salary increment.
annual.zh: 合同规定了每年的加薪幅度。

comment.en: Please keep your comments germane to safety.
comment.zh: 请让你的评论与安全问题相关。

comment.gloss: To make remarks or notes; to express a view regarding.
comment.zh: 他对你的建议发表了评论。

comment.en: I have no comment on that.

affair.en: The house was a ramshackle affair.
affair.gloss: Any proceeding or action which it is wished to refer to or characterize vaguely.

affair.en: This garden is a ramshackle affair.
affair.zh: 这个花园是一个摇摇欲坠的地方。

affair.en: He gave another version of the affair.
affair.zh: 他给出了这件事的另一个版本。

responsible.en: Who is responsible for this mess?
responsible.gloss: Being a primary cause of a situation or action and thus able to be blamed or credited for it.
responsible.zh: 谁该为这个烂摊子负责？

responsible.en: He looks like a responsible guy.
responsible.gloss: Able to be trusted; reliable; trustworthy.
responsible.zh: 看起来是个有责任心的人。

responsible.en: Parents are responsible for their child's behaviour.
responsible.gloss: Having the duty of taking care of something; answerable for an act performed or for its consequences; accountable; amenable, especially legally or politically.
responsible.zh: 父母要对孩子的行为负责。

responsible.en: She has a responsible position in the firm.
responsible.gloss: Involving important duties; involving a degree of personal accountability on the part of the person concerned.

procedure.en: They scrupulously followed the prescribed procedure.
procedure.zh: 他们一丝不苟地遵循了规定流程。

procedure.en: The formalized procedure reduced arbitrary decisions.
procedure.zh: 规范化的流程减少了随意决策。

procedure.en: The procedure is considered relatively low-risk.
procedure.zh: 这个过程被认为风险相对较低。

regular.zh: 经常锻炼使他恢复了活力。
液压制动器需要定期维护。
定期维护可防止问题再次发生。

regular.en: Maintaining a high-fibre diet keeps one regular.
regular.gloss: Having normal bowel movements or menstrual periods at constant intervals.
regular.zh: 保持高纤维饮食可以保持规律。

regular.en: Bartenders usually know their regulars by name.
regular.gloss: A frequent, routine visitor to an establishment.
regular.zh: 调酒师通常都知道常客的名字。

regular.en: This gentleman was one of the architect's regulars.
regular.gloss: A frequent customer, client or business partner.
regular.zh: 这位先生是建筑师的常客之一。

spread.en: The pathogen spreads through contaminated water.
spread.zh: 这种病原体通过受污染的水传播。

spread.en: Diffusion spreads molecules throughout the liquid.
He spread his newspaper on the table.
spread.gloss: To stretch out, open out (a material etc.) so that it more fully covers a given area of space.

chairman.en: The chairman was also an able sailor.
chairman.zh: 主席也是一位能干的水手。

chairman.en: The matter was decided by the chairman.
Our chairman is the face of this company.
chairman.zh: 我们的董事长是这家公司的门面。

baseball.en: He wanted to exhibit his baseball cards.
The New York Yankees are a baseball team.
baseball.gloss: A sport where you try to hit a ball so that you can run to four bases, causing a run. The team with the most runs after nine or more innings wins.
baseball.zh: 纽约洋基队是一支棒球队。

soft.en: The leather remained soft and supple.
soft.zh: 这块皮革仍然柔软而有弹性。

soft.en: They extrude the soft material through a die.
soft.zh: 他们把软材料从模具中挤出。

soft.en: There was a soft breeze blowing.
My head sank easily into the soft pillow.
soft.zh: 我的头轻易地就陷进了柔软的枕头里。

ignore.en: She ignored the reviewer's captious objections.
ignore.zh: 她没有理会审稿人吹毛求疵的反对意见。

ignore.en: Ignoring the warning would be sheer idiocy.
ignore.zh: 无视这个警告简直是愚蠢至极。

ignore.en: The insubordinate apprentice ignored repeated safety warnings.
ignore.zh: 这个不服从管理的学徒无视了一再的安全警告。

ignore.en: A problem ignored is a problem doubled.
ignore.gloss: To deliberately not listen or pay attention to.
ignore.zh: 一个问题被忽视，问题就会加倍。

egg.en: The unfertilized eggs did not develop.
The paleontologist examined the fossilized eggs.
egg.zh: 这位古生物学家检查了蛋化石。

egg.en: Heat can addle eggs before they hatch.
egg.zh: 高温会使蛋在孵化前变坏。

egg.en: The angry demonstrators egged the riot police.
egg.gloss: To throw (especially rotten) eggs (noun sense 1.1.1) at (someone or something).
egg.zh: 愤怒的示威者怂恿防暴警察。

belief.en: His theological research explores ancient beliefs.
belief.zh: 他的神学研究探讨古代信仰。

belief.en: The experience shook my religious belief.
belief.zh: 这次经历动摇了我的宗教信仰。

demonstrate.en: The experiment demonstrates the photoelectric effect.
demonstrate.zh: 这个实验演示了光电效应。

demonstrate.en: High costs demonstrated the scheme's impracticality.
demonstrate.zh: 高成本表明了这个方案的不实用性。

demonstrate.en: The project demonstrated the fruitfulness of cooperation.
demonstrate.zh: 这个项目显示了合作的丰硕成果。

demonstrate.en: Can you demonstrate the new tools for us?
demonstrate.zh: 您能为我们演示一下新工具吗？

anybody.gloss: Any one out of an indefinite number of persons; anyone; any person.

anybody.en: He doesn't take attitude from anybody.
anybody.zh: 他不接受任何人的态度。

anybody.en: He could outspell anybody at school.
anybody.zh: 他的拼写能力胜过学校里的任何人。

murder.en: The defendant was charged with murder.
murder.gloss: An act of killing a person unlawfully, especially with predetermination.; The crime of killing a person unlawfully, especially with predetermination.
murder.zh: 被告被指控犯有谋杀罪。

murder.en: I heard this class is murder.
murder.gloss: Something difficult or terrible to endure.

murder.en: My uncle’s dog murdered my cat.
murder.zh: 我叔叔的狗杀了我的猫。

murder.en: A murder of crows dotted my backyard.
murder.gloss: A flock of crows or sometimes ravens.
murder.zh: 我的后院到处都是乌鸦的谋杀案。

murder.gloss: An act of killing a person unlawfully, especially with predetermination.; The act of killing any being in an immoral manner; (countable) an instance of this.

gift.en: She questioned the propriety of accepting gifts.
They offered gifts to propitiate the deity.
gift.zh: 他们供奉礼物以安抚神明。

gift.en: The gift was a requital of past generosity.
gift.zh: 这份礼物是对以往慷慨的回报。

gift.en: She had a gift for playing the flute.

religion.zh: 他自称的宗教信仰是天主教。

religion.en: She places little value on religion.
She rediscovered her faith in religion.
religion.zh: 她重新发现了对宗教的信仰。

review.zh: 第三，审查安全方面的影响。

review.en: The journal publishes quarterly research reviews.
review.zh: 这份期刊每季度发表研究综述。

review.en: A registered dietitian reviewed the menu.
review.zh: 一位注册营养师审查了菜单。

review.en: The magazine contained a review of Paris restaurants.
review.gloss: A survey of the available items or material.
review.zh: 该杂志包含对巴黎餐馆的评论。

review.en: The Times Literary Review is published in London.
review.gloss: A periodical which makes a survey of the arts or some other field.
review.zh: 《泰晤士报文学评论》在伦敦出版。

review.en: The regulators demanded a review against NYSE practices.
review.gloss: A forensic inspection to assess compliance with regulations or some code.
review.zh: 监管机构要求对纽约证券交易所的做法进行审查。

editor.en: The editor scrupulously checked every citation.
editor.zh: 编辑认真仔细地核查了每一处引文。

editor.en: The anthology reflects the editor's eclecticism.
editor.zh: 这部选集体现了编辑的兼收并蓄。

editor.en: An assiduous editor verified each citation.
editor.zh: 一位勤勉的编辑核查了每处引文。

engage.zh: 一些灵长类动物从事昆虫捕食。

engage.en: He engaged the lock on the door.
engage.gloss: To interact mechanically.; To activate a lock.

engage.zh: 其他人从事志愿者工作。

coffee.zh: 约翰在咖啡里加了很多糖。
与咖啡相比，我更喜欢茶。

coffee.en: He did not stay for coffee.
coffee.gloss: The end of a meal, when coffee is served.

document.en: Company incorporation requires several legal documents.
document.zh: 公司注册需要若干法律文件。

document.en: These documents purport to prove ownership.
document.zh: 这些文件声称能证明所有权。

document.en: Photojournalism documents events through compelling images.
document.zh: 新闻摄影通过有感染力的图像记录事件。

speed.en: Heat speeds up the diffusion process.
Kinetic energy depends on mass and speed.
speed.zh: 动能取决于质量和速度。

speed.en: The catalyst speeds up the chemical reaction.
speed.zh: 催化剂加快了化学反应。

speed.en: The Ferrari was speeding along the road.
How does Usain Bolt run at that speed?
speed.gloss: The state of moving quickly or the capacity for rapid motion.
speed.zh: 尤塞恩·博尔特如何跑得这么快？

cross.en: The sinuous river crosses the floodplain.
cross.zh: 蜿蜒的河流穿过洪泛区。

cross.en: The transcontinental train crosses a vast expanse.
cross.zh: 这列横贯大陆的火车穿过辽阔地域。

cross.en: An oblique path crosses the grassy field.
cross.zh: 一条斜向小路穿过草地。

cross.en: She made the cross after swearing.
cross.gloss: A hand gesture made in imitation of the shape of the Cross; sign of the cross.

cross.en: They exchanged a few cross words.
cross.gloss: (of someone) Bad-tempered, angry, annoyed; (of words) tinged with anger.

cross.en: She frowned and crossed her arms.
cross.gloss: To make or form a cross.; To place across or athwart; to cause to intersect.

influence.zh: 亲属关系影响了仲裁人的决定。
气候变化影响物种分布。

influence.en: Sleep influences physiological and metabolic processes.
influence.zh: 睡眠影响生理和代谢过程。

influence.en: I have absolutely no influence over him.
influence.gloss: The power to affect, control or manipulate something or someone; the ability to change the development of fluctuating things such as conduct, thoughts or decisions.
influence.zh: 我对他完全没有影响力。

influence.en: The politician wants to influence the public.
influence.gloss: To have an effect on by using gentle or subtle action; to exert an influence upon; to modify, bias, or sway; to persuade or induce.

influence.en: I'm not able to exercise influence over him.
influence.gloss: An action exerted by a person or thing with such power on another to cause change.

anyway.zh: 无论如何，我正在获得更多经验。
无论如何，我会抓住机会。

commit.gloss: To give in trust; to put into charge or keeping; to entrust; to consign; used with to or formerly unto.

commit.en: Tony should be committed to a nuthouse!
commit.gloss: To forcibly evaluate and treat in a medical facility, particularly for presumed mental illness.
commit.zh: 托尼应该被关进疯人院！

threaten.en: Soil erosion threatens this coastal fishery.
threaten.zh: 土壤侵蚀威胁着这处沿海渔场。

threaten.en: Resource depletion threatens long-term economic growth.
threaten.zh: 资源耗竭威胁着长期经济增长。

threaten.en: Dissension within the group threatened their cooperation.
threaten.zh: 小组内部的分歧威胁了他们的合作。

threaten.en: He threatened me with a knife.
threaten.gloss: To make a threat against someone; to use threats.

threaten.en: The rocks threatened the ship's survival.
The black clouds threatened heavy rain.
threaten.gloss: To portend, or give a warning of.

female.zh: 她是一位棱角分明的女性。

female.en: Yes, I have a female dog.
female.gloss: If a person, animal or plant is female it is of the sex that can have babies or produce eggs or seeds. Girls and women are female people.

female.en: There are joint lives, male and female.
In humans, females are called women or girls.
female.gloss: A female is a person, animal, or plant that can have babies or produce eggs.
female.zh: 在人类中，女性被称为妇女或女孩。

female.en: This movie is good for a female audience.
female.gloss: If something is female, it is of, for, or about women or girls.
female.zh: 这部电影很适合女性观众。

youth.zh: 他度过了一段虚度的青春。

youth.en: The youth group organises annual residentials.
youth.zh: 青年小组每年组织一次住宿活动。

youth.en: He was footloose in his youth.
Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.
youth.gloss: The quality or state of being young.
youth.zh: 她的青春和美丽吸引了他。

wave.en: Seismic waves revealed the subterranean structure.
wave.zh: 地震波揭示了地下结构。

wave.en: Ultrasonic waves help detect internal flaws.
wave.zh: 超声波有助于检测内部缺陷。

wave.en: Radio waves interact with the ionosphere.
wave.zh: 无线电波与电离层相互作用。

wave.gloss: To swing and miss at a pitch.

wave.en: The flag waved in the gentle breeze.
wave.gloss: To move back and forth repeatedly and somewhat loosely.

wave.en: I waved goodbye from across the room.
wave.gloss: To call attention to, or give a direction or command to, by a waving motion, as of the hand; to signify by waving; to beckon; to signal; to indicate.
wave.zh: 我从房间的另一边挥手告别。

afraid.gloss: Impressed with fear or apprehension; in fear.

afraid.en: He is afraid of the future.
afraid.gloss: Impressed with fear or apprehension; in fear.

afraid.en: He was deathly afraid of crocodiles.

quarter.en: We got help form every quarter.
quarter.gloss: A section (of a population), especially one having a particular set of values or interests.
quarter.zh: 我们每个季度都会得到帮助。

quarter.en: I ate a quarter of the pizza.
quarter.gloss: A fourth part of something.; Each of four equal parts into which something can be divided; a fourth part.
quarter.zh: 我吃了四分之一的披萨。

background.zh: 前景和背景形成强烈对比。

background.en: The radio was playing in the background.
The lawyer had a background in computer science.
background.gloss: One's social heritage, or previous life; what one did in the past.
background.zh: 该律师拥有计算机科学背景。

background.en: The antivirus program runs on a background thread.
background.gloss: Less important or less noticeable in a scene or system.
background.zh: 防病毒程序在后台线程上运行。

background.en: There was tons of noise in the background.
background.gloss: A less important feature of scenery (as opposed to foreground).

background.en: The antivirus program is running in the background.
background.gloss: A type of activity on a computer that is not normally visible to the user.
background.zh: 防病毒程序正在后台运行。

native.gloss: Belonging to one by birth or ancestry.
Characteristic of or relating to people inhabiting a region from prehistoric times.
native.zh: 许多本土艺术家出国留学。

native.en: He is a native of Brazil.
native.gloss: a person born in a particular place or country

native.en: The native integer size is sixteen bits.
native.gloss: Pertaining to the system or architecture in question.
native.zh: 本机整数大小为十六位。

broad.en: The settlement occupies a broad floodplain.
broad.zh: 这处聚落位于宽阔的洪泛区。

broad.en: We're sailing on a broad reach.
broad.zh: 我们正在广阔的航程中航行。

broad.en: Broad transcriptions are typically enclosed in slashes.
broad.zh: 广泛的转录通常用斜线括起来。

wonderful.en: They served a wonderful six-course meal.
wonderful.gloss: Surprisingly excellent; very good or admirable, extremely impressive.
wonderful.zh: 他们提供了一顿美味的六道菜餐。

wonderful.en: That was a simply wonderful dessert.
wonderful.zh: 那真是一道美妙的甜点。

wonderful.en: His delusion was not wonderful, but most natural.
wonderful.gloss: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.
wonderful.zh: 他的错觉并不美妙，但却是最自然的。

deny.en: My father denied me a good education.
deny.gloss: To refuse to give or grant something to someone.
deny.zh: 我的父亲拒绝让我接受良好的教育。

deny.en: I deny that I was at the party.
deny.gloss: To assert that something is not true.

apparently.en: She explained the apparently paradoxical result.
apparently.zh: 她解释了这个看似矛盾的结果。

apparently.en: Apparently you are quite a good dancer.
apparently.gloss: According to what the speaker has read or heard.
apparently.zh: 显然你是一个很好的舞者。

apparently.en: He's apparently found his place at the monastery.
apparently.zh: 他显然已经在修道院找到了自己的位置。

slightly.en: He was slightly built, but tall.
She shifted slightly in her seat.
slightly.zh: 她在座位上轻轻动了动。

slightly.en: Distilled water is very slightly electrically conductive.
slightly.zh: 蒸馏水的导电性非常弱。

reaction.en: The catalyst speeds up the chemical reaction.
reaction.zh: 催化剂加快了化学反应。

twice.en: The philharmonic rehearses twice a week.
twice.zh: 交响乐团每周排练两次。
他们的新闻杂志每周播出两次。

twice.en: You should brush your teeth twice a day.

suit.en: The blue frock suited the summer weather.
suit.zh: 这条蓝色连衣裙适合夏天穿。

suit.en: My new suit cost me buckets.
suit.zh: 我的新西装花了我很多钱。

suit.en: He is well suited with his place.
suit.gloss: To please; to make content; to fit someone's (or one's own) taste.

suit.en: Nick hired a navy-blue suit for the wedding.
suit.gloss: A set of clothes to be worn together, now especially a man's matching jacket and trousers (also business suit or lounge suit), or a similar outfit for a woman.
suit.zh: 尼克为婚礼雇了一套深蓝色西装。

suit.en: The ripped jeans didn't suit her elegant image.
suit.gloss: To be suitable or apt for one's image.
suit.zh: 破洞牛仔裤不符合她优雅的形象。

perspective.en: His perspective had warped after his extreme experiences.
perspective.zh: 在经历了极端的经历之后，他的观点发生了扭曲。
这使得我们能够正确地看待它。

growing.zh: 她越听越觉得难以置信。

growing.en: Turnips grow well in cool weather.
growing.zh: 芜菁在凉爽天气下生长良好。

growing.en: The soil's fruitfulness sustained the growing settlement.
growing.zh: 土地的肥沃养育着不断扩大的聚落。

growing.en: The growing season here begins in March.
growing.zh: 这里的生长季节从三月开始。

blow.en: I’ll strike a blow for you.
Good luck, and don’t blow it!
blow.gloss: To fail at; to mess up; to make a mistake in.
To leave, especially suddenly or in a hurry.

blow.en: He gave his nose a loud blow.
blow.gloss: forceful exhalation through the nose or mouth

construction.zh: 工程师对他的建筑感到惊讶。

construction.zh: 新桥的施工正在进行中。

construction.en: He had worked in construction all his life.
construction.zh: 他一生都从事建筑工作。

intelligence.zh: 这台计算机拥有人工智能。

intelligence.en: The abbreviation CIA stands for "Central Intelligence Agency".
intelligence.zh: CIA 的缩写代表“中央情报局”。
有时候我怀疑你的智商。

destroy.en: The earthquake destroyed several apartment complexes.

destroy.zh: 地震摧毁了几栋公寓楼。

destroy.gloss: To damage beyond use or repair; to damage (something) to the point that it effectively ceases to exist.

destroy.en: I could destroy some wings right now.

destroy.zh: 我现在就可以毁掉一些翅膀。

destroy.zh: 法律要求消灭患有狂犬病的狗。

cook.en: She cooked in a cast-iron pan.
Baste the turkey with its cooking juices.
The cook added sardines to the salad.
cook.zh: 厨师在沙拉中加入了沙丁鱼。

cook.gloss: To prepare food for eating, typically by heating it, combining it with other ingredients, seasoning it, preparing it for serving, etc.
cook.zh: 我正在煮香肠和土豆泥。

cook.gloss: To play or improvise in an inspired and rhythmically exciting way. (From 1930s jive talk.)
cook.zh: 观看这个乐队：他们做饭！

connection.en: The villages maintained a tenuous connection.
connection.zh: 这些村庄维持着微弱的联系。

connection.en: I have some connections in Lancashire.
connection.gloss: A person or persons related to oneself, through either family or business.
connection.zh: 我在兰开夏郡有一些关系。

connection.en: A fat pipe is a high-bandwidth connection.
connection.zh: 胖管道是一种高带宽连接。

burn.en: The propellant burns to generate thrust.
burn.zh: 推进剂燃烧以产生推力。

burn.en: The crowd burned an effigy of the autocrat.
burn.zh: 人群焚烧了这个独裁者的模拟像。

burn.gloss: The act or action of burning something with fire, or by analogous means; the quality or nature of an act of burning.; The operation or result of burning or baking, as in brickmaking.
To be consumed by fire or in flames.
To be consumed by fire or in flames.; To desire or ache for (something); to be intense, as a desire.
To warm (something); to put off intense heat; to be hot.; To give off light; to be lit up; to shine so bright as to seem to harm (something).
burn.zh: 聚光灯灼伤了我的眼睛。

shoe.en: Guests customarily remove their shoes here.
shoe.zh: 客人在这里通常会脱鞋。

shoe.en: The billiard cue stick was shod in silver.
shoe.gloss: To cover an object with a protective layer of material.
shoe.zh: 台球杆的鞋底是银色的。

neighbor.en: The covetous character envied his neighbor's fortune.
neighbor.zh: 这个贪婪的角色羡慕邻居的财富。

neighbor.en: Fort Worth is a neighbor of Dallas.
neighbor.gloss: a nearby object of the same kind

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet

neighbor.zh: 沃斯堡是达拉斯的邻居。

neighbor.en: We should love our neighbor as ourself.

grade.en: Clancy starts grade five this year.
grade.gloss: A level of primary and secondary education.
grade.zh: 克兰西今年开始五年级。

grade.en: I loved reading until 7th grade English.
grade.zh: 我喜欢阅读直到七年级英语。

grade.en: He got a good grade on the test.
grade.gloss: Performance on a test or other evaluation(s), expressed by a number, letter, or other symbol; a score.

grade.en: The grade fives are on a field trip.
grade.gloss: A student of a particular grade (used with the grade level).
grade.zh: 五年级的学生正在进行实地考察。

context.en: The metaphor seems inapt for this context.
context.zh: 这个比喻似乎不适合这个语境。

context.en: Let me put it into context.
context.zh: 让我把它放在上下文中。

context.en: Used with an implied object obvious from context.
context.zh: 与从上下文中显而易见的隐含对象一起使用。

committee.en: His forthright answer surprised the committee.
committee.zh: 他直率的回答使委员会感到意外。

committee.en: The committee issued a formal censure.
committee.zh: 委员会发出了正式谴责。

committee.en: The committee is amenable to compromise.
My uncle is on the committee.
committee.gloss: A body of one or more persons convened for the accomplishment of some specific purpose, typically with formal protocols.

mistake.en: Don't chide him for an honest mistake.
mistake.zh: 不要因为一个无心之失而责备他。
你犯了一个史诗般的错误。

mistake.en: Don't mistake my kindness for weakness.
mistake.gloss: To understand wrongly, taking one thing or person for another.
mistake.zh: 别把我的善良当成软弱。

mistake.en: He always made mistakes on purpose.

location.en: Visit a location, call, or click www.example.com.
location.zh: 访问某个位置、致电或单击 www.example.com。

location.en: The show was filmed on location in Hawaii.
location.gloss: A site outside of a studio used for shooting all or part of a movie or television show.
location.zh: 该节目是在夏威夷拍摄的。

location.en: This is a prime location for a bookstore.

clothes.zh: 她总是穿着高品质的衣服。

clothes.en: The clothes dried on the line.

quiet.en: Quiet surroundings are conducive to concentration.
quiet.zh: 安静的环境有助于集中注意力。

quiet.en: She comported herself with quiet dignity.
The hills embosom the quiet village.
quiet.zh: 群山环抱着这个安静的村庄。

quiet.en: Business was quiet for the season.
When you quiet, we can start talking.
quiet.zh: 当你安静下来时，我们就可以开始说话了。

dress.en: She wore a plain homespun dress.
dress.zh: 她穿着一条朴素的家织布裙。

dress.en: A silver spangle glittered on her dress.
dress.zh: 她裙子上的一片银色亮片闪闪发光。

dress.en: He was dressed in the latest fashions.
dress.gloss: To put clothes (or, formerly, armour) on (oneself or someone, a doll, a mannequin, etc.); to clothe.
dress.zh: 他穿着最新流行的衣服。

dress.en: They returned home early to dress for dinner.
dress.gloss: To put on clothes.; To attire oneself for a particular (especially formal) occasion, or in a fashionable manner.
dress.zh: 他们早早回到家，穿好衣服准备吃晚饭。

dress.en: He came to the party in formal dress.
dress.gloss: Apparel or clothing, especially when appropriate for a particular occasion, profession, etc.
dress.zh: 他穿着正式服装来参加聚会。

promise.zh: 所承诺的解决方案被证明虚幻不实。

promise.en: Be chary of accepting extravagant promises.
She was too credulous about extravagant promises.
promise.zh: 她过于轻信夸大的承诺。

promise.gloss: To give grounds for expectation, especially of something good.

promise.en: That jewelry was a promise to me.
promise.zh: 那件珠宝是对我的承诺。

promise.en: Your claim has little promise in court.
promise.gloss: Reason to expect improvement or success; potential.
promise.zh: 你的主张在法庭上没有什么希望。

aware.en: Be aware of interactions between different medications.
aware.zh: 注意不同药物之间的相互作用。

aware.en: He was already aware of it.
aware.zh: 他已经意识到了这一点。

aware.en: I'm quite aware of your kindness.

function.en: The equipment functioned satisfactorily after calibration.
function.zh: 校准后，设备运作令人满意。

function.en: Glandular secretions regulate several physiological functions.
function.zh: 腺体分泌物调节多种生理功能。

function.en: The pancreas has important exocrine functions.
function.zh: 胰腺具有重要的外分泌功能。

bone.en: Tendon is compliant compared to bone.
bone.zh: 与骨相比，肌腱具有顺应性。

bone.en: Throw me a fricking bone here!
bone.zh: 扔给我一块该死的骨头吧！

bone.en: Some reptiles have a transpalatine bone.

active.en: They identified the active moiety of the compound.
active.zh: 他们识别出了这个化合物的活性部分。

active.en: They developed an antimalarially active compound.
active.zh: 他们开发了一种具有抗疟活性的化合物。

extend.en: Radial lines extend from the center.
extend.zh: 放射状线条从中心延伸出去。

extend.en: Interconnecting rooms accommodated the extended family.
extend.zh: 相互连通的房间安顿下了大家庭。

extend.en: The lode extends deep into the hillside.
extend.zh: 这条矿脉深入山坡内部。

extend.en: The desert extended for miles in all directions.
extend.gloss: To possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space.
extend.zh: 沙漠向四面八方延伸数英里。

chief.en: Bob is our troubleshooter in chief.
chief.gloss: Headship, the status of being a chief or leader.
chief.zh: 鲍勃是我们的首席故障排除专家。

chief.en: All firefighters report to the fire chief.
chief.gloss: The leader or head of a tribe, organisation, business unit, or other group.
chief.zh: 所有消防员均向消防队长报告。

chief.en: His designation as chief justice was controversial.
chief.zh: 他被任命为首席大法官引起了争议。

chief.en: Negligence was the chief cause of the disaster.
chief.zh: 疏忽是造成这场灾难的主要原因。

combine.en: Her solution combined elegance with practicality.
combine.zh: 她的解决方案兼顾了美观和实用性。

combine.en: The film combines narration with archival images.
combine.zh: 这部电影把旁白与档案影像结合起来。

combine.en: The teacher combined firmness with sympathetic understanding.
I'm combining business and pleasure on this trip.
combine.gloss: To bring (two or more things or activities) together; to unite.
combine.zh: 这次旅行我将商务和休闲结合在一起。

wine.en: As a non-drinker, she declined the wine.
wine.zh: 她不饮酒，所以谢绝了葡萄酒。

wine.en: Wine is usually stronger than beer.
wine.gloss: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.
wine.zh: 葡萄酒通常比啤酒更烈。

below.en: Earth's mantle lies below the crust.

below.gloss: Lower than in value, price, rank, concentration, etc.

below.zh: 下面对这一点进行说明。

below.en: Such petty behavior is below me.
below.gloss: Unsuitable to the rank or dignity of; beneath.

cool.en: Cooling magma eventually solidifies into rock.
cool.zh: 冷却的岩浆最终凝固成岩石。

cool.en: Cooling water flows through the condenser.
His proposals had a cool reception.
I think astronomy is really cool.
cool.zh: 我觉得天文学真的很酷。

cool.en: Is it cool if I sleep here tonight?
cool.zh: 今晚我睡在这里很酷吗？

voter.zh: 选民检查了候选人的立场。

bus.en: The bus reached its terminus at noon.
bus.zh: 公交车中午到达终点站。

bus.en: He’s been bussing for minimum wage.
bus.gloss: To work at clearing the remains of meals from tables or counters; to work as a busboy.
bus.zh: 他一直在争取最低工资。

bus.en: He bussed tables as the restaurant emptied out.
bus.zh: 当餐厅空无一人时，他清理了桌子。

learning.en: This paradigm emphasizes learning through experience.
learning.zh: 这种范式强调通过经验学习。

learning.en: Rote learning cannot replace genuine understanding.
learning.zh: 机械记忆无法代替真正的理解。

learning.en: I'm learning to ride a unicycle.

hell.gloss: A place of torment where some or all sinners are believed to go after death and evil spirits are believed to be.

hell.zh: 你看起来就像地狱一样！

hell.en: I went through hell to get home today.
hell.gloss: A place or situation of great suffering in life.
hell.zh: 我今天经历了地狱才回家。

hell.en: You don’t have a snowball's chance in hell.
hell.zh: 你在地狱里连滚雪球的机会都没有。

hell.en: That steep staircase is hell on my knees.
hell.zh: 那个陡峭的楼梯对我来说简直就是地狱。

dangerous.zh: 完全免疫消融是极其危险的。

dangerous.en: Certain drug combinations can be dangerous.
dangerous.zh: 某些药物组合可能很危险。

dangerous.en: Railway crossings without gates are highly dangerous.
dangerous.zh: 没有闸门的铁路道口非常危险。

remind.en: The briny smell reminded her of home.
remind.zh: 海水的咸味让她想起了家。

remind.en: Your eyes remind me of stars.
remind.zh: 你的眼睛让我想起星星。

moral.en: The story concluded with a moral.
moral.zh: 这个故事以一个寓意结束。

moral.en: The Jesuits were sometimes accused of moral laxism.
moral.zh: 耶稣会士有时被指责道德松懈。

united.gloss: Involving the joint activity of multiple agents.
united.zh: 两党一致反对这项提议。

relatively.zh: 这个过程被认为风险相对较低。

relatively.zh: 尽管价格上涨，需求仍相对缺乏弹性。

victory.gloss: The condition or state of having won a battle or competition, or having succeeded in an effort; (countable) an instance of this.

academic.zh: 批评者认为这本书是学术蠢货。

academic.zh: 本次学术会议采用视频会议形式。
他的学术成就令人瞩目。

网络上的恶作剧者一直在捉弄我！

internet.gloss: Alternative letter-case form of Internet (“the specific internet consisting of a global network of computers that communicate using Internet Protocol (IP) and that use Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) to identify the best paths to route those communications”).
internet.zh: 大多数报纸现在都可以在互联网上找到。

healthy.en: Healthy progeny depend on adequate parental nourishment.
healthy.zh: 健康的后代需要亲代获得充足营养。

healthy.zh: 她的脸上散发着健康的光泽。

healthy.gloss: Enjoying good health; free from disease or disorder.

negative.en: The word carries a negative connotation.

negative.gloss: A statement that something didn’t happen or doesn’t exist.

negative.en: I was out in negative weather today.
negative.gloss: Of a number: less than zero.; Less than zero degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit.
negative.zh: 今天我出去的时候天气不好。

negative.en: Customers didn’t like it: feedback was mostly negative.
negative.gloss: Not positive or neutral; bad; undesirable; unfavourable.
negative.zh: 客户不喜欢它：反馈大多是负面的。

following.gloss: A group of followers, attendants or admirers; an entourage.
following.zh: 他有一批忠实的追随者。

following.gloss: Coming next, either in sequence or in time.

following.en: The policeman haunted him, following him everywhere.
following.zh: 警察纠缠着他，到处跟踪他。

following.zh: 会议结束后，大家进行了交谈。

following.zh: 接下来的风让我们加速上路。

following.gloss: A thing or things to be mentioned immediately after.
following.zh: 以下是三个最重要的问题。

historical.zh: 演员们把这段历史记述搬上舞台。

historical.zh: 读一段这部历史编年史的节选。

historical.en: The films purport to depict historical events.
historical.zh: 这些影片声称描绘了历史事件。

tour.en: Prospective students toured the geographic research center.
tour.zh: 有意报考的学生参观了地理研究中心。

tour.en: The tour had a campaignlike atmosphere.
tour.zh: 这次巡演充满了竞选气氛。

tour.en: (by extension) A protest march or campaign tour.
tour.zh: （引申为）抗议游行或竞选之旅。

depend.en: Maritime trade depends on navigable waterways.
depend.zh: 海上贸易依赖可以通航的水道。

depend.en: Embryonic development depends on adequate nourishment.
depend.zh: 胚胎发育依赖充足的营养。

depend.en: Fruit maturation depends partly on temperature.
depend.zh: 果实成熟在一定程度上取决于温度。

finding.en: The findings seem paradoxical at first.
finding.zh: 这些发现乍看似乎互相矛盾。

finding.en: These findings invalidate the original hypothesis.
finding.zh: 这些发现推翻了原来的假设。

finding.en: The findings were unpalatable but credible.
finding.zh: 这些发现令人难以接受，却可信。

grab.en: How does that idea grab you?
grab.gloss: To grip the attention of; to enthrall or interest.

grab.en: Grab your coat, love, you've pulled.
grab.zh: 拿起你的外套，亲爱的，你已经拉了。

grab.en: Is there time to grab a coffee?

direct.en: Only the outermost branches received direct sunlight.
direct.zh: 只有最外侧的树枝受到阳光直射。

direct.en: Store photosensitive chemicals away from direct sunlight.
The converter changes alternating current into direct current.
direct.zh: 这个转换器把交流电变成直流电。

direct.en: She directed them to leave immediately.
direct.gloss: To point out to with authority; to instruct as a superior; to order.

direct.en: He directed me to the left-hand road.
direct.gloss: To point out to or show (somebody) the right course or way; to guide, as by pointing out the way; to refer.

classroom.zh: 教学研究为课堂实践提供参考。

classroom.en: This classroom offers a microcosm of diversity.
classroom.zh: 这间教室是多样性的缩影。

classroom.en: This classroom seats two hundred students.
classroom.zh: 这间教室可容纳两百名学生。

contact.en: I am trying to contact my sister.
contact.gloss: To establish communication with (something or someone).
contact.zh: 我正在尝试联系我姐姐。

contact.en: Who is the company's contact for sales queries?
contact.gloss: Someone who can be contacted, or with whom one is in communication.
contact.zh: 公司的销售查询联系人是谁？

contact.en: The side of the car contacted the pedestrian.
contact.gloss: To touch; to come into physical contact with.
contact.zh: 汽车的侧面接触到了行人。

justice.gloss: The ideal of fairness, impartiality, etc., especially with regard to the punishment of wrongdoing.

justice.en: Justice must be seen to be done.
justice.zh: 正义必须以看得见的方式得到实现。

justice.en: His designation as chief justice was controversial.
justice.zh: 他被任命为首席大法官引起了争议。

photograph.en: A centennial exhibition displayed archival photographs.
photograph.zh: 百年纪念展展出了档案照片。

photograph.en: The photograph caught him in midswing.
photograph.zh: 这张照片捕捉到了他正在挥杆的情景。

photograph.en: The photograph shows the UFO side on.

participate.zh: 共生使双方生物都受益。

participate.en: We can both participate in the game.
participate.gloss: If you participate in something, you join in it; you take part in something.
participate.zh: 我们都可以参加这个游戏。

daily.en: The suburbanite commuted into town daily.
daily.zh: 这位郊区居民每天进城通勤。

daily.en: Avocational interests can enrich daily life.
daily.zh: 业余兴趣可以丰富日常生活。

daily.en: Religious observance shaped the town's daily life.
daily.zh: 宗教仪式影响了小镇的日常生活。

daily.en: He follows a strict daily routine.
daily.gloss: That occurs or attends every day, or at least every working day.
daily.zh: 他遵循严格的日常生活习惯。

fair.en: The court must mete out fair punishment.
fair.zh: 法院必须作出公平的惩罚。

fair.en: The essay distinguishes fair appraisal from detraction.
fair.zh: 这篇文章区分了公正评价与诋毁。

fair.en: Their performance has been only fair.
fair.gloss: Adequate, reasonable, or decent, but not excellent.

fair.en: She had fair hair and blue eyes.
fair.gloss: Light in color, pale, particularly with regard to skin tone but also referring to blond and red hair.
fair.zh: 她有一头金色的头发和蓝色的眼睛。

fair.en: He must be given a fair trial.
fair.zh: 他必须受到公正的审判。

pair.zh: 一双尺码不合适的鞋子。

pair.en: Spouses should make a great pair.
pair.gloss: Two people in a relationship, partnership or friendship.

pair.en: They turned a pair to end the fifth.
pair.gloss: A double play, two outs recorded in one play.
pair.zh: 他们转成一对，结束了第五局。

pair.en: The Pirates took a pair from the Phillies.
pair.gloss: A doubleheader, two games played on the same day between the same teams.
pair.zh: 海盗队从费城人队拿走了一对。

famous.en: Saul Hudson is a famous musician/songwriter.
famous.zh: 索尔·哈德森是一位著名的音乐家/词曲作家。

famous.en: She became famous as a prankster.

Some people are only famous within their city.
famous.zh: 有些人只在自己的城市里出名。

exercise.zh: 经常锻炼使他恢复了活力。

exercise.en: Supplementary exercises reinforce the main lesson.
exercise.zh: 补充练习巩固了主要课程内容。

exercise.en: Exercise helped him overcome his lethargy.
exercise.zh: 锻炼帮助他克服了倦怠。

exercise.gloss: Activity intended to improve physical, or sometimes mental, strength and fitness.; Such activity of physical nature, for physical fitness (plus also mental benefit).

exercise.en: I exercise at the gym every day.
exercise.gloss: To perform physical activity for health or training.
exercise.zh: 我每天都在健身房锻炼。

exercise.en: We urge the exercise of patience and restraint.
exercise.gloss: A setting in action or practicing; employment in the proper mode of activity; exertion; application; use.
exercise.zh: 我们敦促保持耐心和克制。

knee.en: My bad knee is troubling me.
knee.zh: 我的膝盖不好让我很烦恼。

knee.en: The statement "My knee hurts" is incorrigible.
knee.zh: “我的膝盖疼”这句话是无可救药的。

knee.en: He bounced the child on his knee.

desire.en: Too much desire can seriously affect one’s judgement.
desire.gloss: The feeling of desiring; an eager longing for something.

assessment.en: It is a just assessment of the facts.

injury.en: They sought requital for the injury.

injury.en: Slander is an injury to the character.
injury.gloss: The violation of a person's reputation, rights, property, or interests.

respect.en: Teachers inculcate respect for different viewpoints.
respect.zh: 老师们反复教导学生尊重不同观点。

respect.en: His estimable conduct earned widespread respect.
respect.zh: 他值得尊敬的行为赢得了广泛尊重。

respect.en: Her irreproachable conduct earned universal respect.
respect.zh: 她无可指责的行为赢得了普遍尊重。

northern.en: This tributary drains the northern upland.

nod.en: Jones nods the ball back to his goalkeeper.
nod.gloss: To head; to strike the ball with one's head.

fuel.zh: 空气动力学影响飞机的燃料消耗。

fuel.zh: 他们通过仔细规划节省燃料。

leaf.en: Infuse the leaves in hot water.
leaf.zh: 把这些叶子泡在热水里。

dry.en: Apply the cream liberally to dry skin.

Devin dried her eyes with a handkerchief.
This well is as dry as that cow.
dry.gloss: Unable to produce a liquid, as water, (petrochemistry) oil, or (agriculture) milk.

instruction.en: The instructions are clear and succinct.
He gabbled through the instructions without pausing.
instruction.zh: 他不停顿地急促念完了说明。

instruction.en: Conciseness improves the clarity of technical instructions.
instruction.zh: 简洁可提高技术说明的清晰度。

instruction.en: Students receive instruction in the arts and sciences.
instruction.gloss: The act of instructing, teaching, or providing with information or knowledge.
instruction.zh: 学生接受艺术和科学方面的指导。

pool.gloss: To put together; contribute to a common fund, on the basis of a mutual division of profits or losses; to make a common interest of.

pool.gloss: A combination of persons contributing money to be used for the purpose of increasing or depressing the market price of stocks, grain, or other commodities; also, the aggregate of the sums so contributed.

pool.en: It is a seasonal swimming pool.
pool.zh: 这是一个季节性游泳池。

climb.en: Climbing plants covered the wooden lattice.

climb.gloss: To mount; to move upwards on.

climb.en: He climbed into the passenger-seat of the car.
climb.gloss: To enter, mount or otherwise assume a position in or on a conveyance.

sweet.zh: 离别是多么甜蜜的悲伤。

expand.zh: 这支管弦乐队扩展了其古典保留曲目。

expand.en: The expanding city needs better public transport.
expand.zh: 不断扩张的城市需要更好的公共交通。

expand.gloss: To increase the extent, number, volume or scope of (something).

importance.en: These findings underscore the importance of prevention.

metal.zh: 铜是一种有延展性的金属。

fat.en: I saw Daniel crack a fat.

ticket.en: Does everybody have their ticket(s) at hand?

ticket.en: A ticket admits one into a playhouse.

ticket.gloss: A small document that acts as proof of something, often thereby granting the holder some ability.; A pass entitling the holder to board a train, a bus, a plane, or other means of transportation.

ticket.en: Joe will be running on an anti-crime ticket.

mental.zh: 心理语言学研究语言背后的心理过程。

mental.en: That was a mental party last night.
mental.gloss: Enjoyable or fun, especially in a frenetic way.

increasingly.en: Repaying the debt became increasingly burdensome.

planet.zh: 水圈包括这个星球上的水。

planet.en: Gravitation keeps the planets in orbital motion.

favorite.zh: 他最喜欢的格言强调谨慎而非急躁。

favorite.gloss: My favorite brand is the brand I like most.

enemy.zh: 恶棍开始诅咒他的敌人。

surround.zh: 同心圆环绕着中央徽记。

carefully.en: The carver shaped the wood carefully.

carefully.zh: 工厂仔细监测排出的废水。

carefully.zh: 包装工仔细封好了每个纸箱。

scientific.zh: 她天生的好奇心培养了科学志趣。

scientific.zh: 科学证据推翻了流行的神话。

impossible.zh: 从数学上来说，除以零是不可能的。

married.gloss: In a state of marriage; having a wife or a husband.

married.zh: 阿万嫁给了她的兄弟该隐。

married.en: I got married ten years ago.

instrument.zh: 仪器检测到放射性增加。

weather.zh: 芜菁在凉爽天气下生长良好。

presidential.zh: 丹·奎尔看上去不太像总统。

presidential.zh: 布什赢得 2004 年美国总统大选。

commitment.en: He assured of his commitment to her happiness.
commitment.zh: 他向她保证他会致力于让她幸福。

supreme.gloss: If something or someone is supreme, they are much better than normal.

bear.en: The wheel bears a radial load.

bear.en: We had barbecued bear for dinner.

pocket.en: The coins were chinking in his pocket.
pocket.zh: 硬币在他口袋里叮当作响。

pocket.en: His pocket watch was a beautiful timepiece.

thin.zh: 一条细丝连接着这两个细胞。

temperature.zh: 最适温度有利于种子发芽。

surprise.zh: 他直率的回答使委员会感到意外。

surprise.zh: 她大胆的计划使这个联合体感到意外。

proposal.en: The proposal offers a commonsense solution.
proposal.zh: 这个提议提供了一个合乎常识的解决方案。

proposal.en: The proposal's impracticality became immediately apparent.
proposal.zh: 这个提议不切实际之处立即显现了。

consequence.en: Critics decry the policy's adverse consequences.
consequence.zh: 批评者谴责这项政策的不良后果。

consequence.en: The war had ruinous economic consequences.
consequence.zh: 这场战争造成了毁灭性的经济后果。

consequence.en: This policy will assuredly have unforeseen consequences.
consequence.zh: 这项政策肯定会带来意想不到的后果。

breath.en: The child's breath came quickly and unevenly.
breath.gloss: The act or process of breathing.
breath.zh: 孩子的呼吸急促而不均匀。

breath.en: Bad breath is not pleasant for anyone.
breath.zh: 口臭对任何人来说都是不愉快的。

breath.en: The breath was as hot as fire.

sight.gloss: The sense or faculty by which objects are perceived through the agency of light; the sense by which we see.

sight.en: In their sight it was harmless.
sight.zh: 在他们看来，这是无害的。

balance.en: The ungainly fledgling struggled to balance.
balance.zh: 这只动作笨拙的幼鸟努力保持平衡。

balance.en: Water-skiing requires balance and suitable equipment.
balance.zh: 滑水需要平衡能力和合适的装备。

balance.en: Nontraditional students often balance work and study.
balance.zh: 非传统年龄段的学生常常兼顾工作和学业。

balance.en: The balance of the agreement remains in effect.
balance.zh: 协议的其余部分仍然有效。

balance.en: This final payment, or credit, balances the account.
balance.gloss: To make the credits and debits of (an account) correspond.
balance.zh: 最后的付款或贷方平衡了帐户。

adopt.en: The commonwealth adopted a bicameral legislature.
adopt.zh: 这个联邦采用了两院制立法机构。

adopt.en: The company adopted an expansive growth strategy.
adopt.zh: 公司采取了扩张性的发展战略。

adopt.en: The factory adopted a mechanized assembly process.
adopt.zh: 工厂采用了机械化装配流程。

adopt.en: We're going to adopt a Dalmatian.
adopt.gloss: To take (a child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.) by choice into a relationship.; To obtain (a pet) from a shelter or the wild.
adopt.zh: 我们要收养一只达尔马提亚狗。

adopt.en: These are resolutions that were adopted.
adopt.gloss: To select and take or approve.

adopt.en: We adopted an elephant at the local zoo.
adopt.gloss: To take (a child, heir, friend, citizen, etc.) by choice into a relationship.; To contribute towards the upkeep of (a child or animal), in exchange for occasional stories, pictures, etc.
adopt.zh: 我们在当地动物园收养了一头大象。

minority.en: They hold a minority interest in the company.
minority.gloss: Of or relating to a minority.
minority.zh: 他们持有该公司的少数股权。

minority.en: That political party is treading on minority rights.
minority.zh: 该政党正在践踏少数群体的权利。
Tatoeba 可以帮助少数民族语言吗？

straight.zh: 我的朋友们称异性恋为“异性恋”。

straight.gloss: Of a direction relative to the subject, precisely; as if following a direct line.

connect.en: Fraternal bonds connected the two societies.
connect.zh: 兄弟般的情谊把这两个社团联系起来。

connect.en: A narrow inlet connects to the sea.
connect.zh: 一条狭窄的海湾入口通向大海。

works.zh: 他的工作时间不便于社交。

works.en: The design's intricacy requires painstaking work.
works.zh: 这个设计的复杂性需要细致的工作。

works.en: Sensuous textures distinguish the sculptural work.
works.zh: 令人愉悦的质感使这件雕塑作品独具特色。

works.en: The steel works almost fills the valley.
works.gloss: A factory or factories, or a similar collection(s) of industrial facilities.
works.zh: 钢铁厂几乎填满了山谷。

works.en: I'll have a Behemoth Burger with the works.
works.gloss: Everything or everything that is available or possible; especially, all available toppings on food.
works.zh: 我要一份带有作品的巨兽汉堡。

teaching.en: I have found a teaching job.
teaching.gloss: The profession of educating people; the activity that a teacher does when he/she teaches.
teaching.zh: 我找到了一份教学工作。

belong.en: She belonged to an illustrious artistic family.
belong.zh: 她出身于一个声名显赫的艺术世家。

belong.en: The fossil belonged to an early hominid.
belong.zh: 这块化石属于一种早期人科动物。

belong.gloss: To be the property of, or be bound to by dependency or as an attribute.

belong.en: You don’t belong here — get out.
belong.gloss: To have its proper place.; To be accepted in a group.

belong.en: I don’t belong to the Southside Crew.
belong.gloss: To have its proper place.; To be a part of a group.

aid.en: Wind aids the dispersal of seeds.
Any aid will be warmly appreciated.
Slimming aids include dietary supplements and appetite suppressants.
aid.gloss: Something which helps; a material source of help.
aid.zh: 减肥辅助剂包括膳食补充剂和食欲抑制剂。

advice.zh: 她合乎常识的建议很有用。

advice.en: Her sagacious advice prevented a ruinous investment.
advice.zh: 她明智的建议避免了一次毁灭性的投资。

advice.en: Avoid platitudinous advice about complex personal problems.
advice.zh: 面对复杂的个人问题，应避免给出陈腐建议。

advice.en: My kids never listen to advice.
advice.gloss: An opinion offered to guide behavior in an effort to be helpful.
advice.zh: 我的孩子从来不听建议。

okay.gloss: If someone is okay, they are fine or not hurt.
You use okay to check if someone agrees with you.

okay.en: Did you okay this with your dad?
okay.gloss: If you okay something with somebody, you ask them to approve it.

okay.en: We got the okay to go ahead.
okay.gloss: If you give something your okay, you approve it.
okay.zh: 我们得到了继续前进的许可。

organize.zh: 他们举办了一场筹款音乐会。

organize.en: Our neighbourhood organizes an annual festival.
organize.zh: 我们街区每年组织一次节庆。

organize.en: The student organized his class notes.
organize.gloss: When you organize something, you plan or arrange it.
organize.zh: 该学生整理了他的课堂笔记。

empty.en: Empty the receptacle before cleaning it.
The nurse checked whether the room was empty.
empty.zh: 护士查看了房间是否无人。
原子大部分是空的空间。

empty.en: Put the empties out to be recycled.
empty.gloss: A container, especially a bottle, whose contents have been used up, leaving it empty.
empty.zh: 把空的东西拿出来回收。

empty.en: Empty cow rates have increased in recent years.
empty.gloss: Not pregnant; not producing offspring when expected to do so during the breeding season.
empty.zh: 近年来，空牛率有所上升。

regional.en: The syndicate purchased several regional newspapers.
regional.zh: 这个企业联合组织收购了几家地区报纸。

regional.en: They administrate several regional research grants.
regional.zh: 他们管理着几项地区研究资助。

regional.en: A suburbanite may depend on regional transport.
regional.zh: 郊区居民可能依赖区域交通。

trail.en: The telescope detected a brief meteoric trail.
trail.zh: 望远镜探测到了一条短暂的流星轨迹。

trail.gloss: The track or indication marking the route followed by something that has passed, such as the footprints of animal on land or the contrail of an airplane in the sky.

trail.en: The yellow blazes denote the trail.
The trail led straight to the perpetrator.
trail.gloss: evidence pointing to a possible solution

trail.zh: 这条线索直接通向肇事者。

novel.en: Critics laud the novel's subtle characterization.
novel.zh: 评论家赞扬这部小说细腻的人物刻画。

novel.en: The novel explores the futility of revenge.
novel.zh: 这部小说探讨了复仇的徒劳。

novel.en: The novel uses naturalistic descriptions of poverty.
novel.zh: 这部小说使用了对贫困的自然主义描写。

code.gloss: A set of rules for converting information into another form or representation.; A codeword, code point, an encoded representation of a character, symbol, or other entity.

code.en: I wrote some code to reformat text documents.
code.gloss: Instructions for a computer, written in a programming language; the input of a translator, an interpreter or a browser, namely: source code, machine code, bytecode.
code.zh: 我编写了一些代码来重新格式化文本文档。

somehow.zh: 不知何故，这个秘密泄露了。

somehow.en: I'll somehow manage to get by.
This problem has to be tackled somehow.
somehow.gloss: In one way or another; in a way not yet known or explained; by some means
somehow.zh: 这个问题必须以某种方式解决。

jury.en: The judge sequestered the jury during deliberations.
jury.zh: 法官在审议期间将陪审团隔离。

jury.en: The jury finds for the defendant.
jury.zh: 陪审团作出有利于被告的裁决。

jury.en: Jury selection isn't an exact science.
jury.zh: 陪审团的选择并不是一门精确的科学。

jury.en: The jury says the person is not guilty.
jury.gloss: A jury is a group of people who decide a court case's result.

breast.en: Tanya’s breasts grew remarkably during pregnancy.
breast.gloss: Either of the two organs on the front of a female human's chest, which contain the mammary glands; also the analogous organs in males.
breast.zh: 坦尼娅的乳房在怀孕期间显着增大。

breast.en: The robin has a red breast.
breast.gloss: The ventral portion of an animal’s thorax.
breast.zh: 知更鸟有一个红色的乳房。

breast.en: Would you like breast or wing?
breast.gloss: A choice cut of poultry, especially chicken or turkey, taken from the bird’s breast; also a cut of meat from other animals, breast of mutton, veal, pork.

acknowledge.en: She would scarcely deign to acknowledge him.
The robot bleeped to acknowledge its new instructions.
acknowledge.zh: 机器人发出嘟嘟声以确认新指令。

theme.en: The keywords summarize the article's central themes.
theme.zh: 这些关键词概括了文章的核心主题。

theme.en: These stamps have a Christmas theme.
theme.zh: 这些邮票有圣诞节主题。

theme.en: We themed the birthday party around superheroes.
theme.zh: 我们以超级英雄为主题举办生日派对。

theme.en: It was the usual ‘boy gets girl’ theme.
theme.gloss: a unifying idea that is a recurrent element in literary or artistic work

theme.zh: 这是通常的“男孩得到女孩”的主题。

storm.en: The storm damaged several outlying farms.
storm.zh: 暴风雨损坏了几处偏远农场。

storm.en: The old cottonwood survived the storm.
storm.zh: 那棵老三角叶杨经受住了暴风雨。

storm.gloss: Preceded by the dummy subject it: to have strong winds and usually lightning and thunder, and/or hail, rain, or snow.
storm.zh: 整个晚上都在狂风暴雨。

storm.gloss: To violently assault (a fortified position or stronghold, a building, etc.) with the aim of gaining control of it.
storm.zh: 军队袭击了这座建筑群。

storm.en: She stormed out of the room.
storm.gloss: To move noisily and quickly like a storm (noun etymology 1, noun sense 1), usually in a state of anger or uproar.

union.en: Union leaders slammed the new proposals.
union.zh: 工会领导人猛烈抨击了新提议。

union.en: Lightning produced an unusual union of the metals.
union.gloss: the occurrence of a uniting of separate parts

union.zh: 闪电使金属产生了不寻常的结合。

union.en: The union reps gave us a bum deal!
union.zh: 工会代表给了我们一笔不划算的交易！

desk.en: Her desk is covered with yellow stickies.
desk.zh: 她的桌子上贴满了黄色便利贴。

desk.en: The breeze rustled the papers on her desk.
desk.zh: 微风吹得她桌上的文件沙沙作响。

thanks.en: She indited a courteous letter of thanks.
thanks.zh: 她写了一封礼貌的感谢信。

fruit.en: Fruit maturation depends partly on temperature.
fruit.zh: 果实成熟在一定程度上取决于温度。

expensive.zh: 那家餐馆看起来贵得可怕。

expensive.en: Motor insurance is expensive for youngsters.
expensive.zh: 汽车保险对于年轻人来说很昂贵。

expensive.en: A pencil that cost $100 is very expensive.
expensive.gloss: Something that is expensive costs a lot of money to buy or takes a lot of effort to get.
expensive.zh: 一支100美元的铅笔非常昂贵。

yellow.en: Gimme two of them yellow ones.
The yellow blazes denote the trail.
He had a yellow laptop in his bag.
yellow.zh: 他的包里有一台黄色笔记本电脑。

conclusion.en: The conclusion rests on a fallacious assumption.
conclusion.zh: 这个结论建立在错误假定上。

conclusion.en: The fragmentary evidence supports only conjectural conclusions.
conclusion.zh: 零碎的证据仅支持推测性的结论。

conclusion.en: His conclusion is warrantable from the evidence.
conclusion.zh: 他的结论可以从证据中得到证明。

prime.gloss: Having exactly two integral factors: itself and unity (1 in the case of integers).

prime.en: The boys are primed for mischief.
prime.zh: 男孩们已经做好了恶作剧的准备。

prime.en: I speak for the Prime Minister.

prime.gloss: A prime element of a mathematical structure, particularly a prime number.

prime.en: I'm threatening to build a prime here.
prime.gloss: A series of consecutive blocks. A prime of six prevents the opponent's pieces from passing.
prime.zh: 我威胁要在这里建造一个总理。

prime.en: This is a prime location for a bookstore.
prime.gloss: First in excellence, quality, or value.

shadow.en: A sundial tells time by casting shadows.
shadow.zh: 日晷通过投射阴影来显示时间。

shadow.en: The X-ray showed a shadow on his lung.
shadow.gloss: A dark image projected onto a surface where light (or other radiation) is blocked by the shade of an object.
shadow.zh: X光检查显示他的肺部有阴影。

shadow.en: I lived in her shadow my whole life.
shadow.gloss: That which looms as though a shadow.
shadow.zh: 我一生都生活在她的阴影下。

shadow.en: Looks like that cloud's going to shadow us.
shadow.gloss: To block light or radio transmission from.
shadow.zh: 看来那朵云要遮蔽我们了。

struggle.en: The ungainly fledgling struggled to balance.
struggle.zh: 这只动作笨拙的幼鸟努力保持平衡。

struggle.en: The family struggled to escape penury.
struggle.zh: 这家人艰难地试图摆脱贫困。

struggle.en: The fractious committee struggled to reach consensus.
struggle.zh: 这个分歧重重的委员会难以达成共识。

struggle.en: One of the doctor’s patients struggled with depression.
struggle.zh: 这位医生的一位病人患有抑郁症。

struggle.en: She struggled to escape from her assailant's grasp.
struggle.gloss: To strive, or to make efforts, with a twisting, or with contortions of the body.
struggle.zh: 她挣扎着逃离袭击者的掌控。

conclude.en: The performance concluded with considerable eclat.
conclude.zh: 这场演出以巨大成功告终。

conclude.en: The story concluded with a moral.
conclude.gloss: To end; to come to an end.
conclude.zh: 这个故事以一个寓意结束。

conclude.en: The defendant is concluded by his own plea.
conclude.gloss: To shut off; to restrain; to limit; to estop; to bar.
conclude.zh: 被告通过自己的抗辩得出结论。

dance.zh: 不要模仿我的舞蹈动作。

dance.en: Have you ever danced the tango?

dance.gloss: To make love or have sex.

dance.en: I danced with her all night long.
dance.gloss: To move with rhythmic steps or movements, especially in time to music.

analyst.zh: 分析师预计不会出现任何意外。
你有一位出色的分析师。

regulation.en: The burdensome regulations discouraged new businesses.
regulation.zh: 繁重的规定使新企业望而却步。

regulation.en: The government will promulgate new safety regulations.
regulation.zh: 政府将颁布新的安全法规。

being.en: Her surmise proved to be correct.
being.zh: 她的推测被证明是正确的。

being.en: They proved to be congenial companions.
being.zh: 事实证明他们是意气相投的伙伴。

being.en: Be chary of accepting extravagant promises.

ring.en: Cut the onion into concentric rings.
This ring holds a two-carat aquamarine.
ring.zh: 这枚戒指镶着一颗两克拉的海蓝宝石。

ring.gloss: To produce the sound of a bell or a similar sound.
Of something spoken or written, to appear to be, to seem, to sound.

ring.en: The bells were ringing in the town.
ring.gloss: Of a bell, etc., to produce a resonant sound.

ring.en: I will ring you when we arrive.
ring.zh: 当我们到达时我会给你打电话。

largely.zh: 他们的叙述仍主要是推测性的。
他发现青霉素很大程度上是偶然的。
他的工作主要是非政府的。

largely.en: They were largely successful in their efforts.
largely.gloss: For the most part; mainly or chiefly.
largely.zh: 他们的努力基本上取得了成功。

shift.zh: 他的政治立场每天都在变化。

shift.en: Does it come with a stick-shift?
shift.gloss: The gear mechanism in a motor vehicle.

shift.en: She shifted slightly in her seat.
shift.zh: 她在座位上轻轻动了动。

shift.en: We are shifting to America next month.
shift.gloss: To change residence; to leave and live elsewhere.
shift.zh: 我们下个月要搬到美国。

shift.en: How can I shift a grass stain?
I finally shifted to Hogwarts last night!
shift.gloss: To use meditation or other means to change the reality that one's consciousness resides in.
shift.zh: 昨晚我终于搬到了霍格沃茨！

revenue.en: The statute forbids officials to peculate revenue.
revenue.zh: 法律禁止官员侵吞公共收入。

revenue.en: I was disappointed by last year’s revenue.
revenue.zh: 我对去年的收入感到失望。

revenue.en: The company's 2005 revenue exceeds that of 2004.

locate.en: Aural cues help us locate sounds.
locate.zh: 听觉线索帮助我们判断声音的位置。

locate.en: I really can't locate the sever files.
locate.gloss: To find out where something is located.
locate.zh: 我真的找不到服务器文件。

locate.en: The council must locate the new hospital.
locate.gloss: To designate the site or place of; to define the limits of (Note: the designation may be purely descriptive: it need not be prescriptive.)
locate.zh: 委员会必须找到新医院的地点。

mark.en: A tiny flyspeck marked the window.
mark.zh: 窗上有一个小小的苍蝇斑点。

mark.en: The musician marked the flats carefully.
mark.zh: 音乐家仔细标出了降号。

mark.en: The centennial marked a century of progress.
mark.zh: 百年纪念标志着一个世纪的发展。

mark.gloss: To record that (someone) has a particular status.

mark.en: Prices are marked on individual items.
mark.gloss: To indicate (something) in writing or by other symbols.
mark.zh: 价格标注在个别商品上。

mark.en: Some animals mark their territory by urinating.
mark.gloss: To create an indication of (a location).
mark.zh: 有些动物通过排尿来标记自己的领地。

appearance.en: The portrait emphasizes his hirsute appearance.
appearance.zh: 肖像强调了他多毛的外貌。

appearance.gloss: The act of appearing or coming into sight; the act of becoming visible to the eye.
appearance.zh: 他的突然出现让我吃了一惊。
呈现出干瘪、萎缩的样子。

appearance.en: There was a strange appearance in the sky.
appearance.gloss: A thing seen; a phenomenon; an apparition.
appearance.zh: 天空中出现了奇异的景象。

package.en: The vacation package includes car rental.
package.zh: 假期套餐包括汽车租赁。

package.en: A dirty package was left in my home.
package.gloss: Something which is packed, a parcel, a box, an envelope.
package.zh: 我家留下了一个脏包裹。

difficulty.en: She surmounted many difficulties during her training.
difficulty.zh: 她在培训期间克服了许多困难。

difficulty.en: I'm having difficulty getting up the stairs.
We negotiated the mountain track with difficulty.
difficulty.zh: 我们艰难地通过了山路。

bridge.en: Our forefathers built this venerable stone bridge.
bridge.zh: 我们的祖先建造了这座古老的石桥。

bridge.en: An eddy formed behind the bridge's pillar.
bridge.zh: 桥墩后面形成了一个漩涡。

bridge.en: The rope bridge crosses the river.
bridge.gloss: A construction or natural feature that spans a divide.; A construction spanning a waterway, ravine, or valley from a height, allowing for the passage of vehicles, pedestrians, trains, etc.

bridge.en: The first officer is on the bridge.
bridge.gloss: An arch or superstructure.; An elevated platform above the upper deck of a mechanically propelled ship from which it is navigated and from which all activities on deck can be seen and controlled by the captain, etc; smaller ships have a wheelhouse, and sailing ships were controlled from a quarterdeck.

bridge.en: The LAN bridge uses a spanning tree algorithm.
bridge.gloss: A connection, real or abstract.; A system which connects two or more local area networks at layer 2 of OSI model.
bridge.zh: LAN 网桥使用生成树算法。

recommend.en: The dietitian recommended a healthful eating plan.
recommend.zh: 营养师推荐了一份健康饮食计划。

recommend.en: Dentists recommend several toothbrushings per day.
recommend.zh: 牙医建议每天刷几次牙。

recommend.en: A city that has much to recommend it.
recommend.gloss: To make acceptable; to attract favor to.
recommend.zh: 一个有很多值得推荐的城市。

obvious.en: Her obvious nervousness belied what she said.
obvious.zh: 她明显的紧张与她所说的不符。

obvious.en: Used with an implied object obvious from context.
obvious.zh: 与从上下文中显而易见的隐含对象一起使用。

obvious.en: The glitz of the award ceremony was obvious.
obvious.zh: 颁奖典礼的华丽程度可见一斑。

basically.zh: 他的哲学基本上是普世主义。

basically.en: I shouldn't have done it, basically.
basically.gloss: Used to refer to the most important or fundamental point that the speaker is making or to indicate a generalization or simplification; sometimes tending towards a meaningless filler word.
basically.zh: 基本上我不应该这样做。

basically.en: The material of his character was basically good.
