equal.gloss: The same in one or more respects.; The same in all respects that matter practically; interchangeable, fungible, or (even sometimes) identical for practical purposes.
equal.zh: 同等的条件应该产生同等的结果。

frame.en: The stove has a cast-iron frame.
frame.zh: 这个炉子有一个铸铁框架。

frame.en: The carpenter chose softwood for the frame.
frame.zh: 木匠选择了软木来做框架。

frame.en: The manufacturer offers a rustproof metal frame.
frame.zh: 制造商提供防锈金属框架。

frame.en: How would you frame your accomplishments?
frame.gloss: To construct in words so as to establish a context for understanding or interpretation.
frame.zh: 你会如何构建你的成就？

frame.en: Round glasses would frame your face perfectly.
frame.gloss: To position visually within a fixed boundary.
frame.zh: 圆形眼镜可以完美修饰您的脸型。

forth.en: He trod back and forth wearily.
Their orchard brings forth magnificent fruit.
forth.zh: 他们的果园结出硕果累累的果实。

typical.gloss: of a feature that helps to distinguish a person or thing

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

typical.en: This behaviour is typical of teenagers.
typical.zh: 这种行为是青少年的典型行为。

typical.en: Sheep are typical in the Irish landscape.
typical.zh: 羊是爱尔兰风景中的典型代表。

except.zh: 除了肛交，我什么都会做。

except.en: To survive, I did everything except steal.
except.gloss: Used to introduce a clause, phrase, verb infinitive, adverb or other non-noun complement forming an exception or qualification to something previously stated.
except.zh: 为了生存，除了偷窃，我什么都做了。

except.en: Our ideas coincide, except in certain areas.
except.zh: 我们的想法是一致的，除了某些领域。

eliminate.en: Curative treatment aims to eliminate the disease.
eliminate.zh: 治愈性治疗的目标是消除疾病。

eliminate.en: Heaven will eliminate the tyrannical regimes.

eliminate.zh: 他们消除了所有的缺陷。

hall.zh: 这个大厅几乎不需要装饰。

hall.en: They bedeck the hall with flowers.
The engineer tested the hall's acoustical properties.
hall.zh: 工程师测试了大厅的声学性能。

hall.en: The drinking fountain was out in the hall.

host.en: The genial host welcomed us warmly.
host.zh: 和蔼的主人热情地欢迎了我们。

host.en: The convivial host encouraged lively conversation.
host.zh: 这位好交际的主人鼓励大家热烈交谈。

host.en: The tapeworm lives inside its host.
Kremvax hosts a variety of services.
host.gloss: To run software made available to a remote user or process.

host.en: I was terrible at hosting that show.
host.gloss: To perform the role of a host.
host.zh: 我主持那个节目的表现很糟糕。

trust.zh: 他直率的态度使人信任。

trust.en: Her probity earned the consortium's trust.
trust.zh: 她的正直赢得了联合体的信任。

trust.en: They transact business through a trusted intermediary.
trust.zh: 他们通过可信的中间人进行交易。

trust.en: We cannot trust anyone who deceives us.
trust.gloss: To place confidence in, to rely on, to confide in.
trust.zh: 我们不能相信任何欺骗我们的人。

trust.en: I trust you have cleaned your room?
trust.gloss: To hope confidently; to believe (usually with a phrase or infinitive clause as the object)
trust.zh: 我相信你已经打扫过你的房间了吗？

trust.en: You'll get your money back bro, trust.
trust.gloss: Ellipsis of trust me, often used sarcastically or self-mockingly.
trust.zh: 兄弟，你会拿回你的钱的，相信。

ocean.en: Primordial life developed in ancient oceans.
ocean.zh: 原始生命在古代海洋中形成。

ocean.en: The submerged seamount rises from the ocean floor.

ocean.zh: 海洋的潮汐最令人印象深刻。

row.en: I went for an early-morning row.
row.gloss: An act or instance of rowing.

row.en: Pit row was abuzz with activity.

producer.en: Maine is a leading producer of potatoes.

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

producer.zh: 缅因州是马铃薯的主要生产国。

producer.en: Louisiana is a major producer of tabascos.
producer.zh: 路易斯安那州是塔巴斯科烟的主要产地。

producer.en: The producer hopes nobody goes up opening night.
producer.zh: 制片人希望没有人参加首映之夜。

afford.en: Actuarially, we can't really afford to retire.
afford.zh: 事实上，我们真的负担不起退休的费用。

afford.en: A good life affords consolation in old age.
afford.gloss: To give, grant, or confer, with a remoter reference to its being the natural result; to provide; to furnish.
afford.zh: 美好的生活可以给晚年带来安慰。

afford.en: To put it simply, we can't afford it.

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile the socialists are running the government.
meanwhile.gloss: the time between one event, process, or period and another

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，社会主义者正在管理政府。
与此同时，新的一年开始了。
与此同时，时间已经不多了。

neighbour.en: My neighbour has two noisy cats.
neighbour.gloss: A person living on adjacent or nearby land; a person situated adjacently or nearby; anything (of the same type of thing as the subject) in an adjacent or nearby position.
neighbour.zh: 我的邻居有两只吵闹的猫。

neighbour.en: He made friends with his new neighbour.
neighbour.zh: 他和他的新邻居成了朋友。

neighbour.en: That sort of talk is neighbouring on treason.
neighbour.gloss: To be similar to, to be almost the same as.
neighbour.zh: 这种言论与叛国罪相邻。

regime.en: Heaven will eliminate the tyrannical regimes.
regime.gloss: A form of government, or the government in power, particularly an authoritarian or totalitarian one.

regime.en: The regime relied on political indoctrination in schools.
regime.zh: 该政权依靠学校的政治灌输。
压迫政权不会永远存在。

division.en: Magnolias belong to the division Magnoliophyta.
division.gloss: A rank below kingdom and above class, particularly used of plants or fungi, also (particularly of animals) called a phylum; a taxon at that rank.

division.en: Tomorrow's class will cover long division.
Division is the reverse of multiplication.

fix.en: The annuity pays a fixed yearly amount.
fix.zh: 这份年金每年支付固定金额。
你无法解决愚蠢的问题。

fix.en: She fixed dinner for the kids.
fix.zh: 她为孩子们准备了晚餐。

fix.en: We have a fix on your position.
fix.zh: 我们已经确定了你的立场。

fix.en: Some pizza rolls would fix me right now.
fix.gloss: To mend, to repair.; To be immensely pleasurable to.
fix.zh: 一些披萨卷现在就能解决我的问题。

confirm.en: I cannot confirm what they purport.
confirm.zh: 我无法证实他们声称的内容。

confirm.en: No existent record confirms the disputed claim.
confirm.zh: 没有现存记录能证实这项有争议的说法。

confirm.en: This is confirm not my handwriting.
The Senate must confirm federal court appointments.
confirm.gloss: To approve a proposal or nomination.
confirm.zh: 参议院必须确认联邦法院的任命。

appeal.en: This video game won’t appeal to muggles.
appeal.zh: 这款视频游戏不会吸引麻瓜。

appeal.en: An urgent appeal was sent out for assistance.
appeal.zh: 已发出紧急呼吁寻求援助。

mirror.en: The mirror produced an undistorted image.
mirror.zh: 这面镜子形成了一幅未失真的像。

mirror.en: He ingeniously used mirrors to redirect light.
mirror.zh: 他巧妙地用镜子改变了光的方向。

mirror.en: The mirror gave a distorted reflection.
He broke the mirror with the pickaxe.
mirror.gloss: A smooth surface, usually made of glass with reflective material painted on the underside, that reflects light so as to give an image of what is in front of it.

tooth.en: The edentate animal lacked front teeth.
tooth.zh: 这只缺齿动物没有门牙。

tooth.en: Jute has more tooth than polypropylene.
tooth.gloss: The property of resisting slippage when knotted.
tooth.zh: 黄麻比聚丙烯有更多的齿。

length.en: One line overruns another in length.
length.zh: 一条线的长度超过另一条线。

length.en: The centimetre is a unit of length.
He spoke at great length on the topic.
length.zh: 他就这个话题发表了长篇大论。

smart.gloss: Cleverly shrewd and humorous in a way that may be rude and disrespectful.

smart.en: You look smart in that business suit.
smart.zh: 你穿那套西装看起来很聪明。

smart.en: She's not as smart as all that.

rely.en: The portrayal relies on vivid imagery.
rely.zh: 这种描写依靠生动的意象。

rely.en: The animal relies on olfactory signals.
rely.zh: 这种动物依赖嗅觉信号。

rely.en: Their account relied on scanty evidence.
rely.zh: 他们的说法依赖少量证据。

rely.en: The city relies on the subway system.
rely.gloss: To depend; to be dependent upon.
rely.zh: 这个城市依赖地铁系统。

entirely.zh: 这个发现完全出于偶然。

entirely.en: Some decorative elements are entirely dispensable.
entirely.zh: 有些装饰元素完全可以省去。

entirely.gloss: To the exclusion of others; solely.

association.en: All the teachers were at an association meeting.
association.gloss: An association is a group of people who have a common goal or interest.
association.zh: 所有老师都参加了协会会议。

association.en: The association announced its endorsement of the policy.
association.zh: 该协会宣布支持该政策。
这个词有令人不愉快的联想。

complain.en: It ill behooves my mother to complain.
complain.zh: 我妈妈抱怨是不应该的。

complain.en: They've complained about me to the police again.
complain.gloss: To make a formal accusation or bring a formal charge.

topic.zh: 这个话题始终具有现实意义。

topic.en: Concurrent sessions cover different research topics.
topic.zh: 同时进行的会议讨论不同研究主题。

topic.en: This topic is not open to discussion.

variable.en: Change only one variable at a time.
There are several variables to consider here.
variable.gloss: Something whose value may be dictated or discovered.
variable.zh: 这里有几个变量需要考虑。

telephone.gloss: If you telephone someone, you use a telephone to talk to them.
telephone.zh: 我昨天给我朋友打电话了。

telephone.en: We installed a bug in her telephone.
telephone.zh: 我们在她的电话里安装了一个窃听器。

telephone.en: Her telephone has been busy all day.
telephone.zh: 她的电话一整天都占线。

perception.zh: 听觉训练提高音乐感知能力。

attract.en: Hollywood's glamour attracted the young performer.
attract.zh: 好莱坞的魅力吸引了这位年轻表演者。

attract.en: The unspoiled coastline attracted the naturalist.
attract.zh: 这片未遭破坏的海岸吸引了博物学家。

attract.en: The anode attracts negatively charged particles.
attract.zh: 阳极吸引带负电的粒子。

attract.en: Advertising is designed to attract customers.
attract.gloss: To draw by moral, emotional or sexual influence; to engage or fix, as the mind, attention, etc.; to invite or allure.
attract.zh: 广告的目的是吸引顾客。

secret.zh: 不知何故，这个秘密泄露了。

secret.en: We went down a secret passage.
secret.zh: 我们沿着一条秘密通道走下去。

secret.en: The secret to a long-lasting marriage is compromise.
secret.gloss: The key or principle by which something is made clear; the knack.
secret.zh: 婚姻长久的秘诀就是妥协。

bedroom.en: The apartment has a spacious bedroom.
Please don't enter my bedroom without knocking.
bedroom.gloss: A room in a house, apartment, hotel, or other dwelling where a bed is kept for sleeping.
bedroom.zh: 请不要在不敲门的情况下进入我的卧室。

confidence.en: The actor declaimed the prologue with confidence.
confidence.zh: 演员自信地朗诵了序幕。

confidence.en: Experience may endue the apprentice with confidence.
confidence.zh: 经验可能赋予学徒信心。

confidence.en: He entered the ring with confidence.
confidence.zh: 他满怀信心地走进了擂台。

confidence.en: She had confidence it would soon end.
confidence.gloss: A feeling of certainty; firm trust or belief; faith.
confidence.zh: 她有信心这一切很快就会结束。

debt.en: Repaying the debt became increasingly burdensome.
debt.zh: 偿还债务变得越来越沉重。

debt.en: Debt encumbered the family's inherited property.
debt.zh: 债务使这家人的继承财产背上负担。

debt.en: Improvident decisions left the family in debt.
debt.zh: 缺乏远见的决定使这家人负债。

debt.gloss: The state or condition of owing something to another.

rare.en: The naturalist identified a rare lichen.
rare.zh: 这位博物学家辨认出了一种稀有地衣。

rare.en: This is a rare fivepenny stamp.
rare.zh: 这是一张罕见的五便士邮票。

rare.en: Plants with dimerous flowers are fairly rare.
rare.zh: 具有二聚花的植物相当罕见。

tank.en: The engineer inspected the propellant tank.
tank.zh: 工程师检查了推进剂储箱。

tank.en: Please top up the tank tonight.
The propane is stored in these tanks.
tank.gloss: A closed container for liquids or gases.

nurse.en: The nurse monitored his postoperative recovery.
nurse.zh: 护士监测了他的术后恢复情况。

nurse.en: The nurse offered solicitous postoperative care.
nurse.zh: 护士提供了细心的术后护理。

nurse.en: The nurse checked whether the room was empty.
nurse.zh: 护士查看了房间是否无人。

nurse.en: She nursed him back to health.
nurse.gloss: To care for (someone), especially in sickness; to tend to.
nurse.zh: 她精心护理他，让他恢复健康。

nurse.en: Rob was nursing a small beer.
nurse.gloss: To drink (a beverage) slowly, so as to make it last.
nurse.zh: 罗布正在喝一小杯啤酒。

nurse.en: Would you like to nurse the puppy?
nurse.gloss: To hold closely to one's chest.

opposition.en: The proposal met with stiff opposition.
opposition.zh: 该提议遭到了强烈反对。

opposition.en: This law would effectively shackle its opposition.
opposition.zh: 这项法律将有效地束缚其反对派。

opposition.en: They met the proposal with stiff opposition.
opposition.zh: 他们对该提议表示强烈反对。

opposition.en: These ideas are in opposition to each other.
opposition.zh: 这些想法是相互对立的。

coverage.en: The postelection television coverage was canceled.
coverage.zh: 选举后的电视报道被取消。

coverage.en: There are overlapping coverages on your insurance policies.
coverage.gloss: An amount by which something or someone is covered.
coverage.zh: 您的保单承保范围有重叠。

coverage.en: Mobile phone coverage is poor in some areas.
coverage.gloss: The signal strength, reception of a radio signal.
coverage.zh: 某些地区的移动电话覆盖率较差。

aside.en: I stepped aside to let her pass.
The minister will stand aside during the investigation.
aside.zh: 部长将在调查期间站在一旁。

anywhere.gloss: Any location or an unknown location.

anywhere.en: Are you going anywhere special this weekend?
anywhere.gloss: To (in the direction of) any location.
anywhere.zh: 这个周末你要去什么特别的地方吗？

bond.en: Fraternal bonds connected the two societies.
bond.zh: 兄弟般的情谊把这两个社团联系起来。

bond.en: The adhesive bonds glass to metal.
bond.zh: 这种黏合剂把玻璃与金属黏合起来。

bond.en: Music helps forge strong bonds between people.
bond.zh: 音乐有助于在人们之间建立牢固纽带。

bond.en: The contractor was bonded with a local underwriter.
bond.gloss: To guarantee or secure a financial risk.
bond.zh: 承包商与当地承销商有保证金。

pleasure.en: Their pleasure was alloyed with misfortune.
pleasure.zh: 他们的快乐与不幸交织在一起。

pleasure.en: She grinned pleasure at his embarrassment.
pleasure.zh: 她因他的尴尬而高兴地笑了。

pleasure.en: Hereby I make known my pleasure.
It was a pleasure to meet you.
pleasure.gloss: A person, thing or action that causes enjoyment.

pleasure.en: What is your pleasure: coffee or tea?
pleasure.zh: 您喜欢什么：咖啡还是茶？

pleasure.en: He remembered with pleasure his home and family.
pleasure.gloss: A state of being pleased or contented; gratification.
pleasure.zh: 他高兴地回忆起他的家和家人。

master.en: Her matchless skill astonished the master carver.
master.zh: 她无与伦比的技巧使雕刻大师惊讶。

master.en: She has a master in psychology.
master.gloss: A master's degree; a type of postgraduate degree, usually undertaken after a bachelor degree.
master.zh: 她拥有心理学硕士学位。

master.en: The master bath has two sinks.
Mark Twain was a master of fiction.
master.zh: 马克·吐温是一位小说大师。

master.en: He is a master of marine biology.
master.gloss: A person holding such a degree.

master.en: Many modern recording artists value owning their masters.
master.gloss: The copyright in a sound recording.
master.zh: 许多现代唱片艺术家都珍视拥有他们的母带。

era.en: Dinosaurs lived during the Mesozoic era.
era.gloss: A geological series of rocks laid down over several hundred million years.

era.en: The Renaissance was a golden era.
era.zh: 文艺复兴是一个黄金时代。

era.en: It ushered in a whole new era.
era.zh: 它开创了一个全新的时代。

requirement.en: Citizenship is a requirement for eligibility.
requirement.zh: 公民身份是资格的要求。

fun.zh: 这个游戏一点也不好玩。

fun.en: I do it for the fun of it.
fun.gloss: activities that are enjoyable or amusing

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

fun.en: We had a fun time at the party.
fun.zh: 我们在聚会上度过了一段愉快的时光。

wing.en: The child watched the dragonfly's delicate wings.
wing.zh: 孩子看着蜻蜓纤细的翅膀。

wing.en: Would you like breast or wing?
Only make the right wing strong.

expectation.en: Her research's fruitfulness exceeded their expectations.
expectation.zh: 她的研究取得的丰硕成果超出了预期。

expectation.en: We questioned the impracticality of his expectations.
expectation.zh: 我们质疑了他的期望不切实际。

expectation.en: He struggled with his parents' expectations.
expectation.gloss: That which is expected or looked for.; An implicit obligation or duty held by another in someone's view.
expectation.zh: 他与父母的期望作斗争。

separate.en: Each subcommittee submitted a separate report.
separate.zh: 各小组委员会分别提交了一份报告。

separate.en: Each subsection addresses a separate issue.
separate.zh: 每个小节处理一个独立问题。

separate.en: Each datum represents a separate observation.
separate.zh: 每个数据点代表一次独立观测。

separate.en: Separate the articles from the headings.
separate.gloss: To divide (a thing) into separate parts.

somewhat.en: Ufology is a somewhat Fortean subject.
somewhat.zh: 不明飞行物学是一个有点Fortean 主题。

somewhat.en: That hat seems somewhat small for him.
somewhat.gloss: To a limited extent or degree; not completely.
somewhat.zh: 那顶帽子对他来说似乎有点小。

pour.en: to pour out sand or dust.
pour.gloss: To cause (liquid, or liquid-like substance) to flow in a stream, either out of a container or into it.
To flow, pass, or issue in a stream; to fall continuously and abundantly.

pour.en: Pour the tea into the cup.
The people poured out of the theater.
pour.gloss: To move in a throng, as a crowd.

stir.en: The torpid animal stirred as spring approached.
stir.zh: 随着春天临近，蛰伏的动物开始活动。

stir.en: Political debates often stir up animosity.
stir.zh: 政治辩论常常激起敌意。

stir.en: The news story caused a stir.
stir.zh: 这则新闻报道引起了轰动。

stir.en: She stirred the pudding with a spoon.
stir.gloss: To disturb the relative position of the particles (of a liquid or similar) by passing an object through it.

stir.en: Can you give the soup a little stir?
stir.gloss: The act or result of stirring (moving around the particles of a liquid etc.)
stir.zh: 你能稍微搅拌一下汤吗？

judgment.zh: 酒精中毒会损害判断力。

judgment.en: An impersonal report avoids subjective judgments.
judgment.zh: 客观的报告避免主观判断。

judgment.en: Her esthetic judgment favored simple forms.
judgment.zh: 她的审美判断偏爱简洁的形式。

judgment.en: We will hear the judgment soon.
judgment.gloss: A judgment is the something decided by a judge. It is an official order by a court.
judgment.zh: 我们很快就会听到判决。

judgment.en: I'll trust your judgment on this matter.
judgment.gloss: Judgment is being able to make good choices.
judgment.zh: 我会相信你对这件事的判断。

beer.en: Can I buy you a beer?
beer.gloss: A glass, bottle, or can of any of the above beverages.
beer.zh: 我可以给你买瓶啤酒吗？

beer.en: I haven't tried this beer before.
beer.gloss: A variety of the above beverages.
beer.zh: 我以前没喝过这种啤酒。

beer.en: Beer is brewed all over the world.
beer.gloss: An alcoholic drink fermented from starch material, commonly barley malt; often with hops or some other substance (like gruit) to impart a bitter flavor.

reference.en: Her oblique reference puzzled the audience.
reference.zh: 她间接的提及让观众感到困惑。

reference.en: The open-book examination permits printed reference material.
reference.zh: 这场开卷考试允许使用印刷参考资料。

reference.en: Reference the dictionary for word meanings.
reference.gloss: To cite, to use as a reference.
reference.zh: 参考字典了解单词含义。

reference.en: Reference to an encyclopedia produced the answer.
reference.gloss: the act of referring or consulting

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

reference.zh: 参考百科全书给出了答案。

tear.en: He was torn by conflicting emotions.
tear.gloss: To destroy or reduce abstract unity or coherence, such as social, political or emotional.

tear.en: Tear the coupon out of the newspaper.
tear.gloss: To remove by tearing, or with sudden great force.

tear.en: He tore his coat on the nail.
tear.gloss: To rend (a solid material) by holding or restraining in two places and pulling apart, whether intentionally or not; to destroy or separate.

tear.en: He tore into the backlog of complaints.
tear.gloss: To move or act with great speed, energy, or violence.
tear.zh: 他对积压的投诉进行了深入研究。

doubt.en: Her emphatic refusal left no room for doubt.
doubt.zh: 她坚决的拒绝不容怀疑。

doubt.en: I'd no reason to doubt him.
He doubted that was really what you meant.
doubt.gloss: To consider questionable or unlikely; to hesitate to believe; to lack confidence in; to question.
doubt.zh: 他怀疑这确实是你的意思。

grant.en: They administrate several regional research grants.
grant.zh: 他们管理着几项地区研究资助。

grant.en: The grant gave fresh impetus to research.
grant.zh: 这笔资助为研究注入了新的动力。

grant.en: They disburse grants directly to eligible students.
grant.zh: 他们直接向符合条件的学生发放助学金。

grant.en: He was granted permission to attend the meeting.

seriously.en: He was seriously wounded, perhaps fatally.
seriously.zh: 他受了重伤，也许是致命的。

seriously.en: Are you seriously like actually for real?
That was a seriously unpleasant thing to say.
seriously.zh: 这是一件非常令人不愉快的事情。

minister.en: I speak for the Prime Minister.
The Prime Minister has the call.
The prime minister scotched rumors of his resignation.
minister.zh: 首相驳斥了有关他辞职的谣言。

totally.zh: 我彻底搞砸了那次考试。
他的想法完全不合常理。
我完全低估了这项任务。

totally.en: That was totally not what happened.
They've totally demolished the bank on Main Street.
totally.gloss: To the fullest extent or degree.
totally.zh: 他们完全拆毁了大街上的银行。

hero.en: The antagonist challenged the hero's principles.
hero.zh: 反派挑战了主人公的原则。

hero.en: He was hailed as a hero.
Childe Harold exemplifies the Byronic hero.
hero.zh: 柴尔德·哈罗德是拜伦式英雄的典范。

hero.en: My mom died a hero on duty.
hero.gloss: Somebody who possesses great bravery and carries out extraordinary or noble deeds.
hero.zh: 我妈妈在执行任务时像英雄一样牺牲了。

industrial.en: The factory reuses this industrial by-product.
industrial.zh: 工厂再利用这种工业副产品。

industrial.en: Italy is a part-industrial, part-rural nation.
industrial.zh: 意大利是一个半工业、半农村的国家。

industrial.en: Corn steep has many industrial uses.
industrial.zh: 玉米浆有许多工业用途。

cloud.zh: 乌云预示着又一阵狂风。
乌云凶险地在头顶聚集。

cloud.gloss: To overspread or hide with a cloud or clouds.

cloud.en: Your emotions are clouding your judgement.
cloud.gloss: To make less acute or perceptive.
cloud.zh: 你的情绪影响了你的判断。

cloud.en: The glass clouds when you breathe on it.
cloud.gloss: To become foggy or gloomy, or obscured from sight.
cloud.zh: 当你对着玻璃呼吸时，它会产生云雾。

stretch.en: The polymer's elasticity allows repeated stretching.
stretch.zh: 这种聚合物的弹性使其可以反复拉伸。

stretch.en: Tensile testing measures resistance to stretching.
stretch.zh: 拉伸测试测量材料抵抗拉伸的能力。

stretch.en: The inelastic material resisted further stretching.
stretch.zh: 这种无弹性材料抵抗进一步拉伸。

stretch.gloss: an unbroken period of time during which you do something

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

stretch.en: Her bizarre explanation really stretches credulity.
stretch.gloss: To make great demands on the capacity or resources of something.
stretch.zh: 她的离奇解释确实令人难以置信。

stretch.en: The ship stretched to the eastward.
stretch.gloss: To sail by the wind under press of canvas.

winner.en: The winner will be chosen at random.
And the winner is... drumroll, please... Eric!
winner.zh: 获胜者是……请打鼓……埃里克！

volume.en: Water displacement reveals the object's volume.
volume.zh: 排水量可以显示物体的体积。

volume.en: Volume can be measured in decibels.
volume.gloss: Strength of sound: how loud it is.
volume.zh: 音量可以用分贝来测量。

volume.en: The proper products can improve your hair's volume.
volume.gloss: A three-dimensional measure of space that comprises a length, a width and a height. It is measured in units of cubic centimeters in metric, cubic inches or cubic feet in English measurement.
volume.zh: 合适的产品可以增加头发的体积。

volume.en: The letter "G" was found in volume 4.
volume.gloss: A single book of a publication issued in multi-book format, such as an encyclopedia.

volume.en: The volume of ticket sales decreased this week.
volume.zh: 本周门票销售量有所下降。

seed.en: The optimum temperature promotes seed germination.
seed.zh: 最适温度有利于种子发芽。

seed.en: Wind aids the dispersal of seeds.
Cottonwood seeds drifted through the air.
seed.zh: 三角叶杨的种子在空中飘散。

seed.en: I seeded my lawn with bluegrass.
seed.gloss: To plant or sow an area with seeds.
seed.zh: 我在草坪上种了早熟禾。

seed.en: A venture capitalist seeds young companies.
seed.gloss: To start; to provide, assign or determine the initial resources for, position of, state of.
seed.zh: 风险投资家培育年轻公司。

surprised.en: His forthright answer surprised the committee.
surprised.zh: 他直率的回答使委员会感到意外。

surprised.en: Her audacious plan surprised the consortium.
surprised.zh: 她大胆的计划使这个联合体感到意外。

surprised.en: His vehement denial surprised the accuser.
surprised.zh: 他强烈的否认使指控者感到意外。

surprised.en: I was surprised by how helpful he was.
surprised.gloss: Caused to feel surprise, amazement or wonder, or showing an emotion due to an unexpected event.
surprised.zh: 我对他的乐于助人感到惊讶。

fashion.en: The silversmith fashioned a delicate stickpin.
fashion.zh: 银匠制作了一枚精致的领带饰针。
她穿着时下最流行的时装。

fashion.en: Check out the latest in fashion.
fashion.gloss: Popular trends, especially in clothing; the industry that designs clothing and sometimes other related items.

pepper.en: It bites like pepper or mustard.
pepper.zh: 它咬起来像胡椒或芥末。

pepper.en: Add a soupçon of red pepper.
Some ballparks have signs saying "No pepper games".
pepper.gloss: A game used by baseball players to warm up where fielders standing close to a batter rapidly return the batted ball to be hit again
pepper.zh: 一些棒球场有标语“禁止进行胡椒比赛”。

busy.en: Mercantile activity flourished around the busy port.
busy.zh: 繁忙港口周围的商业活动蓬勃发展。

busy.en: New businesses burgeon along the busy waterfront.
busy.zh: 新企业在繁忙的滨水区蓬勃兴起。

busy.gloss: Engaged with or preoccupied by an activity or person.
busy.zh: 你走开吧，我正忙着睡觉呢！

busy.en: Be careful crossing that busy street.
busy.gloss: Crowded with business or activities; having a great deal going on.
busy.zh: 穿过那条繁忙的街道时要小心。

busy.en: The work busied me all afternoon.
busy.gloss: To make somebody busy or active; to occupy.

copy.en: They examined every existent copy of the manuscript.
copy.zh: 他们检查了这份手稿的每一份现存副本。
不要模仿我的舞蹈动作。

copy.en: Please copy these reports for me.
copy.gloss: To produce an object identical to a given object.

copy.en: Submit all copy to the appropriate editor.
copy.gloss: The text (words, content) that is to be typeset or similarly prepared and published.; The text to be set into newspaper articles, magazine pages, or similar.
copy.zh: 将所有副本提交给适当的编辑。

copy.en: All heads of departments have been copied.
copy.gloss: To give or transmit a copy to (a person).
copy.zh: 所有部门负责人均已抄送。

tip.en: He stiffed me on the tip.
Tip it out of the jar.

cheap.en: I’m not a friend of cheap wine.
cheap.zh: 我不是廉价葡萄酒的朋友。

cheap.en: A new sports car doesn't come cheap.
We have an overdependence on cheap labor.
cheap.zh: 我们过度依赖廉价劳动力。

aim.en: The training aims to inculcate safe habits.
aim.zh: 这项培训旨在培养安全习惯。

aim.en: Curative treatment aims to eliminate the disease.
aim.zh: 治愈性治疗的目标是消除疾病。

aim.en: The lecture aims to edify its audience.
aim.zh: 这场讲座旨在启发听众。

aim.en: She aimed a punch at her ex-boyfriend.
aim.gloss: To direct or point (e.g. a weapon), at a particular object; to direct, as a missile, an act, or a proceeding, at, to, or against an object
aim.zh: 她一拳打向她的前男友。

aim.en: Take time with the aim of your gun.
aim.gloss: The pointing of a weapon, as a gun, a dart, or an arrow, or object, in the line of direction with the object intended to be struck; the line of fire; the direction of anything, such as a spear, a blow, a discourse, a remark, towards a particular point or object, with a view to strike or affect it.

cite.en: The judge cited a familiar legal dictum.
cite.zh: 法官引用了一条常见的法律格言。

cite.en: He was cited for his outstanding achievements.

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

cite.zh: 他因其杰出成就而受到表彰。
两份报告都没有引用任何消息来源。

welfare.en: Medical ethics require doctors to prioritize patient welfare.
welfare.zh: 医学道德要求医生优先考虑患者的福利。

vegetable.en: The dish contains thin vegetable strings.
Fresh vegetables are part of a healthful diet.
vegetable.zh: 新鲜蔬菜是健康饮食的一部分。

vegetable.en: This substance is vegetable, not mineral.
vegetable.zh: 这种物质是植物性的，不是矿物质的。

dish.zh: 这道菜有明显的烟熏味。

dish.en: The dish contains thin vegetable strings.
Joan made the dish from ceramic.
Going to the club is not my dish.
dish.gloss: Something that fits someone's tastes, interests, or abilities.

improvement.en: These results are indicative of improvement.
improvement.zh: 这些结果表明情况有所改善。

improvement.en: The improvement was small but appreciable.
improvement.zh: 改善虽然不大，但可以察觉。

improvement.en: The discovery produced a thousandfold improvement.
improvement.zh: 这项发现带来了千倍的改善。

improvement.en: The decade has seen vast improvements in techniques.
improvement.zh: 这十年见证了技术的巨大进步。

beach.gloss: Euphemistic form of bitch (taboo swear word).
beach.zh: 那个海滩应该受到惩罚！
大众旅游业破坏了海滩。

beach.en: Seashells lay thick on the beach.
beach.zh: 海滩上堆积着厚厚的贝壳。

everywhere.en: The headline was splashed across newspapers everywhere.
everywhere.zh: 这个标题充斥在各地的报纸上。

everywhere.en: The policeman haunted him, following him everywhere.
everywhere.zh: 警察纠缠着他，到处跟踪他。

everywhere.en: He delivers the mail everywhere on this street.
everywhere.gloss: In or to all locations under discussion.
everywhere.zh: 他在这条街上到处送邮件。

gray.en: My hair is beginning to gray.
The walls were painted a flat gray.

opening.en: The congenial atmosphere encouraged open discussion.
opening.zh: 融洽的气氛鼓励了坦诚的讨论。

opening.en: The navigable channel remains open year-round.
opening.zh: 这条可通航的航道全年开放。

opening.en: The porpoise swam toward the open sea.
opening.zh: 这只鼠海豚游向了外海。

opening.en: He slipped through an opening in the crowd.
opening.zh: 他从人群中的一个空隙溜了进去。

opening.en: We have an opening in our marketing department.
opening.gloss: A vacant position, especially in an array.; An unoccupied employment position.
opening.zh: 我们的营销部门有一个空缺。

overall.en: Data aggregation simplifies the overall analysis.
overall.zh: 数据汇总简化了整体分析。

overall.en: Absenteeism reduced the factory's overall productivity.
overall.zh: 旷工降低了工厂的整体生产率。

overall.en: Writing is a subskill of overall literacy.
overall.zh: 写作是整体读写能力的一项子技能。

divide.zh: 族群冲突使这个社区陷入分裂。

divide.en: Explain the process whereby cells divide.
The cells divided irregularly under stress.
divide.zh: 这些细胞在压力下不规则地分裂。

divide.en: How shall we divide this pie?
divide.zh: 这块蛋糕我们该如何分呢？

divide.en: Words divide us; Wiktionary unites us.
divide.gloss: To cause (a group of people) to disagree.
divide.zh: 言语使我们分裂；维基词典将我们团结在一起。

divide.en: There is a great divide between us.
divide.gloss: A distancing between two people or things.
divide.zh: 我们之间存在很大的分歧。

initial.en: The valuation exceeded our initial estimate.
initial.zh: 这项估值超过了我们最初的估计。

initial.en: These benefits counterbalance the initial expense.
initial.zh: 这些益处抵消了最初的支出。

initial.en: Alliteration repeats initial sounds in nearby words.
initial.zh: 头韵重复相邻词语的起始音。

terrible.zh: 他的意大利语发音很糟糕。

terrible.en: Jeez, I'm having terrible RNG today.
terrible.zh: 天哪，我今天的 RNG 真是太糟糕了。

terrible.en: It had a terrible minky smell.
terrible.zh: 里面有一股难闻的水貂味。

terrible.en: The witch laid a terrible curse on him.
terrible.gloss: Causing terror, alarm or fear; dreadful
terrible.zh: 女巫对他下了可怕的诅咒。

terrible.en: The food was terrible, but it was free.
terrible.zh: 食物很糟糕，但它是免费的。

terrible.en: Whatever he thinks, he is a terrible driver.
terrible.zh: 不管他怎么想，他都是一个糟糕的司机。

oppose.en: Many religious leaders oppose cloning humans.
oppose.zh: 许多宗教领袖反对克隆人。

oppose.en: There is still time to oppose this plan.
oppose.gloss: To attempt to stop the progression of; to resist or antagonize by physical means, or by arguments, etc.; to contend against.
oppose.zh: 现在还有时间反对这个计划。

oppose.en: They are opposed to any form of hierarchy.
oppose.gloss: To present or set up in opposition; to pose.
oppose.zh: 他们反对任何形式的等级制度。

route.en: The proposed route is economically practicable.
route.zh: 拟议的路线在经济上可行。

route.en: The route is comparatively short and unobstructed.
route.zh: 这条路线相对较短，而且畅通无阻。

route.en: We took a circuitous route around town.
route.zh: 我们绕着小镇走了一条迂回路线。

route.en: We live near the bus route.
route.gloss: A regular itinerary of stops, or the path followed between these stops, such as for delivery or passenger transportation.
route.zh: 我们住在巴士路线附近。

route.gloss: A road or path; often specifically a highway.

contemporary.en: Cervantes was a contemporary of Shakespeare.
contemporary.gloss: Someone or something belonging to the same time period (as someone or something else)
contemporary.zh: 塞万提斯是莎士比亚的同时代人。
巴赫和亨德尔是同时代人。
他经常阅读当代作家的作品。

multiple.en: Multiple sclerosis is a neuromuscular disease.
multiple.zh: 多发性硬化症是一种神经肌肉疾病。

multiple.en: My Swiss Army knife has multiple blades.
multiple.zh: 我的瑞士军刀有多个刀片。

multiple.en: Some states do explicitly prohibit multiple citizenship.
multiple.gloss: Having more than one element, part, component, or function, having more than one instance, occurring more than once, usually contrary to expectations (can be followed by a singular).
multiple.zh: 一些州确实明确禁止多重国籍。

essential.en: Adherence to safety rules remains essential.
essential.zh: 遵守安全规则依然至关重要。

essential.en: The car is missing essential features.
Obedience is essential in any army.
essential.zh: 服从对于任何军队都是至关重要的。

lake.en: Heavy runoff carried sediment into the lake.
lake.zh: 大量径流把沉积物带入湖中。

lake.en: The lake remained limpid after the rain.

league.zh: 阿森纳封杀了英超联赛。

league.en: Calatrava is a major league architect.
league.zh: 卡拉特拉瓦是一位大联盟建筑师。

league.en: We're not even in the same league.
league.gloss: A class or type of people or things that are evenly matched or on the same level.
league.zh: 我们甚至不在同一个联盟。

league.en: Are you going to watch the league tonight?

careful.zh: 这个实验需要仔细稀释。

careful.en: Concurrent access requires careful system design.
careful.zh: 并发访问需要周密的系统设计。

careful.en: The glass's fragility requires careful handling.
careful.zh: 这种玻璃易碎，需要小心搬运。

careful.en: He was a slow and careful driver.
careful.gloss: Taking care; attentive to potential danger, error or harm; cautious.
careful.zh: 他是一个缓慢而小心的司机。

criminal.en: The indictment listed three criminal charges.
criminal.zh: 起诉书列出了三项刑事指控。

criminal.en: Printing such asinine opinions is criminal!
criminal.zh: 发表如此愚蠢的观点是犯罪行为！

criminal.en: Runaways are vulnerable to criminal exploitation.
criminal.zh: 逃亡者很容易受到犯罪剥削。

upper.en: Cometary dust entered the upper atmosphere.
upper.zh: 彗星尘埃进入了高层大气。

upper.en: The lithosphere includes the crust and upper mantle.
upper.zh: 岩石圈包括地壳和上地幔顶部。

upper.en: A spent upper stage is a derelict satellite.
upper.zh: 用过的上级是一颗废弃的卫星。

rush.en: The rollercoaster gave me a rush.
rush.gloss: A sudden, brief exhilaration, for instance the pleasurable sensation produced by a stimulant.

rush.en: The traffic is slow during rush hour.
Don't rush your client or he may withdraw.
rush.gloss: To cause to move or act with unusual haste.
rush.zh: 不要催促你的客户，否则他可能会退出。

rush.en: A detachment of cavalrymen rushed the enemy's position.
rush.zh: 一队骑兵冲向敌人的阵地。

necessarily.en: Nonlabor time is not necessarily leisure.
necessarily.zh: 非劳动时间不一定是休闲时间。

specifically.en: Check-raising is sometimes specifically prohibited by house rules.
specifically.zh: 有时，庄家规则会明确禁止过牌加注。
阿德里亚诺专门跟踪梅丽莎。
你特别提到了比尔·盖茨。

tired.en: The portrait captures his tired, sallow face.
tired.zh: 这幅肖像画出了他疲惫、蜡黄的面容。

tired.en: He was tired, hence his early departure.

employ.en: Yesterday our local garage employed a new mechanic.
employ.gloss: To provide (someone) with a new job; to hire.
employ.zh: 昨天我们当地的车库雇用了一位新机械师。

employ.en: The burglar employed a jemmy to get in.
employ.gloss: To use (someone or something) for a job or task.
employ.zh: 窃贼雇了一个混蛋闯了进来。

holiday.en: We spent our summer holiday exploring the coast.
holiday.zh: 我们利用暑假游览了海岸。

holiday.gloss: A day on which a religious event or secular celebration is traditionally observed.
holiday.zh: 今天是巫术崇拜者的节日！
复活节是一个可流动的节日。

holiday.en: How much holiday are you allowed?
holiday.gloss: A period of one or more days taken off work for leisure and often travel; often plural.

vast.en: This excerpt describes a vast forest tract.
vast.zh: 这段节选描写了一大片林地。

vast.en: The transcontinental train crosses a vast expanse.
vast.zh: 这列横贯大陆的火车穿过辽阔地域。

vast.gloss: Very large or wide (literally or figuratively).

fewer.en: We envisage a system with fewer restrictions.
fewer.zh: 我们设想一种限制更少的制度。

fewer.en: Fewer women wear hats these days.
fewer.gloss: comparative degree of few; a smaller number.
fewer.zh: 如今戴帽子的女性越来越少了。

fewer.en: Smiling takes fewer muscles than frowning.
fewer.zh: 微笑比皱眉需要更少的肌肉。

household.en: Higher taxes affected the household pocketbook.
household.zh: 更高的税款影响了家庭开支。

household.en: They apportion costs according to household income.
household.zh: 他们按家庭收入分摊费用。
许多家用产品都含有抗菌剂。

household.en: How many people are there in your household?
household.gloss: A group of people who live together; the group may or may not be a family. A household may also be an individual living alone.

resolution.en: His stalwart resolution is perhaps admirable, perhaps foolish.
resolution.gloss: A strong will; the state of being resolute.
resolution.zh: 他的坚定决心也许令人钦佩，也许愚蠢。

resolution.en: By February, most New Year’s resolutions are forgotten.
resolution.gloss: A statement of intent, a vow.
resolution.zh: 到了二月，大多数新年决心都被遗忘了。

resolution.gloss: The number of pixels in an image being stored or displayed.
resolution.zh: 该显示器的最大分辨率为 1600 × 1200。

resolution.en: The resolution was passed by a two-thirds majority.
resolution.gloss: A formal statement adopted by an assembly, or during any other formal meeting.
resolution.zh: 该决议以三分之二多数通过。

abortion.en: He was on record as opposing abortion.
abortion.zh: 他曾公开表示反对堕胎。

abortion.en: Abortion was becoming the season's big political battleground.
abortion.zh: 堕胎正在成为这一季的主要政治战场。

witness.en: The witness's account exculpated the suspect.
witness.zh: 证人的叙述为嫌疑人洗清了嫌疑。

witness.en: The witness avouched the document's authenticity.
witness.zh: 证人保证了这份文件的真实性。

witness.en: We witnessed an exodus from the city.
witness.zh: 我们目睹了人们大批离开这座城市。

witness.gloss: To see or gain knowledge of through experience.

witness.en: This certificate witnesses his presence on that day.
witness.gloss: To furnish proof of, to show.
witness.zh: 这张证书见证了他那天的存在。

apart.en: The ancient supercontinent eventually broke apart.
apart.zh: 这个古老的超大陆最终分裂了。

apart.en: The sharp blade cleaved the timber apart.
apart.zh: 锋利的刀刃把木料劈开了。

apart.en: Joking apart, what do you think?

schedule.gloss: To add (a name) to the list of those participating in an event; to reserve a place or time for.

sad.gloss: Emotionally negative.; Feeling sorrow; sorrowful, mournful.

saving.en: I'm saving up for a car.
I invested all my savings in gold.
saving.gloss: Something (usually money) that is saved, particularly money that has been set aside for the future.
saving.zh: 我把所有积蓄都投资在黄金上。

saving.en: The ship has made a saving voyage.
saving.gloss: Bringing back in returns or in receipts the sum expended; incurring no loss, though not gainful.
saving.zh: 这艘船完成了一次拯救航行。

bend.en: Material stiffness determines resistance to bending.
bend.zh: 材料刚度决定其抗弯能力。

bend.gloss: To cause (something) to change its shape into a curve, by physical force, chemical action, or any other means.

bend.en: Bend the sail to the yard.
bend.gloss: To tie, as in securing a line to a cleat; to shackle a chain to an anchor; make fast.

bend.en: They bent me to their will.
bend.zh: 他们让我屈服于他们的意志。

bend.en: Look at the trees bending in the wind.
He bent down to pick up the pieces.
bend.zh: 他弯下腰​​去捡那些碎片。

desert:noun.en: The desert gets cold at night.
Camels can survive in the desert.
desert:noun.zh: 骆驼可以在沙漠中生存。

desert:noun.en: They crossed the desert on foot.

desert:verb.zh: 士兵们擅自离开了岗位。

shall.gloss: Used in questions with the first person singular or plural to suggest a possible future action.

shall.en: I shall sing in the choir tomorrow.
shall.gloss: Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.
shall.zh: 明天我将在合唱团唱歌。

shall.en: (obligation): Citizens shall provide proof of identity.
shall.gloss: Used similarly to indicate determination or obligation in the second and third persons singular or plural.

error.en: Don't upbraid him for an inadvertent error.
error.zh: 不要因无心之失而责骂他。

error.en: Luckily, the error was quickly corrected.
error.zh: 幸运的是，这个错误很快就得到了纠正。

error.en: I fancy this is an error.
There was a large error in the accounts.
error.gloss: A mistake; an accidental wrong action or a false statement not made deliberately.
error.zh: 账目上出现了很大的错误。

error.en: I've finally seen the error of my ways.
error.zh: 我终于看到了我的做法的错误。

error.en: This directory errors with a "Permission denied" message.
error.gloss: To function improperly due to an error, especially accompanied by error message.
error.zh: 该目录出现错误并显示“权限被拒绝”消息。

cop.en: That eejit has no cop on.
The cop gave me an impaired.
cop.zh: 警察给了我一个残疾人。

cop.en: Harold copped to being known as "Dirty Harry".
cop.gloss: To admit, especially to a crime or wrongdoing.
cop.zh: 哈罗德被称为“肮脏的哈利”。

double.gloss: Made up of two matching or complementary elements.

double.en: I work a double this weekend.
double.gloss: Two shifts of work back to back.
double.zh: 这个周末我做双份工作。

double.en: The sine function returns a double.
double.zh: 正弦函数返回一个双精度值。

double.en: The batter doubled into the corner.
double.zh: 击球手双垒打进入角落。

double.en: He hit a double to deep centerfield.
double.gloss: a base hit on which the batter stops safely at second base

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

double.zh: 他击中了中外野深处的双垒安打。

double.en: I did double his sales this month.
double.gloss: Twice the number, amount, size, etc.
double.zh: 这个月我的销售额是他的两倍。

sand.en: This conglomerate contains pebbles and sand.
sand.zh: 这种砾岩含有卵石和沙粒。

sand.en: The burning sand hurt my feet.
sand.zh: 燃烧的沙​​子刺痛了我的脚。

sand.en: to pour out sand or dust.

print.en: The manuscript antedates the printed edition.
These terms are conventionally printed in italics.
print.zh: 这些术语按惯例用斜体印刷。

print.en: The open-book examination permits printed reference material.
print.zh: 这场开卷考试允许使用印刷参考资料。

print.en: Write in print using block letters.
print.gloss: Clear handwriting, especially, writing without connected letters as in cursive.

print.en: Print your name here and sign below.
print.gloss: To write very clearly, especially, to write without connecting the letters as in cursive.
print.zh: 在此打印您的姓名并在下面签名。

print.en: TV and the Internet haven't killed print.
print.gloss: Books and other material created by printing presses, considered collectively or as a medium.
print.zh: 电视和互联网并没有消灭印刷品。

preserve.en: Petrifaction preserved the tree's original structure.
preserve.zh: 石化作用保存了树木的原有结构。

preserve.en: These rocks preserve evidence of primordial conditions.
preserve.zh: 这些岩石保留了原始环境的证据。

preserve.en: Only three extant manuscripts preserve this text.
preserve.zh: 仅有三份现存手稿保留了这篇文字。

preserve.en: Let's pray that we'd be preserved from danger.
preserve.gloss: To protect; to keep from harm or injury.
preserve.zh: 让我们祈祷我们能免受危险。

preserve.en: I preserved a composed manner throughout the interrogation.
preserve.gloss: To maintain throughout; to keep intact.
preserve.zh: 整个审讯过程中我都保持着镇定的态度。

ceo.en: The financial director reports to the CEO.
ceo.zh: 财务总监向首席执行官汇报。

ceo.en: This company has a female CEO.
ceo.zh: 这家公司有一位女性首席执行官。

passage.en: The passage describes the landscape lyrically.
passage.zh: 这个段落抒情地描写了风景。

passage.en: She played the passage surpassingly well.
passage.zh: 她把这段乐句演奏得极其出色。

passage.en: The instrumentalist practiced the difficult passage repeatedly.
passage.zh: 这位器乐演奏者反复练习那段困难的乐句。

passage.gloss: To make a passage, especially by sea; to cross.

passage.en: She struggled to play the difficult passages.
passage.gloss: A paragraph or section of text or music with particular meaning.
passage.zh: 她努力演奏困难的乐段。

formal.en: The committee issued a formal censure.
formal.zh: 委员会发出了正式谴责。

formal.en: Avoid colloquialism in this formal report.
formal.zh: 在这份正式报告中避免使用口语表达。

formal.en: She felt gauche at the formal reception.
formal.zh: 她在正式招待会上感到拘谨笨拙。

formal.en: She spoke formal English, without any dialect.
formal.zh: 她说的是正式英语，没有任何方言。

formal.en: I'd like to make a formal complaint.
Formal wear must be worn at my wedding!

transition.en: The rite marks an important life transition.
transition.zh: 这个仪式标志着人生的重要转变。

existence.en: Scientists postulate the existence of dark matter.
existence.zh: 科学家假定暗物质存在。

existence.en: The theist argued for a creator's existence.
existence.zh: 这位有神论者主张造物主存在。

participation.zh: 为什么观众参与很重要？
价格和参与可能有所不同。

album.zh: 他的最后一张专辑是《脸颊》。

album.en: His new album is quite rocky.
His albums are very popular on Spotify.
album.gloss: A group of audio recordings, on any medium, intended for distribution as a group.
album.zh: 他的专辑在 Spotify 上非常受欢迎。

arrange.en: Arrange these numbers in an array.
arrange.zh: 把这些数字排成一个数组。

arrange.en: Arrange the chairs in a circle.

atmosphere.en: The congenial atmosphere encouraged open discussion.
atmosphere.zh: 融洽的气氛鼓励了坦诚的讨论。

atmosphere.en: Cometary dust entered the upper atmosphere.
atmosphere.zh: 彗星尘埃进入了高层大气。

atmosphere.en: The inoffensive joke lightened the atmosphere.
atmosphere.zh: 这个无伤大雅的笑话活跃了气氛。

atmosphere.en: The atmosphere for the football match was great.
atmosphere.gloss: The apparent mood felt in an environment.
atmosphere.zh: 足球比赛的气氛非常好。

joint.en: We circled a joint that afternoon.
joint.zh: 那天下午我们围着一家酒吧转了一圈。
让我们一起摇滚这个关节吧！

reply.en: Her terse reply ended the conversation.
reply.zh: 她简短的答复结束了交谈。

reply.en: His gibe provoked a curt reply.
reply.zh: 他的嘲讽引出了一句简短的反驳。

reply.en: His reply offered only a familiar platitude.
reply.zh: 他的回答只有一句常见的陈词滥调。

reply.gloss: To give a written or spoken response, especially to a question, request, accusation or criticism; to answer.

reply.en: He wrote replies to several of his critics.
reply.gloss: a statement (either spoken or written) that is made to reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

reply.zh: 他给几位批评他的人写了回复。

cycle.en: The equipe prepared for the cycling race.
cycle.zh: 运动队为自行车赛做了准备。

cycle.gloss: To turn power off and back on
cycle.zh: 避免不必要地循环使用设备。

cycle.en: Sulfur recycles in the sulfur cycle.
cycle.zh: 硫在硫循环中循环利用。

cycle.en: They have their cycling game going tonight.
cycle.gloss: To maintain a team's possession of the puck in the offensive zone by handling and passing the puck in a loop from the boards near the goal up the side boards and passing to back to the boards near the goal
cycle.zh: 他们今晚要进行自行车比赛。

cycle.en: Put the washing in on a warm cycle.
cycle.gloss: A programme on a washing machine, dishwasher, or other such device.
cycle.zh: 将衣物置于温水循环中。

lock.en: Forcible entry left marks around the lock.
lock.zh: 强行进入在锁周围留下了痕迹。

lock.en: This door locks with a key.
lock.gloss: To be capable of becoming fastened in place.

lock.en: He engaged the lock on the door.
Remember to lock the door when you leave.

opposite.en: Her essay explores the juxtaposition of opposites.
opposite.zh: 她的文章探讨了对立事物的并置。
他与玛丽莲·梦露演对手戏。

opposite.en: They were moving in opposite directions.
opposite.zh: 他们正朝相反的方向前进。

opposite.gloss: Something or someone opposite to something or someone else.; An antonym.

opposite.en: He is attracted to the opposite sex.
opposite.gloss: Of either of two complementary or mutually exclusive things.

opposite.en: The dogfighter fought closely with his opposite.
opposite.gloss: Something or someone opposite to something or someone else.; An opponent.
opposite.zh: 斗狗者与他的对手进行了激烈的战斗。

deserve.en: Every educable child deserves suitable support.
deserve.zh: 每位能够受教育的儿童都应获得适当支持。

deserve.en: We don't think your article deserves reading.
deserve.gloss: To be entitled to, as a result of past actions; to be worthy to have.
deserve.zh: 我们认为您的文章不值得阅读。

consistent.en: The dimensional measurements must remain consistent.
consistent.zh: 这些尺寸测量值必须保持一致。

consistent.en: These ideas cohere into a consistent theory.
consistent.zh: 这些观点结合成了一套一致的理论。

resistance.zh: 电阻与电导率成反比变化。

resistance.en: Material stiffness determines resistance to bending.
resistance.zh: 材料刚度决定其抗弯能力。

discovery.zh: 这个发现完全出于偶然。

discovery.en: The discovery brought her international prominence.
discovery.zh: 这项发现使她在国际上崭露头角。

discovery.en: The discovery became a commercial bonanza.
discovery.zh: 这项发现成了一个商业财源。

discovery.en: The purpose of the voyage was discovery.
discovery.zh: 这次航行的目的是发现。

exposure.en: Adjust the aperture to control exposure.

exposure.zh: 一些砂岩因暴露而结垢。

exposure.en: Limit your exposure to harsh chemicals.
exposure.gloss: The condition of being exposed, uncovered, or unprotected.
exposure.zh: 限制接触刺激性化学物质。

pose.en: To pose a model for a picture.
pose.gloss: To place in an attitude or fixed position, for the sake of effect.

stream.zh: 污染物玷污了曾经清澈的溪流。

stream.en: Subterranean streams carved the limestone caves.
stream.zh: 地下溪流侵蚀形成了这些石灰岩洞穴。

stream.en: Salmon return to their natal streams.
stream.zh: 鲑鱼回到它们出生的溪流。

stream.en: A flag streams in the wind.
stream.gloss: To extend; to stretch out with a wavy motion; to float in the wind.

stream.en: The soldier's wound was streaming blood.

sale.zh: 我们有待售的修剪植物。
周六烘焙义卖，下午 2 点至。

sale.en: My car is up for sale.
He celebrated after the sale of company.
sale.gloss: An exchange of goods or services for currency or credit.

sale.en: They are having a clearance sale: 50% off.
sale.gloss: Ellipsis of discount sale (“the sale of goods at reduced prices”).
sale.zh: 他们正在进行清仓促销：50％的折扣。

pot.en: The kiln produced durable earthenware pots.
pot.zh: 这座窑烧制了耐用的陶罐。

pot.en: The artichokes are steaming in the pot.
After his arrest, his prospects went to pot.
pot.zh: 被捕后，他的前景一片黯淡。

mine.gloss: That or those belonging to me.; As double possessive.
That or those belonging to me.; Used predicatively.

mine.en: Mine has been a long journey.
mine.gloss: That or those belonging to me.; Used substantively, with an implied noun.

mine.en: We had the party at mine.
mine.gloss: That or those belonging to me.; My house or home.
mine.zh: 我们在我家举办了聚会。

grand.en: A grand staircase leads to the upper floor.
grand.zh: 一座宏伟的楼梯通向楼上。

grand.en: This person is a Grand Cross.
For quotations using this term, see Citations:grand.
grand.gloss: A thousand of some unit of currency, such as dollars or pounds. (Compare G.)
grand.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文：grand。

hello.en: Li’er said hello to his father.
Hello ducks, how are you today?
hello.zh: 哈喽，鸭子们，今天过得怎么样？

hello.en: Hello love, how can I help you?
hello.zh: 你好，亲爱的，有什么可以帮到你的吗？

tale.en: The old tale centers on a malediction.
tale.zh: 这个古老故事围绕一个诅咒展开。

tale.en: It was a long, logorrheic tale.
tale.zh: 这是一个漫长的、语言丰富的故事。

tale.gloss: An account of an asserted fact or circumstance; a rumour; a report, especially an idle or malicious story; a piece of gossip or slander; a lie.

tale.en: Have you read the tale of three pigs?
tale.gloss: A tale is a type of story.
tale.zh: 你读过三只小猪的故事吗？

knife.en: The boat knifed through the water.
knife.gloss: To cut through as if with a knife.
knife.zh: 小船在水中刀锋般地划过。

knife.en: He threatened me with a knife.
The knife left sliced his arm.
knife.zh: 左边的刀划破了他的手臂。

knife.en: She was repeatedly knifed in the chest.
knife.gloss: To use a knife to injure or kill by stabbing, slashing, or otherwise using the sharp edge of the knife as a weapon.
knife.zh: 她的胸部多次被刀刺伤。

coalition.en: Factious disputes weakened the governing coalition.
coalition.zh: 派系争斗削弱了执政联盟。

coalition.en: The coalition talks are dragging on.
coalition.zh: 联合政府谈判仍在拖延。

resolve.en: Arbitration resolved the prolonged labor dispute.
resolve.zh: 仲裁解决了这场旷日持久的劳资纠纷。

resolve.en: An intermediary helped resolve their disagreement.
resolve.zh: 一位中间人帮助解决了他们的分歧。

resolve.en: They resolved the dispute without rancor.
resolve.zh: 他们在没有怨恨的情况下解决了争端。

resolve.en: He was resolved by an unexpected event.
resolve.gloss: To determine or decide in purpose; to make ready in mind; to fix; to settle.
resolve.zh: 一件意想不到的事情让他下定决心。

racial.en: The rules expressly forbid racial intimidation.
racial.zh: 这些规则明确禁止种族恐吓。

racial.en: Her promotion broke America's racial barriers.
racial.zh: 她的晋升打破了美国的种族障碍。

phase.gloss: Any appearance or aspect of an object of mental apprehension or view.

phase.en: Tell me why the moon changes phase.
phase.zh: 告诉我为什么月亮会改变相位。

joke.en: The inoffensive joke lightened the atmosphere.
joke.zh: 这个无伤大雅的笑话活跃了气氛。

joke.gloss: A laughably worthless thing or person; a sham.

joke.zh: 这个笑话总是要了我的命。

joke.en: The final exam was a joke.
joke.gloss: Something that is far easier or far less challenging than expected.
Something said or done for amusement, not in seriousness.

joke.en: Relax, man, I'm just joking with you.
joke.gloss: To dupe in a friendly manner for amusement; to mess with, play with.
joke.zh: 放松点，伙计，我只是和你开玩笑。

coat.en: The coating prevents penetration by water.

symptom.zh: 这些症状通常是暂时的。

symptom.en: The symptoms returned sporadically during recovery.
symptom.zh: 恢复期间，症状偶尔再次出现。

symptom.en: Early symptoms may foreshadow a serious illness.
symptom.zh: 早期症状可能预示着严重疾病。

manufacturer.en: The manufacturer offers a rustproof metal frame.
manufacturer.zh: 制造商提供防锈金属框架。

manufacturer.gloss: A person or company that manufactures.
manufacturer.zh: 这家服装制造商向海外扩张。

manufacturer.en: He worked at a smallgoods manufacturer.
manufacturer.zh: 他在一家小商品制造商工作。

philosophy.en: The essay expounds a humanistic philosophy.
philosophy.zh: 这篇文章阐述了一种人文主义哲学。

philosophy.en: She studied transcendental philosophy at university.
philosophy.zh: 她在大学学习超验哲学。
自然哲学涵盖许多科学。

potato.en: We usually eat meat and potatoes.
potato.gloss: A potato is a food that grows under the ground, which is round and white inside.

potato.en: This dish is served with balls of potato.
(as determiner) I don't want this much potato.
potato.zh: （作为限定词）我不需要这么多土豆。

quote.zh: 这篇文章引用了福布斯教授的话。

quote.en: The writer quoted the president's speech.
quote.gloss: To repeat (the exact words of a person).
quote.zh: 作者引用了总统的讲话。

quote.en: She loved reading quotes of famous people.
quote.gloss: A statement attributed to a person; a quotation.
quote.zh: 她喜欢阅读名人的名言。

quote.en: Can you believe they quoted me $5,000?
quote.gloss: To prepare a summary of work to be done and set a price; to estimate.
quote.zh: 你能相信他们给我报价 5,000 美元吗？

foundation.en: We measured compaction before laying the foundation.
foundation.zh: 我们在打地基前测量了压实程度。

foundation.en: Semantics is a foundation of lexicography.
foundation.zh: 语义学是词典学的基础。

online.en: Synchronous communication requires both parties online.
online.zh: 同步通信需要双方同时在线。
网上银行使用双因素身份验证。
他在网上发布运动视频。

online.gloss: Of a system: connected (generally electrically) to a larger network.; Of a computer: actively connected to the Internet or to some other communications service.
online.zh: 该调制解调器是否在线？

online.en: I prefer to read online newspapers.
online.gloss: Available over, or delivered from, the Internet.
online.zh: 我更喜欢阅读在线报纸。

online.gloss: Of a system: active, particularly building facilities (such as power) or a factory or power plant.

negotiation.zh: 这个吉兆鼓舞了双方重启谈判。
谈判结束了持续一周的罢工。
尖刻的敌意破坏了谈判气氛。

urge.en: He fought down the urge to laugh.
We urge the exercise of patience and restraint.
urge.zh: 我们敦促保持耐心和克制。

urge.en: She got the uncontrollable urge for some chocolate.
urge.zh: 她无法控制地想吃点巧克力。

occasion.en: The actress brought glamor to the occasion.
occasion.zh: 这位女演员为这个场合增添了魅力。

occasion.en: I have no occasion for firearms.
His rumbling voice suited the solemn occasion.
occasion.zh: 他低沉的声音很适合这个庄严的场合。

occasion.en: I had no occasion to feel offended, however.
occasion.gloss: An occurrence or state of affairs which causes some event or reaction; a motive or reason.
occasion.zh: 然而，我没有理由感到被冒犯。

dust.en: Dust accumulation reduced the sensor's sensitivity.
dust.zh: 灰尘积聚降低了传感器的灵敏度。

dust.en: Cometary dust entered the upper atmosphere.
dust.zh: 彗星尘埃进入了高层大气。

dust.en: The bandanna protected her neck from dust.
dust.zh: 花巾保护她的脖子不受灰尘侵袭。

dust.gloss: To remove dust; to clean by removing dust.

dust.en: The furniture was covered with dust.
dust.gloss: fine powdery material such as dry earth or pollen that can be blown about in the air

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

breathe.en: The flowers breathed a heady perfume.
breathe.gloss: To exhale or expel (something) in the manner of breath.
breathe.zh: 花朵散发着令人陶醉的香味。

breathe.en: The decor positively breathes classical elegance.
breathe.gloss: To give an impression of, to exude.
breathe.zh: 装饰洋溢着古典优雅的气息。

breathe.en: The wind breathes through the trees.
breathe.gloss: To pass like breath; noiselessly or gently; to emanate; to blow gently.

breathe.en: Try not to breathe too much smoke.
breathe.gloss: To draw something into the lungs.
breathe.zh: 尽量不要吸入太多烟雾。

breathe.en: Fish have gills so they can breathe underwater.
breathe.gloss: To take in needed gases and expel waste gases in a similar way.
breathe.zh: 鱼有鳃，因此可以在水下呼吸。

elect.gloss: Who has been elected in a specified post, but has not yet entered office.

elect.zh: 我们选举乔丹先生为主席。

investigator.en: Investigators uncovered the cabal's financial dealings.
investigator.zh: 调查人员揭露了这个秘密小集团的财务往来。

investigator.en: Investigators found evidence of deliberate connivance.
investigator.zh: 调查人员发现了蓄意纵容的证据。

investigator.en: The inconclusive results caused perplexity among investigators.

substance.zh: 外分泌腺通过导管释放物质。

substance.zh: 蒸馏分离具有不同沸点的物质。

practical.zh: 他们的合作产生了显著的实际益处。

practical.zh: 非专业审阅者提供了有用的实际反馈。

moreover.zh: 他很有钱，而且出身名门。

passion.en: We share a passion for books.
passion.gloss: Any great, strong, powerful emotion, especially romantic love or extreme hate.

volunteer.zh: 她热情的请求激励了志愿者。

volunteer.en: My sister volunteered me to do the dishes.
volunteer.gloss: To offer the services of (someone else) to do something.

implement.zh: 小堆通常用于实现优先级队列。

战争基本上已经结束了。
这基本上就是这里发生的事情。

sauce.en: Tomato sauce is generally a puree.

priest.en: The Shinto priest burnt incense for his ancestors.
priest.gloss: A religious clergyman (clergywoman, clergyperson) who is trained to perform services or sacrifices at a church or temple.

amazing.en: The architecture throughout NYC is amazing.

employer.en: He was apprenticed to a local employer.
employer.zh: 他在当地一家雇主那里当学徒。

employer.en: Your next employer may require a recommendation.

shock.gloss: To cause to be emotionally shocked; to cause (someone) to feel greatly surprised or upset.

shock.en: Call an ambulance, he's in shock!

shock.en: The news came as a shock.
His shock announcement rocked the tennis world.
shock.gloss: Causing intense surprise, horror, etc.; unexpected and shocking.
shock.zh: 他的令人震惊的声明震惊了网球界。

inspire.en: The expansive landscape inspired her paintings.

mystery.zh: 侦探面临着一个令人费解的谜团。

impose.gloss: To apply, enforce, or establish (something, often regarded as burdensome as a restriction or tax: see verb sense 1.2.2) with authority.

spending.en: His improvident spending exhausted the bequest.

symbol.en: They notate the music using traditional symbols.

mood.zh: 陈述事实时使用陈述语气。

emphasis.zh: 过度注重细节拖延了完工。

singer.zh: 这位歌手穿着一件彩色衬衫。

singer.en: My sister is an overrated singer.
singer.zh: 我姐姐是一位被高估的歌手。

partly.en: Fruit maturation depends partly on temperature.
partly.zh: 果实成熟在一定程度上取决于温度。

partly.en: The inscription had been partly effaced.
Euphony depends partly on the arrangement of sounds.
partly.zh: 音韵和谐在一定程度上取决于声音排列。

partly.en: The car was partly visible in the garage.
partly.gloss: In part, or to some degree, but not completely.
partly.zh: 车库里的汽车部分可见。

unknown.en: The study revealed hitherto unknown species.
unknown.zh: 这项研究发现了此前未知的物种。
他们何时到达尚不清楚。

unknown.en: The concept has existed since times unknown.
unknown.gloss: Not known; unidentified; not well known.
unknown.zh: 这个概念自古以来就已存在。

offense.en: Murder is a serious criminal offense.
offense.gloss: An offense is an action that breaks the law.
offense.zh: 谋杀是一种严重的刑事犯罪。

offense.en: Bullying is a punishable offense in schools.
offense.zh: 在学校欺凌是一种应受惩罚的罪行。

offense.en: No offense, but his cooking is lousy.
offense.zh: 无意冒犯，但他的厨艺很糟糕。

counter.en: Go up to the counter and ask.
The counter "i" was declared as an integer.
There were unbagged groceries all over the counter.
counter.zh: 柜台上到处都是未装袋的杂货。

potentially.en: Avoid substances with potentially deleterious effects.
potentially.zh: 避免接触可能有害的物质。

potentially.gloss: with a possibility of becoming actual

thirty.en: I have over thirty years’ experience.
Thirty countries attended the environmental superconference.
thirty.zh: 三十个国家参加了环境超级会议。

justify.en: The payoff justified our cumulative investment.
justify.zh: 所得回报证明了累计投入的价值。

justify.en: The text will look better justified.
justify.gloss: To arrange (text) on a page or a computer screen such that the left and right ends of all lines within paragraphs are aligned.

justify.en: Nothing can justify your rude behaviour last night.
justify.gloss: To be a good reason behind a normally-unacceptable action; to warrant.
justify.zh: 没有什么可以证明你昨晚的粗鲁行为是正当的。

protest.en: He remained passive during the protest.
protest.zh: 他在抗议期间保持被动。

protest.en: They lodged a protest with the authorities.
protest.gloss: A formal objection, especially one by a group.

protest.en: They protested the demolition of the school.

treaty.zh: 这项条约限制常规武器装备。

treaty.en: Both countries signed a bilateral treaty.
treaty.zh: 两国签署了一项双边条约。

treaty.en: The treaty was a good auspice.
treaty.zh: 这项条约是一个好兆头。

treaty.en: Both countries signed the peace treaty.
treaty.gloss: A treaty is a formal agreement between two or more states.

crash.gloss: An automobile, airplane, or other vehicle accident.
To make a sudden loud noise.

crash.en: Double-clicking this icon crashes the desktop.
crash.gloss: To cause an exception that terminates or halts execution.
crash.zh: 双击该图标会使桌面崩溃。

crash.en: After the lightning came the crash of thunder.
crash.gloss: A sudden, intense, loud sound, as made for example by cymbals.
crash.zh: 闪电过后，便是雷霆轰鸣。

crash.en: Hey dude, can I crash at your pad?
crash.gloss: To make or experience informal temporary living arrangements, especially overnight.
crash.zh: 嘿老兄，我可以撞你的垫子吗？

craft.en: She represented the craft of brewers.
craft.gloss: A trade or profession as embodied in its practitioners collectively; the members of a trade or handicraft as a body; an association of these; a trade's union, guild, or ‘company’ .
craft.zh: 她代表了酿酒师的工艺。

craft.en: He learned his craft as an apprentice.
craft.gloss: A branch of skilled work or trade, especially one requiring manual dexterity or artistic skill, but sometimes applied equally to any business, calling or profession; the skilled practice of a practical occupation .
craft.zh: 他作为学徒学习了自己的手艺。

craft.en: A rowing boat is not a seafaring craft.

insight.en: Her questions educed several useful insights.
insight.zh: 她的问题引出了几项有用见解。

terrorist.en: Who is behind these terrorist attacks?
terrorist.zh: 这些恐怖袭击事件的幕后黑手是谁？

terrorist.en: The terrorist was outwardly a bank clerk.
terrorist.zh: 恐怖分子表面上是一名银行职员。
我们不与恐怖分子谈判。

possess.en: Resistors possess resistance and inductors possess inductance.
possess.zh: 电阻器具有电阻，电感器具有电感。

possess.en: Dogs possess a highly developed olfactory system.
possess.zh: 狗拥有高度发达的嗅觉系统。

possess.en: Deer, camels and peccaries possess paraxonic feet.
possess.zh: 鹿、骆驼和西貒拥有拟轴足。

possess.en: He does not even possess a working telephone.
possess.gloss: To have (something) as, or as if as, an owner; to have, to own.
possess.zh: 他甚至没有可用的电话。

possess.en: They thought he was possessed by evil spirits.
possess.gloss: Of a supernatural entity, especially one regarded as evil: to take control of (an animal or person's body or mind).
possess.zh: 他们认为他被邪灵附身了。

tap.en: You can pay by tapping your card.
tap.gloss: To (lightly) touch (a finger, foot, or other body part) on a surface, often repeatedly.

tap.en: What hazies do you have on tap?
Is the tap water here safe to drink?
tap.gloss: A hollow device used to control the flow of a fluid, such as an alcoholic beverage from a cask, or a gas or liquid in a pipe.
tap.zh: 这里的自来水可以安全饮用吗？

tap.en: He tapped the ten-year-old whiskey from its barrel.
tap.gloss: To draw off (a liquid) from a container or other source; also, to draw off a liquid from (a container or other source).
tap.zh: 他从酒桶里轻轻地倒出了十年前的威士忌。

tap.en: Businesses are trying to tap the youth market.
tap.gloss: To break into or open up (a thing) so as to obtain something; to exploit, to penetrate; tap into.
tap.zh: 企业正在努力开拓年轻人市场。

extensive.en: The treatise includes an extensive glossary.
extensive.zh: 这部专著附有详尽的术语表。

extensive.en: His slovenly work required extensive revision.
extensive.zh: 他草率的工作需要大幅修改。

extensive.en: The enactment of legislation followed extensive debate.
extensive.zh: 经过广泛辩论后，这项法律得以颁布。

extensive.en: I have done extensive research on the subject.
extensive.zh: 我对这个主题进行了广泛的研究。

episode.en: I can't wait till next week’s episode.
episode.gloss: A bounded narrative unit within a television series, constituting a single installment that is structurally discrete yet interrelated with the series as a whole.
episode.zh: 我等不及下周的剧集了。

swim.en: An ichthyosaur swam through ancient seas.
swim.zh: 鱼龙游弋于古代海洋中。

swim.en: A shoal of fish swam past.
The porpoise swam toward the open sea.
swim.zh: 这只鼠海豚游向了外海。

swim.gloss: An act or instance of swimming.

swim.en: Half of the guinea pigs were swum daily.
swim.zh: 一半的豚鼠每天都游泳。

fault.en: The captious critic found fault with everything.
fault.zh: 这位吹毛求疵的评论家对什么都挑剔。

fault.en: You're still young, that's your fault.
fault.gloss: A defect, imperfection, or weakness; more severe than a flaw.; A characteristic, positive or negative or both, which increases one's risk of danger or difficulty.

tire.en: The tires provide traction on wet roads.
tire.zh: 这些轮胎在湿滑道路上提供抓地力。

tire.en: The portrait captures his tired, sallow face.
tire.zh: 这幅肖像画出了他疲惫、蜡黄的面容。

tire.en: He was tired, hence his early departure.

loose.en: The technician used solder on a loose wire.
loose.zh: 技术人员在松散的电线上使用了焊料。

loose.en: This wheelbarrow has a loose wheel.
loose.gloss: Not fixed in place tightly or firmly.
loose.zh: 这辆独轮车的轮子松了。
胡言乱语要付出生命的代价。

loose.en: I'm going to loose this game.
It is difficult walking on loose gravel.
loose.zh: 在松散的砾石上行走很困难。

shortly.en: The meeting ended shortly before midmorning.
shortly.zh: 会议在上午中段之前不久结束。

shortly.en: The tissue ulcerated shortly after exposure.
shortly.zh: 暴露后不久，组织就溃烂了。

considerable.zh: 他的影射让人十分尴尬。

considerable.en: We expend considerable effort on calibration.
considerable.zh: 我们在校准上花费了大量精力。

considerable.en: His defeat caused him considerable chagrin.

prior.en: The doctor had known three months prior.
prior.gloss: Chiefly followed by to: in advance, before, previously.
prior.zh: 医生三个月前就知道了。

prior.en: I had no prior knowledge you were coming.
prior.gloss: Coming before in order or time; earlier, former, previous.
prior.zh: 我事先并不知道你会来。

intellectual.en: The school tolerated reasonable intellectual nonconformity.
intellectual.zh: 学校容许合理的思想独立。

intellectual.en: The essay criticizes the argument's intellectual barrenness.
intellectual.zh: 这篇文章批评了该论证的思想贫乏。

intellectual.en: The philosopher’s work gave intellectual illumination to many.
intellectual.zh: 这位哲学家的著作给许多人带来了智力上的启发。

characterize.en: Stylized gestures characterize the choreographic tradition.
characterize.zh: 程式化的手势体现了这种舞蹈编排传统。

characterize.en: How would you characterize fast food?

assault.en: You just bought yourself an assault charge!
assault.zh: 你刚刚给自己买了一个袭击罪名！

assault.en: I'm charging you with assault and battery.
assault.zh: 我要控告你攻击罪和殴打罪。

assault.en: The castle was unprepared for the assault.
The army made an assault on the enemy.
assault.gloss: A violent onset or attack with physical means, for example blows, weapons, etc.

relax.en: He consciously relaxed his stiff shoulders.
relax.zh: 他有意识地放松了僵硬的肩膀。

relax.gloss: To make something loose.; To relieve from constipation; to loosen; to open.
To relieve (someone or someone's mind) of stress; to enable to rest; to calm down.

relax.en: I like to relax by listening to music.
relax.gloss: To rest and become relieved of stress.
relax.zh: 我喜欢通过听音乐来放松。

adventure.gloss: If you have an adventure you have a trip with a lot of excitement, hazards, or dangers.
adventure.zh: 比尔博踏上了冒险之旅。
这真是一次离奇的冒险啊！
这次冒险是互惠互利的。

external.en: This building has some external pipework.
external.gloss: Outside of something; on the exterior.
external.zh: 该建筑有一些外部管道。

external.en: He enjoyed the solemn externals of religion.

external.zh: 他喜欢宗教庄严的外表。

external.en: An enlightened mind does not need external authority.

proof.zh: 这个公设是整个数学证明的基础。
这款特百惠可用洗碗机清洗。

confident.en: He has a confident, unshowy style.
confident.zh: 他有一种自信、不张扬的风格。

headquarters.en: What is up with that project at headquarters?
headquarters.zh: 总部的那个项目进展如何？

headquarters.en: He was at present near the headquarters gates.
headquarters.zh: 他现在就在总部大门附近。

headquarters.en: Headquarters merged the operations of the three divisions.
headquarters.zh: 总部将三个部门的业务合并。

sudden.en: The seismograph recorded a sudden tremor.
sudden.zh: 地震仪记录到了一次突然的震动。

sudden.en: The ductile alloy resisted sudden fracture.
sudden.zh: 这种有延展性的合金抵抗了突然断裂。

sudden.en: A sudden influx strained the town's resources.
sudden.zh: 突然涌入的人群使小镇资源紧张。

dirty.en: I won't accept your dirty money!

dirty.zh: 他用一种肮脏的眼神看着我。

dirty.en: The old flag was a dirty white.

dirty.gloss: Used as an intensifier, especially in conjunction with "great".
dirty.zh: 他住在一座肮脏的大宅里。

violation.en: This violation of our trust cannot be forgiven.
violation.gloss: A violation of a rule is an act of breaking the rule: going past the limits of the rule.
violation.zh: 这种违背我们信任的行为是不可原谅的。

violation.zh: 上个月他违反假释规定。

tongue.gloss: The power of articulate utterance; speech generally.
tongue.zh: 我是如此不知所措，我的舌头抛弃了我。

license.en: Occupational training helped with license renewal.
license.zh: 职业培训有助于执照续期。

license.en: The cops yanked my driver's license.
license.zh: 警察没收了我的驾驶执照。

shelter.en: The boat entered a sheltered inlet.
shelter.zh: 船驶入了一个避风的小海湾。

shelter.en: The rocky overhang sheltered the climbers.
shelter.zh: 突出的岩壁为攀登者提供了遮蔽。

shelter.zh: 牧马人引导马匹走向避雨处。

shelter.zh: 暴雨期间，我们躲在一棵树下。

rub.en: My shoes are beginning to rub.

rub.en: The cat rubbed itself against my leg.

rub.zh: 猫在我的腿上蹭来蹭去。

controversy.en: She courted controversy with her frank speeches.
controversy.zh: 她坦率的演讲引起了争议。

controversy.en: The government wanted to avoid controversy.

entrance.en: Workers secured the entrance to the armory.
entrance.zh: 工人们封好了军械库入口。

entrance.en: Each rentable unit has a separate entrance.
entrance.zh: 每个可出租单元都有独立入口。

entrance.en: A brief scuffle broke out near the entrance.
entrance.zh: 入口附近发生了一场短暂的扭打。

entrance.en: Her entrance attracted no attention whatsoever.
entrance.gloss: The action of entering, or going in.
entrance.zh: 她的出现并没有引起任何注意。

properly.en: The lid wasn't screwed on properly.

properly.zh: 聚会结束后我真的很累了。

defensive.en: The tribes formed a defensive confederacy.
defensive.zh: 这些部族组成了防御联盟。

defensive.en: Our defensive line is too high.

fade.en: The novel portrays a family of fading gentility.
fade.zh: 这部小说描写了一个渐失体面的家庭。

fade.en: Denim has a tendency to fade.

fade.gloss: To sink away; to disappear gradually; to grow dim; to vanish.
fade.zh: 送奶工的口哨声渐渐消失在远方。

tragedy.en: You mustn't blame yourself for this tragedy.
tragedy.zh: 你不应该因为这场悲剧而责怪自己。
莎士比亚的《麦克白》是一部悲剧。

net.en: The fish escaped from the net.
The company reported a net profit.
He kicked the ball into the net.

funeral.en: The mourners left the funeral heavy-hearted and silent.
funeral.zh: 哀悼者离开葬礼时心情沉重，沉默不语。

funeral.en: The yellow blazer was incongruent for the funeral.
funeral.zh: 黄色西装外套与葬礼不协调。

profession.en: Mario and Luigi's profession is plumbers.
profession.zh: 马里奥和路易吉的职业是水管工。

profession.en: My father was a barrister by profession.
profession.gloss: A professional occupation.; An occupation, trade, craft, or activity in which one has a professed expertise in a particular area; a job, especially one requiring a high level of skill or training.

profession.en: She had planned to enter the legal profession.
profession.zh: 她原本计划进入法律行业。

constitute.zh: 这次闯入加强了安全性。

constitute.en: These things constitute a balanced meal.
constitute.zh: 这些东西构成了均衡的膳食。

constitute.en: Music constitutes a part of me.
constitute.zh: 音乐构成了我的一部分。

alter.zh: 这种药改变神经递质活动。

alter.en: They experimentally altered the ambient temperature.
alter.zh: 他们通过实验改变了环境温度。

alter.en: Land reclamation altered the coastal landscape.
alter.zh: 土地开垦改变了沿海地貌。

establishment.en: Not all Anglicans have supported establishment.
establishment.gloss: The institution and official status of a church as a state church, especially that of the Church of England and historically of Ireland.
establishment.zh: 并非所有英国圣公会教徒都支持建国。

establishment.en: A school is an educational establishment.
Bare feet are banned in this establishment.

squeeze.en: Can you squeeze through that gap?
squeeze.gloss: To fit into a tight place.

squeeze.en: I squeezed myself through the crowd.
squeeze.gloss: To fit into a tight place.

squeeze.en: I squeezed the ball between my hands.
squeeze.gloss: To apply pressure (to something) from two or more sides at once.

squeeze.en: I want to be your main squeeze.
squeeze.zh: 我想成为你的主要挤压者。

squeeze.en: He squeezed some money out of his wallet.
squeeze.gloss: To remove something with difficulty, or apparent difficulty.
squeeze.zh: 他从钱包里掏出一些钱。

squeeze.en: Jones squeezed in Smith with a perfect bunt.
squeeze.gloss: To attempt to score a runner from third by bunting.
squeeze.zh: 琼斯用一记完美的短打将史密斯挤了过去。

imagination.en: His imagination makes him a valuable team member.
imagination.zh: 他的想象力使他成为一名有价值的团队成员。

imagination.en: Imagination is an extrarational function of the brain.
imagination.zh: 想象力是大脑的一种超理性功能。

imagination.en: Imagination is a superrational function of the brain.
imagination.zh: 想象力是大脑的超理性功能。

convert.en: Photosynthesis converts light into chemical energy.
convert.zh: 光合作用把光转化为化学能。

convert.en: The dynamo converts motion into electrical energy.
convert.zh: 发电机把运动转化为电能。

convert.en: A kettle converts water into steam.
convert.gloss: To transform or change (something) into another form, substance, state, or product.

convert.en: We converted our pounds into euros.
convert.gloss: To exchange for something of equal value.
convert.zh: 我们把英镑换成了欧元。

convert.gloss: To undergo a conversion of religion, faith or belief (see also sense 3).
convert.zh: 我们已经皈依卫理公会。

convert.en: The chair converts into a bed.

comprehensive.zh: 这是一个综合性的方法。
伊斯兰教是一个综合性的宗教。

prominent.en: Place the slogan in a more prominent position.
prominent.gloss: Likely to attract attention from its size or position; conspicuous.
prominent.zh: 将口号放在更显眼的位置。

prominent.en: The action group has outed many prominent celebrities.
prominent.zh: 该行动小组已经推出了许多知名名人。

prominent.en: The moons Dione and Europa have prominent lineae.
prominent.zh: 土卫四和木卫二卫星都有明显的纹路。

presentation.zh: 她的演讲使高管们很高兴。

presentation.en: I beefed my presentation hard yesterday.
presentation.zh: 昨天我大力加强了我的演讲。

presentation.en: I just inboxed you the presentation.
presentation.zh: 我刚刚将演示文稿收件箱发送给您。

regardless.en: Tatiana ate the cauliflower regardless its colour.
regardless.gloss: Synonym of regardless of; paying no attention to.
regardless.zh: 塔蒂亚娜不管花椰菜颜色如何，都吃了它。

regardless.en: He smoked cigars regardless of the consequences.

regardless.zh: 无论如何，今晚我要出去。

load.en: The wheel bears a radial load.
load.zh: 这个轮子承受着径向载荷。

load.en: The shaft bears an axial load.
load.zh: 这根轴承受着轴向载荷。

load.en: The beam bears a transverse load.

load.gloss: To place in or on a conveyance or a place of storage.
load.zh: 码头工人迅速装载货物。

load.en: The containers load quickly and easily.
load.gloss: To be placed into storage or conveyance.

load.en: He walks to load the bases.
load.gloss: To put runners on first, second and third bases

stable.en: Interlocking pieces make the structure stable.
stable.zh: 相互咬合的构件使结构稳定。

stable.en: The satellite entered a stable orbital path.
stable.zh: 这颗卫星进入了稳定轨道。

stable.en: This mammalian endotherm maintains a stable temperature.
stable.zh: 这种内温哺乳动物保持稳定体温。

stable.en: He was in a stable relationship.
stable.gloss: Relatively unchanging, steady, permanent; firmly fixed or established; consistent; not easily moved, altered, or destroyed.

introduction.en: Her trepidation subsided after the introduction.
introduction.zh: 介绍完后，她的紧张不安减轻了。

introduction.en: A judgment concludes the introduction of further evidence.
introduction.zh: 判决结束后引入了进一步的证据。

pretend.zh: 让我们假装我们是外星人。

elderly.zh: 她供养着一位年长的家属。

elderly.en: The exhausting journey enervated the elderly traveller.
elderly.zh: 这趟耗人的旅程使年长的旅行者疲惫不堪。

elderly.en: He lives next door to an elderly.
elderly.zh: 他住在一位老人的隔壁。

representation.en: He made a feeling representation of his wrongs.
