custom.zh: 许多古老习俗所禁止的内容如今已被接受。

economist.en: For quotations using this term, see Citations:political economist.
economist.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文：政治经济学家。
约瑟夫是一位熟练的经济学家。
这位经济学家并不简洁。

fifteen.en: Fifteen ducks swim on the lake.
fifteen.gloss: ordinal fifteenth) Fifteen is the number that is after fourteen and before sixteen. It can also be written as 15.
fifteen.zh: 十五只鸭子在湖里游泳。

fifteen.en: The fifteen were leaving the city.
fifteen.gloss: A set of fifteen things or persons.
fifteen.zh: 十五人即将离开这座城市。

celebration.en: The plutocrat funded the extravagant centennial celebration.
celebration.zh: 这位富豪资助了奢华的百年庆典。

celebration.en: The local gazette covered the centennial celebrations.
celebration.zh: 当地报纸报道了百年庆祝活动。
圣诞节是一年一度的庆祝活动。

celebration.en: We will attend the Christmas celebration in church.
celebration.gloss: The formal performance of a solemn rite, such as Christian sacrament.
celebration.zh: 我们将参加教堂的圣诞节庆祝活动。

celebration.en: The celebrations around here for Easter are enjoyable.
celebration.gloss: The observance of a holiday or feast day, as by solemnities.
celebration.zh: 这里的复活节庆祝活动很愉快。

soup.zh: 这碗温吞的汤需要重新加热。

soup.en: The soup tasted insipid without seasoning.
soup.zh: 没有调味的汤淡而无味。

soup.en: The soup became more palatable after seasoning.
soup.zh: 调味后，这汤变得更加可口。

soup.en: Pho is a traditional Vietnamese soup.
soup.gloss: Any of various dishes commonly made by combining liquids, such as water or stock, with other ingredients, such as meat and vegetables, that contribute the food value, flavor, and texture.
soup.zh: 河粉是一种传统的越南汤。

efficient.en: Efficient utilization of water improves crop yields.
efficient.zh: 高效利用水可以提高作物产量。

composition.en: Demography examines population size and composition.
composition.zh: 人口学研究人口规模和构成。

composition.en: Silicate structures vary with their chemical composition.
composition.zh: 硅酸盐结构随化学成分而变化。

composition.en: He envied the composition of their faculty.
composition.gloss: something that is created by arranging several things to form a unified whole

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

composition.zh: 他羡慕他们师资队伍的组成。

satisfy.en: The meal should satisfy your hunger.
satisfy.zh: 这顿饭应该能让你填饱肚子。

satisfy.en: That brief explanation will never satisfy.
satisfy.zh: 这种简短的解释永远不会令人满意。

satisfy.en: This proposal will satisfy both business and labor.
satisfy.zh: 这项提议将使企业和劳工双方都满意。

briefly.zh: 他只在这里短暂工作过。

briefly.en: He covered the subject briefly in his book.
briefly.zh: 他在书中简要介绍了这个主题。
简单地告诉我发生了什么事。

pile.en: We piled the camel with our loads.
pile.gloss: To cover with heaps; or in great abundance; to fill or overfill; to load.
pile.zh: 我们把货物堆在骆驼上。

pile.en: The pile of pennies began to topple.
We raked all the leaves into a pile.
pile.zh: 我们把所有的树叶耙成一堆。

pile.en: They were piling up wood on the wheelbarrow.
pile.gloss: To lay or throw into a pile or heap; to heap up; to collect into a mass; to accumulate
pile.zh: 他们正在独轮车上堆木头。

carbon.en: Carbon monoxide is a silent killer.
My carbon footprint is very high.
Press firmly: you are making a carbon.
carbon.zh: 用力按压：您正在制作碳。

closer.en: The clubs maintain close fraternal relations.
closer.zh: 这些俱乐部保持着亲密友好的关系。

closer.en: Their tenancy ends at the month's close.
closer.zh: 他们的租期在月底结束。

closer.en: The project requires close co-operation between departments.
closer.zh: 这个项目需要部门之间密切合作。

closer.en: They brought their closer in for the ninth.
closer.gloss: A relief pitcher who specializes in getting the last three outs of the game.
closer.zh: 他们在第九局比赛中更接近了比分。

consume.en: This bulb consumes only one watt.
consume.zh: 这个灯泡只消耗一瓦功率。

consume.en: The project consumed an inordinate amount of time.
consume.zh: 这个项目耗费了过多时间。

consume.en: The building was consumed by fire.
consume.zh: 这座建筑被大火烧毁了。

consume.gloss: To completely occupy the thoughts or attention of.

scheme.en: The scheme required the supervisor's connivance.
scheme.zh: 这个计划需要主管暗中配合。

scheme.en: High costs demonstrated the scheme's impracticality.
scheme.zh: 高成本表明了这个方案的不实用性。

scheme.en: The image uses a monochromatic color scheme.
scheme.zh: 这幅图像采用单色配色。

scheme.en: Her brain is continually fermenting new schemes.
scheme.gloss: A plot or secret, devious plan.
scheme.zh: 她的大脑不断酝酿新的计划。

crack.en: The hatchling struggled through the cracked eggshell.
crack.zh: 幼体挣扎着钻出了裂开的蛋壳。
他的声音因激动而沙哑。

crack.gloss: To make a crack or cracks in.
To overcome a security system or component.

frequency.en: The frequency of the light is upshifted.
What frequency is Tatoeba FM on?
frequency.zh: Tatoeba FM 的频率是多少？

tobacco.zh: 烟草是一种应课税商品。

tobacco.en: Tobacco smoke contains many toxic substances.
tobacco.zh: 烟草烟雾中含有多种有毒物质。

tobacco.en: Tobacco companies develop carefully calculated media campaigns.
tobacco.zh: 烟草公司精心策划媒体宣传活动。

survivor.en: A joint life last survivor term assurance contract.
survivor.zh: 共同生命最后幸存者定期保证合同。

besides.en: I don't want to go anywhere besides India.
besides.gloss: Other than; except for; instead of.
besides.zh: 除了印度我哪儿也不想去。

besides.en: I have been to Spain but nowhere besides.
besides.zh: 我去过西班牙，但除此之外别无他处。

psychologist.zh: 我是一名普通心理学家。

wealthy.en: My intention was to marry a wealthy widow.
wealthy.zh: 我本打算娶一位富有的寡妇。

galaxy.en: She really wants a Samsung Galaxy.
galaxy.zh: 她真的想要一部三星 Galaxy。

galaxy.en: The Andromeda Galaxy is my home.
I live in the Andromeda Galaxy.

given.en: Please give a succinct account of events.
She performed well under/in/given the circumstances.
given.zh: 在这种情况下，她表现得很好。

given.en: The patient was given anticoagulation treatment.

limitation.zh: 尽管如此，它还是有一些局限性。
他的健康状况是一个限制。

trace.en: The book traces the genesis of cubism.
trace.zh: 这本书追溯了立体主义的起源。

trace.en: The exhibition traces the history of portraiture.
trace.zh: 这个展览追溯了肖像画的发展史。

trace.en: The essay traces the history of vitalism.
trace.zh: 这篇文章追溯了活力论的历史。

trace.en: There are traces of chocolate around your lips.
trace.gloss: A very small amount, often residual, of some substance or material.
trace.zh: 你的嘴唇周围有巧克力的痕迹。

appointment.en: The gazette published the official appointments.
A secretive cabal tried to influence appointments.
appointment.zh: 一个秘密小集团试图影响人事任命。

appointment.en: His appointment as treasurer was deemed suitable.
appointment.gloss: The act of appointing a person to hold an office or to have a position of trust.
appointment.zh: 任命他为司库被认为是合适的。

appointment.en: They made an appointment to meet at six.
appointment.gloss: An arrangement between people to meet; an engagement.

preference.en: He has a preference for crisp wines.
preference.gloss: The selection of one thing or person over others (with the main adposition being "for" in relation to the thing or person, but possibly also "of")

preference.en: She drank gin and tonic by preference.
preference.zh: 她最喜欢喝杜松子酒和奎宁水。

explosion.gloss: An explosion is when something explodes.

explosion.en: He lost his hearing in the explosion.
explosion.zh: 他在爆炸中失去了听力。

meter.en: Iambics are one form of poetic meter.
meter.zh: 抑扬格是诗歌格律的一种形式。

incredible.en: The telescope captured incredible images from outer space.
incredible.zh: 该望远镜从外太空捕捉到了令人难以置信的图像。
这是一个令人难以置信的地方。

publicly.en: He will avow his support publicly.
He publicly proposed to his girlfriend.
publicly.gloss: If something is done publicly, it is done in public.

publicly.zh: 他公开宣称自己是领导人。

fighter.en: The fighter returned to training after recovery.
fighter.zh: 这名战士康复后返回训练。

fighter.en: The fighter slugged his opponent into unconsciousness.
fighter.zh: 拳击手将对手打得失去知觉。

fighter.en: The prize fighter quickly flattened his challenger.
fighter.zh: 这位职业拳击手很快就击垮了他的挑战者。

rapid.en: Porous soil allows rapid water drainage.
rapid.zh: 多孔的土壤使水迅速排出。

rapid.en: The gyroscope maintains stability through rapid gyration.
rapid.zh: 陀螺仪通过快速旋转保持稳定。

rapid.en: You must be so damn rapid.

hunter.gloss: One who hunts or seeks after anything.

admission.zh: 入场费为每人 10 英镑。

admission.en: I request admission for two adults.
admission.gloss: Permission to enter, or the entrance itself; admittance; entrance; access

admission.en: Admission is three dollars a head.

ski.en: They ski winters in the Laurentians.
ski.zh: 他们在劳伦山脉滑雪冬天。

educate.zh: 她是一个有教养的女孩。

painful.en: The injury made walking painful for several days.
painful.zh: 这次受伤让他一连几天走路都感到疼痛。

aide.en: The educator requested help from an aide.
aide.zh: 教育工作者向助手请求帮助。

aide.en: We aided him in his business.

friendship.en: Friendship sustained her through every tribulation.
friendship.zh: 友谊支撑她渡过了每一次磨难。

friendship.en: The long-standing friendship survived the disagreement.
friendship.zh: 这段长久的友谊经受住了这次分歧。

friendship.en: Their conversation became a prelude to friendship.
friendship.zh: 他们的交谈成了友谊的开端。

friendship.gloss: Friendship is being friends with someone.

infant.en: The infant let out a lusty cry.
infant.zh: 婴儿发出了一声响亮的啼哭。

infant.en: A sudden noise may waken the infant.
infant.zh: 突然的噪声可能吵醒婴儿。

infant.en: The infant showed an inborn grasping reflex.
infant.zh: 这个婴儿表现出了天生的抓握反射。

fifty.zh: 我们可以去二点五十分。
我们招募了五十名新成员。

fifty.en: There were fifty people in my class.

calculate.en: Calculate the determinant of this matrix.
calculate.zh: 计算这个矩阵的行列式。

calculate.en: The accountant calculated the equipment's depreciation.
calculate.zh: 会计计算了设备的折旧。

calculate.en: Calculate the roll of that aircraft.

tendency.en: Denim has a tendency to fade.
tendency.gloss: A likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction; a tending toward.

tendency.en: Unflighted darts have a tendency to tumble.
tendency.zh: 未飞行的飞镖有翻滚的倾向。
这种倾向是非常有用的。

rid.en: We’re trying to rid the world of poverty.
rid.gloss: Followed by of: to free (oneself or someone, or a place) from an annoyance or hindrance.
rid.zh: 我们正在努力让世界摆脱贫困。

rid.en: We rid his house of mice.
rid.zh: 我们帮他消灭了家里的老鼠。

rid.en: Please rid me of this pain.

porch.en: She sat on the back porch hulling peanuts.
Leave the box on the porch.

uniform.en: The uniform was standard prison issue.
uniform.zh: 制服是标准的监狱制服。

uniform.en: She runs after any man in uniform!
uniform.zh: 她追任何穿制服的男人！

uniform.en: I never saw such a hokie band uniform.
uniform.zh: 我从来没有见过这样的霍基乐队制服。

scholarship.en: She checked her eligibility for the scholarship.
scholarship.zh: 她检查了自己获得奖学金的资格。

scholarship.en: He is proud of his scholarship.
scholarship.zh: 他为自己的奖学金感到自豪。

formation.en: The choreographic sequence uses concentric formations.
formation.zh: 这段舞蹈编排使用了同心圆队形。

formation.en: Dripstone formations hang from the cave ceiling.

reservation.en: I have reservations about your intentions.
reservation.gloss: A limiting qualification regarding certainty or risk; a doubt or concern.
reservation.zh: 我对你的意图持保留态度。

reservation.en: The committee authorised the reservation of funds.
reservation.gloss: The act of reserving, withholding or keeping back.

reservation.en: I agreed to testify without any mental reservation.
reservation.zh: 我毫无保留地同意出庭作证。

efficiency.en: Improved efficiency was an unexpected by-product.
efficiency.zh: 效率提高是一个意外的附带结果。

efficiency.en: The efficiency of this loudspeaker is 40%.
efficiency.gloss: The extent to which a resource is used for the intended purpose.; The ratio of useful work to energy expended. Often given the symbol η.

efficiency.en: The efficiency of the planning department is deplorable.
efficiency.gloss: The extent to which a resource is used for the intended purpose.; The extent to which time is well used for the intended task.
efficiency.zh: 规划部门的效率低得可怜。

efficiency.en: I have an efficiency available June through July.
efficiency.zh: 我有六月到七月的效率。

qualify.en: The dieter consulted a qualified dietitian.
qualify.zh: 这位节食者咨询了一位合格的营养师。

qualify.en: He is qualified as a solicitor.

mall.en: Our teenager has become a mall rat.
mall.zh: 我们的青少年已经成为商场老鼠。

mall.en: The new mall should be a major attraction.
mall.zh: 新的购物中心应该是一个主要景点。

mall.en: Those teenagers like to hang around the mall.
mall.zh: 那些青少年喜欢在商场里闲逛。

derive.en: Some English words derive from Japanese.
derive.zh: 一些英语单词源自日语。

derive.en: Bob derives pleasure from observing insects.
derive.zh: 鲍勃从观察昆虫中获得乐趣。

scandal.en: The scandal brought an ignominious end.
scandal.zh: 丑闻带来了不光彩的结局。

scandal.en: The scandal may taint the conglomerate's reputation.
scandal.zh: 这起丑闻可能玷污这个企业集团的声誉。

scandal.en: The scandal brought the institution into disrepute.
scandal.zh: 这起丑闻使该机构名誉扫地。

scandal.en: The incident brought considerable scandal to his family.
scandal.zh: 这件事给他的家人带来了很大的丑闻。

scandal.en: According to village scandal, they weren't even married.
scandal.zh: 根据村里的丑闻，他们甚至没有结婚。

helpful.en: Nonprofessional reviewers offered helpful practical feedback.
helpful.zh: 非专业审阅者提供了有用的实际反馈。

helpful.en: The manuscript was filled with helpful annotations.
helpful.zh: 手稿充满了有用的注释。

helpful.en: I was surprised by how helpful he was.
helpful.zh: 我对他的乐于助人感到惊讶。

impress.en: The palace's grandeur impressed every visitor.
impress.zh: 宫殿的宏伟给每位游客留下了深刻印象。

impress.en: Her prodigious memory impressed the academician.
impress.zh: 她惊人的记忆力令那位院士赞叹。

impress.en: Her deft movements impressed the audience.
impress.zh: 她灵巧的动作给观众留下了深刻印象。

impress.en: He impressed his signature into the wax.
impress.gloss: To mark or stamp (something) using pressure; to apply (something) using pressure.; To produce (a mark, stamp, image, etc.); to imprint (a mark or figure upon something).
impress.zh: 他在蜡上留下了自己的签名。

impress.en: I will impress the schedule upon her.
impress.gloss: To mark or stamp (something) using pressure; to apply (something) using pressure.; To produce a vivid impression of (something); to convince someone of one's nature.
impress.zh: 我会把日程安排给她留下深刻的印象。

impress.en: You impressed me with your command of Urdu.
impress.gloss: To affect (someone) strongly and often favourably; to inspire admiration from (someone).
impress.zh: 你对乌尔都语的掌握给我留下了深刻的印象。

heel.en: She called to her dog to heel.
heel.gloss: To follow at somebody's heels; to chase closely.

heel.en: I caught my heel on the threshold.
For quotations using this term, see Citations:Achilles' heel.
heel.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文：致命弱点。

humor.en: His subversive humor challenged established conventions.
humor.zh: 他颠覆性的幽默挑战了既定惯例。

humor.en: His irreverent humor amused the audience.
humor.zh: 他不拘敬意的幽默逗乐了观众。

humor.en: The satirist exposed hypocrisy through irreverent humor.
humor.zh: 这位讽刺作家通过不敬的幽默揭露虚伪。

resemble.en: The flounder's coloring resembles the sandy seabed.
resemble.zh: 比目鱼的颜色与沙质海底相似。

resemble.gloss: To be like or similar to (something); to represent as similar.

resemble.zh: 这个女孩很像她的母亲。

fabric.zh: 这块布料上绣着精细的图案。

fabric.en: They sold the fabric remnant cheaply.
fabric.zh: 他们把那块剩余布料廉价卖掉了。

fabric.en: The fabric can imbibe moisture rapidly.
fabric.zh: 这种织物可以迅速吸收水分。

contest.zh: 这是一场势均力敌的比赛。

contest.en: The child entered the spelling contest.
contest.zh: 这孩子参加了拼写比赛。

contest.en: I'll take a Porsche, no contest!
contest.zh: 我会开一辆保时捷，没有竞争！

contest.en: The troops contested every inch of ground.
contest.gloss: To strive earnestly to hold or maintain; to struggle to defend.

proportion.en: Don't blow things out of proportion.
The proportion of ozone increases sharply.

guideline.en: The guideline expressed caution against excessive radiographic imaging.
guideline.zh: 该指南对过度放射线成像表示谨慎。

guideline.en: We have very strict guidelines here.
guideline.zh: 我们这里有非常严格的指导方针。

rifle.en: A single rifle shot downed the mighty beast.
rifle.zh: 一枪射倒了这头强大的野兽。

rifle.en: Chewbacca blasted the Stormtroopers with his laser rifle.
rifle.zh: 丘巴卡用他的激光步枪轰击了冲锋队。

conviction.zh: 没有什么能够动摇他的信念。

maintenance.zh: 液压制动器需要定期维护。
定期维护可防止问题再次发生。

maintenance.en: The new levy funds road maintenance.
maintenance.zh: 新征收的税用于道路养护。

trick.en: They came a trick on me.
He played an ugly trick on us.
trick.zh: 他对我们玩了一个丑陋的把戏。

trick.en: Wow, your new sportscar is so trick.
trick.zh: 哇，你的新跑车太诡异了。

trick.en: They played a crude trick on the teacher.
trick.gloss: Mischievous or annoying behavior; a prank.
trick.zh: 他们对老师做了一个粗俗的恶作剧。

examination.en: Recurrent headaches prompted a medical examination.
examination.zh: 反复头痛促使他去做了医学检查。

examination.en: He approached the examination with trepidation.
examination.zh: 他怀着惶恐的心情参加考试。

examination.en: Two teachers will invigilate the examination.
Did you pass the English examination last week?
examination.gloss: An examination is a formal test, usually important and often at the end of a course.
examination.zh: 你上周的英语考试通过了吗？

organic.en: Organic farms only use soil-friendly fertilisers.
organic.zh: 有机农场只使用对土壤友好的肥料。

organic.en: This drink is one hundred percent organic.
organic.zh: 这种饮料是百分百有机的。

organic.en: The production came together in an organic whole.
organic.zh: 作品形成了一个有机的整体。

tent.zh: 简早些时候对帐篷进行了热箱处理。
啤酒节啤酒帐篷被挤得水泄不通。

tent.en: The sheet tented over his midsection.
tent.gloss: To form into a tent-like shape.

tent.en: We were camping in a three-man tent.
tent.gloss: A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.
tent.zh: 我们在一个三人帐篷里露营。

tent.en: We’ll be tenting at the campground this weekend.
tent.zh: 这个周末我们将在露营地搭帐篷。

publisher.en: My publisher put up with my authorisms.
publisher.zh: 我的出版商容忍了我的独裁。

publisher.en: We are not affiliated with any commercial publisher.
publisher.zh: 我们不隶属于任何商业出版商。
我们首先需要一个出版商。

strengthen.zh: 它的颁布加强了环境保护。

strengthen.en: Susan's doing sit-ups to strengthen her muscles.
strengthen.zh: 苏珊正在做仰卧起坐来增强肌肉。

proposed.en: The mediator proposed an equitable solution.
proposed.zh: 调解员提出了一个公平的解决方案。

proposed.en: The proposed route is economically practicable.
proposed.zh: 拟议的路线在经济上可行。

proposed.en: They fulminate about every proposed alteration.
proposed.zh: 他们对每一项拟议的改动都猛烈抱怨。

myth.en: His story is a pure myth.
myth.gloss: An invented story, theory, or concept.

myth.en: They sought to explode the myth.
myth.zh: 他们试图打破这个神话。

myth.en: The scientific evidence upended the popular myth.
myth.zh: 科学证据推翻了流行的神话。

cow.en: The only meat I eat is cow.

asleep.gloss: In a state of sleep; also, broadly, resting.

nerve.gloss: A bundle of neurons with their connective tissue sheaths, blood vessels and lymphatics.

nerve.en: His nerves could no longer handle the worry.

membership.en: The terms of membership agreement were vague.
membership.gloss: The state of being a member of a group or organization.

membership.en: He has memberships in clubs in three cities.
membership.gloss: The state of being a member of a group or organization.
membership.zh: 他在三个城市的俱乐部拥有会员资格。

membership.en: Nonsalary benefits include membership of the company gym.
membership.zh: 非工资福利包括公司健身房的会员资格。

menu.en: A registered dietitian reviewed the menu.
menu.zh: 一位注册营养师审查了菜单。

menu.en: The server handed us the menu.
menu.gloss: A list containing the food and beverages served at a restaurant, café, or bar. Menus may be printed on paper sheets provided to customers, put on a large poster or display board inside the establishment, displayed outside the restaurant, or digital.

menu.en: They took the chicken sandwich off their menu.
menu.gloss: The food or drinks that are available in a restaurant, café, or bar.
menu.zh: 他们把鸡肉三明治从菜单上去掉了。

bombing.zh: 历史学家记录了这次爆炸事件。

bombing.en: The bombing resulted in wholesale destruction.
The building was destroyed by enemy bombing.

ratio.en: The octave has a pitch ratio of 2:1.

controversial.en: The treatise propounds several controversial ideas.
controversial.zh: 这部专著提出了几个有争议的观点。

controversial.zh: 他被任命为首席大法官引起了争议。

controversial.en: Brangelina is the most controversial couple in Hollywood.
controversial.gloss: Something that is causing debate, causing talk and discussion.
controversial.zh: 布兰吉利娜是好莱坞最具争议的一对。

desperate.en: He was desperate, playing behind the eight-ball.

lifestyle.zh: 他的生活方式非常自由。

lifestyle.en: It was a glamorous but shallow lifestyle.
lifestyle.zh: 这是一种光鲜亮丽但肤浅的生活方式。

loud.en: Don't play your radio so loud!
loud.zh: 别把收音机开得那么大声！

loud.zh: 他们大声的笑声暴露了他们的存在。

loud.en: Turn that music down; it's too loud.
loud.zh: 把音乐调小一点；太大声了。

glove.en: The knight offered his glove as a gage.
glove.zh: 骑士以手套作为挑战信物。

glove.en: I wore gloves to keep my hands warm.
glove.gloss: An item of clothing, covering all or part of the hand and fingers, but usually allowing independent movement of the fingers.

photographer.gloss: A photographer is a person who takes photographs as his work.

helicopter.gloss: An aircraft that is borne along by one or more sets of long rotating blades which allow it to hover, move in any direction including reverse, or land; and typically having a smaller set of blades on its tail to stabilize the aircraft.
helicopter.zh: 我们乘坐直升机飞越城市上空。

helicopter.zh: 这架直升机被地对空导弹击落。

modest.en: They lived in genteel but modest surroundings.

modest.zh: 这家寄宿公寓提供简朴的房间和饭食。

motor.zh: 汽车保险对于年轻人来说很昂贵。

overlook.zh: 这间古雅的小屋俯瞰着一个避风海湾。

float.en: I’d love to just float downstream.
float.gloss: To move in a particular direction with the liquid in which one is floating.

float.gloss: To not be tied to a reference.; (of currencies) To have an exchange value determined by the markets, as opposed to by central fiat.

undergo.gloss: To suffer or endure; bear with.

sequence.zh: 这段舞蹈编排使用了同心圆队形。

jet.zh: 喷气推进为飞机提供动力。

ritual.en: The priests carried out the religious ritual carefully.
ritual.gloss: A rite; a repeated set of actions, especially in religious contexts (that is, a service).
ritual.zh: 祭司们认真地进行着宗教仪式。

ritual.en: They performed the ritual lighting of the candles.
ritual.gloss: Related to a rite or repeated set of actions.
ritual.zh: 他们举行了点燃蜡烛的仪式。

insect.en: The insect's mimetic coloring conceals it.
insect.zh: 这种昆虫的拟态色彩使它隐蔽起来。

insect.en: Mimicry helps the insect avoid predators.
insect.zh: 拟态帮助这种昆虫躲避捕食者。

insect.en: The biologist studied cannibalism among certain insects.
insect.zh: 生物学家研究了某些昆虫的同类相食现象。

salmon.en: Salmon return to their natal streams.
salmon.zh: 鲑鱼回到它们出生的溪流。

salmon.en: The salmon are first headed and then scaled.
salmon.zh: 鲑鱼首先去头，然后去鳞。

interrupt.en: The clamour outside interrupted their deliberations.
interrupt.zh: 外面的喧闹打断了他们的讨论。

interrupt.en: The trip interrupted their otherwise humdrum week.
interrupt.zh: 这次旅行打破了他们原本单调的一周。

interrupt.en: The packet receiver circuit interrupted the microprocessor.
interrupt.gloss: To assert to (a computer) that an exceptional condition must be handled.
interrupt.zh: 数据包接收器电路中断了微处理器。

trading.en: The trading bloc supports multilateral agreements.
trading.zh: 这个贸易集团支持多边协议。

trading.en: Maritime trade depends on navigable waterways.
trading.zh: 海上贸易依赖可以通航的水道。

trading.en: Trade contributed to the kingdom's flourishment.
trading.zh: 贸易促进了这个王国的繁荣。

superior.en: I was foiled by my superior.
We submit to their superior judgment.
superior.zh: 我们服从他们的上级判断。

superior.en: A genus is superior to a species.

magic.en: Witches and mages have magic powers.
magic.zh: 女巫和法师拥有魔法力量。

magic.en: The tale is full of magic and sorcery.
magic.zh: 这个故事充满了魔法和巫术。

magic.en: Sympathetic magic is based on imitation or correspondence.
magic.zh: 同情魔法是基于模仿或对应。

combat.zh: 我们的儿子在战斗中牺牲了。
乌克兰的战斗损失有所增加。

surgeon.zh: 外科医生使用了无菌器械。

surgeon.en: The surgeon examined the cranial cavity.
That surgeon has a great job.
surgeon.zh: 那个外科医生有一份很棒的工作。

stem.en: The cactus has thick, spined stems.
stem.zh: 这株仙人掌有粗壮带刺的茎。

stem.en: Thematic vowels are part of the stem.
stem.gloss: (linguistics) the form of a word after all affixes are removed

source.name: Open English WordNet 2025
source.attribution: Open English Wordnet Community; derived from Princeton WordNet
source.adaptation: Initial capitalization and final punctuation normalized

stem.zh: 主题元音是词干的一部分。

stem.en: The stem of the mushroom is squamulose.

acceptable.en: The plan is acceptable in principle.
acceptable.zh: 该计划原则上可以接受。

acceptable.en: Marrying interracially was not always socially acceptable.
acceptable.zh: 异族通婚并不总是被社会所接受。

rape.zh: 丹妮亚遭到强奸和酷刑。

physics.zh: 她最喜欢的科目是物理。

physics.en: I know squat about nuclear physics.
Algebra is typically a prerequisite for physics.
physics.zh: 代数通常是物理学的先决条件。

counsel.en: I would counsel prudence in this matter.
counsel.zh: 我建议在这件事上要谨慎。

counsel.en: The lawyer counselled his client to remain silent.
counsel.gloss: To give advice, especially professional advice, to (somebody).
counsel.zh: 律师建议他的委托人保持沉默。

hunt.zh: 猫头鹰通常在夜间捕猎。

hunt.en: The police are hunting for evidence.
hunt.gloss: To try to find something; search (for).

hunt.en: He was hunted from the parish.
hunt.gloss: To drive; to chase; with down, from, away, etc.

hunt.en: Did you hunt that pony last week?
hunt.gloss: To use or manage (dogs, horses, etc.) in hunting.
hunt.zh: 上周你猎杀那匹小马了吗？

hunt.en: He hunts the woods, or the country.
hunt.gloss: To use or traverse in pursuit of game.
hunt.zh: 他在树林里或乡村里打猎。

jeans.en: Traditionally most jeans are dyed dark blue.
jeans.gloss: A pair of trousers made from denim cotton.
jeans.zh: 传统上，大多数牛仔裤都染成深蓝色。

jeans.en: He wore brown jeans for his birthday.
jeans.zh: 他生日时穿了棕色牛仔裤。

continuous.en: The nozzle extrudes a thin continuous filament.
continuous.zh: 喷嘴挤出一条细而连续的丝。
连续函数是 Borel 可测量的。

continuous.en: Continuous watchfulness is maintained around the clock.

log.en: To multiply two numbers, add their logs.
log.zh: 要将两个数字相乘，请将它们的对数相加。

log.en: Abraham Lincoln was born in a log cabin.
log.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯出生在一个小木屋里。

echo.en: The mournful melody echoed through the nave.
echo.zh: 哀伤的旋律在教堂中殿回荡。

echo.en: Sid echoed his father’s point of view.
echo.zh: 席德赞同他父亲的观点。
这幅作品呼应了梵高的风格。

pill.en: Pilling the cat is such a nightmare.
pill.gloss: To medicate with pills; to administer pills to.
pill.zh: 给猫打药真是一场噩梦。

pill.en: Take a chill pill, and calm down.
pill.zh: 吃一颗定心丸，冷静一下。

pill.en: This pill provides 500 units of Vitamin E.
pill.zh: 该药丸提供 500 单位的维生素 E。

excited.en: The excited children began to gabble.
excited.zh: 兴奋的孩子们开始急促地说个不停。
整个静修所都兴奋不已。

excited.en: He was so excited, he pogged.
excited.zh: 他太兴奋了，一蹦一跳的。

excited.en: He was very excited about his promotion.
excited.gloss: Having great enthusiasm, passion and energy.
excited.zh: 他对自己的晋升感到非常兴奋。

sculpture.en: An assemblage of sculptures filled the gallery.

sculpture.zh: 我焊接了一个金属雕塑。

sculpture.en: Michelangelo's "David" is an exemplar of Renaissance sculpture.
sculpture.zh: 米开朗基罗的《大卫》是文艺复兴时期雕塑的典范。

compound.en: They identified the active moiety of the compound.
compound.zh: 他们识别出了这个化合物的活性部分。

compound.en: They developed an antimalarially active compound.
compound.zh: 他们开发了一种具有抗疟活性的化合物。

compound.en: This new compound has bioherbicidal potential.
compound.zh: 这种新化合物具有生物除草潜力。

flour.en: She brushed the flour off my clothes.
flour.zh: 她把我衣服上的面粉掸掉。

flour.en: Flour is a basic ingredient of bread.
flour.zh: 面粉是面包的基本成分。

flour.en: Flour the surface before rolling out the dough.
flour.gloss: To apply flour to something; to cover with flour.
flour.zh: 在擀面团之前先在表面撒上面粉。

bare.zh: 这只是一个赤裸裸的断言。

bare.en: She bared her teeth at him.

integrate.en: The refugees integrated well into the community.
integrate.gloss: To join a group or an environment harmoniously; to make oneself fit in.
integrate.zh: 难民很好地融入了社区。
马克帮助杰西卡快速融入。
我们融入了他们的集体。

presidency.en: In France, a presidency lasts for five years.
presidency.gloss: The time during which one is president; a president's term of office.

presidency.en: She put in her bid for the presidency.

rent.en: The avaricious proprietor demanded excessive rent.
rent.zh: 贪婪的房主索要过高的租金。

rent.en: He rented a small bedsit near college.
rent.zh: 他在大学附近租了一间兼作起居室的卧室。

rent.en: They rented a commodious house near town.
rent.zh: 他们在城镇附近租了一栋宽敞的房子。

rent.en: I am asking £300 a week rent.
rent.gloss: A payment made by a tenant at intervals in order to lease a property.
rent.zh: 我要求每周租金 300 英镑。

slope.en: Lateral movement increases traction on slopes.
slope.zh: 横向移动会增加斜坡上的抓地力。

slope.en: The grassy bank slopes toward the river.
slope.zh: 长满青草的河岸向河流倾斜。

slope.en: The expedition mapped the seamount's steep slopes.
slope.zh: 考察队测绘了这座海底山的陡坡。

slope.en: The order was given to "slope arms".
slope.gloss: To hold a rifle at a slope with forearm perpendicular to the body in front holding the butt, the rifle resting on the shoulder.

slope.en: The road slopes sharply down at that point.
slope.gloss: To tend steadily upward or downward.
slope.zh: 道路在那一点急剧倾斜。

subtle.en: Critics laud the novel's subtle characterization.
subtle.zh: 评论家赞扬这部小说细腻的人物刻画。

subtle.en: Her delineation of character was remarkably subtle.
subtle.zh: 她对人物性格的描绘十分细腻。

subtle.en: Don't overaccessorize: go for a subtle look instead.
subtle.zh: 不要过度装饰：选择低调的外观。

greatly.gloss: To a great extent or degree.
greatly.zh: 我非常崇拜猫王埃尔维斯·普雷斯利。

greatly.en: He was greatly agitated by the news.
greatly.zh: 这个消息使他非常激动。

greatly.en: I was greatly relieved by the jury's verdict.
greatly.zh: 陪审团的裁决让我松了一口气。

bishop.en: The bishop is a colourbound piece.
The player's knight jumped the opponent's bishop.
bishop.zh: 玩家的马跳过了对手的象。

bishop.en: I need to develop my white-square bishop.
bishop.zh: 我需要培养我的白方主教。

serving.en: The sewerage works serve the outlying villages.
serving.zh: 污水处理设施服务于外围村庄。

serving.en: She adjusted the saltiness before serving it.
serving.zh: 她在上菜前调整了咸度。

serving.en: We'll be serving supper buffet style.

drinking.en: The filter removes contaminants from drinking water.
drinking.zh: 过滤器去除饮用水中的污染物。

drinking.en: Some say drinking is a vice.
drinking.gloss: An act or session by which drink is consumed, especially alcoholic beverages.
drinking.zh: 有人说喝酒是一种恶习。

acceptance.en: His speech of acceptance was brief but moving.
acceptance.zh: 他的获奖感言简短而感人。
让我们促进包容性和接受度！

pump.en: Last night's party was really pumping.
pump.gloss: Of music: to be loud, to have strong bass and rhythms; (by extension) to be full of energy.
pump.zh: 昨晚的聚会真是热闹极了。

pump.en: I want to pump you up.

candy.zh: 他把糖果包装纸扔了出去。

candy.en: Fruits preserved in sugar candy over time.
candy.gloss: To form into congelations or crystals, especially of sugar or syrup.
candy.zh: 水果在糖中保存一段时间。

candy.en: I've hidden candy somewhere in this room.
candy.zh: 我在这个房间的某个地方藏了糖果。

evil.en: That cat of yours is evil.
You must decide between good and evil.
evil.zh: 你必须在善与恶之间做出决定。

evil.en: The evils of society include murder and theft.
evil.gloss: Moral badness; wickedness; malevolence; the forces or behaviors that are the opposite or enemy of good.
evil.zh: 社会的罪恶包括谋杀和盗窃。

evil.en: If something is evil, it is never mandatory.
evil.zh: 如果某件事是邪恶的，它永远不是强制性的。

medal.en: The gallant rider received a medal for gallantry.
medal.zh: 这位英勇的骑手因英勇而获得了一枚奖章。

medal.en: He medalled twice at the Olympics.
medal.zh: 他在奥运会上两次获得奖牌。

medal.en: We will strike a medal in your honour.
medal.zh: 我们将为您铸造一枚奖章。

beg.en: Might I beg leave to accompany you?
He begged on the street corner from passers-by.
beg.gloss: To request the help of someone, often in the form of money.

sponsor.en: They were my sponsors for immigration.
sponsor.gloss: A person or organization with some sort of responsibility for another person or organization, especially where the responsibility has a religious, legal, or financial aspect.
sponsor.zh: 他们是我的移民担保人。
他赞助免费的柏柏尔教育。

secondary.en: Bright's disease is often secondary to scarlet fever.
secondary.gloss: Dependent or consequent upon another disease, or occurring in the second stage of a disease.
secondary.zh: 布莱特氏病通常继发于猩红热。

export.en: Japan exports electronic goods throughout the world.
export.gloss: To sell (goods) to a foreign country.
export.zh: 日本向世界各地出口电子产品。

export.en: Oil is the main export of Saudi Arabia.
export.zh: 石油是沙特阿拉伯的主要出口产品。

experimental.en: Uniformity of samples improves experimental reliability.
experimental.zh: 样本的一致性提高了实验可靠性。

experimental.gloss: Pertaining to or founded on experiment.

experimental.en: They took the experimental car to the proving-grounds.
experimental.zh: 他们把实验车带到了试验场。

slam.gloss: To shut with sudden force so as to produce a shock and noise.

slam.en: Union leaders slammed the new proposals.
slam.gloss: To speak badly of; to criticize forcefully.
slam.zh: 工会领导人猛烈抨击了新提议。

slam.en: Don't slam that trunk down on the pavement!
slam.gloss: To put in or on a particular place with force and loud noise. (Often followed by a preposition such as down, against or into.)
slam.zh: 别把树干摔在人行道上！

civilization.en: A hermit doesn't much care for civilization.
He was a man of great civilization.
civilization.gloss: The state or quality of being civilized.
civilization.zh: 他是一位具有伟大文明的人。

melt.zh: 他的烦恼都烟消云散了。

melt.en: I melted butter to make a cake.
melt.gloss: To change (or to be changed) from a solid state to a liquid state, usually by a gradual heat.
melt.zh: 我融化了黄油来做蛋糕。

midnight.en: They protracted the discussion well beyond midnight.
midnight.zh: 他们把讨论拖到了午夜之后很久。

midnight.en: The curfew is effective at midnight.

curve.en: The road curves southwards near the coast.
curve.zh: 这条路在海岸附近转向南方。

curve.en: The teacher will curve the test.
curve.gloss: To grade on a curve (bell curve of a normal distribution).

curve.en: She scribbled a curve on the paper.
curve.gloss: A simple figure containing no straight portions and no angles; a curved line.
curve.zh: 她在纸上写下了一条曲线。

curve.en: You should slow down when approaching a curve.
curve.gloss: A bend, such as in a road.

integrity.zh: 你是在质疑我的诚信吗？

evident.zh: 他说话时带着明显的高兴。
学术写作应该是显而易见的。

park.en: They built a multistory parking facility.
park.zh: 他们建了一座多层停车设施。

park.gloss: To hit a home run; to hit the ball out of the park.
park.zh: 他真的把那辆车停了下来。

park.en: to park artillery, wagons, automobiles, etc.
park.gloss: To bring together in a park, or compact body.

park.en: Park your bags in the hall.
park.gloss: To sit, recline, or put, especially in a manner suggesting an intent to remain for some time.
park.zh: 把你的行李放在大厅里。

essence.en: She seems the very essence of kindness.
essence.gloss: An essence is the most basic and important quality of something.

essence.zh: 另请参见同义词库：本质。

logic.en: She won the debate with her unassailable logic.
logic.zh: 她以无懈可击的逻辑赢得了这场辩论。

exclude.en: The building's rentable area excludes shared corridors.
exclude.zh: 这栋楼的可出租面积不包括公共走廊。
其他人也被排除在外了吧？

harsh.en: The region experiences harsh climatic conditions.
harsh.zh: 这个地区的气候条件恶劣。

harsh.en: His sentimentalism obscured the harsh realities.
harsh.zh: 他的感伤主义掩盖了严酷的现实。

harsh.en: The soldiers became inured to harsh weather.
harsh.zh: 士兵们变得习惯恶劣天气。

harsh.gloss: To put a damper on (a mood).
harsh.zh: 伙计，你打扰了我的嗡嗡声。

harsh.en: Harsh irritating smoke filled the hallway.
harsh.gloss: unpleasantly rough or jarring to the senses

harsh.zh: 刺鼻的刺激性烟雾充满了走廊。

closet.en: A voice came muffledly from inside the closet.
closet.zh: 柜子里传来低沉的声音。

corridor.en: The building's rentable area excludes shared corridors.
corridor.zh: 这栋楼的可出租面积不包括公共走廊。

corridor.en: He walked down the lit corridor.
corridor.zh: 他沿着灯火通明的走廊走去。

corridor.en: We walked down a wide corridor.
corridor.zh: 我们沿着一条宽阔的走廊走去。

greet.en: She greeted the news with rapture.
greet.zh: 她听到这个消息时欣喜若狂。

greet.en: He greeted us with an expansive smile.
greet.zh: 他满面笑容地迎接我们。

greet.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
greet.zh: 亲爱的医生路加和底马向你们问安。

interior.en: She set herself up as an interior designer.
interior.zh: 她开始从事室内设计工作。

pitcher.en: The pitcher threw a perfect game.
pitcher.zh: 投手投出了一场完美的比赛。

pitcher.en: The pitcher had a blazing fastball.
pitcher.zh: 投手投出了一记炽热的快球。

retail.gloss: The sale of goods directly to the consumer, encompassing the storefronts, mail-order, websites, etc., and the corporate mechanisms, branding, advertising, etc. that support them.

retail.en: I never pay retail for clothes.
retail.gloss: Retail price; full price; an abbreviated expression, meaning the full suggested price of a particular good or service, before any sale, discount, or other deal.
retail.zh: 我从不支付服装零售费。

retail.en: Brick and mortar retail stores face online competition.
retail.zh: 实体零售店面临在线竞争。

snake.en: The path snaked through the forest.
snake.gloss: To follow or move in a winding route.

snake.en: The river snakes through the valley.
snake.gloss: To follow or move in a winding route.

march.en: The growing season here begins in March.
march.zh: 这里的生长季节从三月开始。

march.en: 17th March is St Patrick's feast day.
We're going to march on City Hall!
We saw the guards marching at Buckingham Palace.
march.gloss: To walk with long, regular strides, like a soldier does.
march.zh: 我们看到卫兵在白金汉宫行进。

excuse.gloss: To forgive; to pardon; to overlook.

excuse.zh: 他的借口似乎令人难以置信。

excuse.en: She'll take any excuse to ballgown!
excuse.zh: 她会找任何借口穿上舞会礼服！

excuse.en: May I be excused from the table?
excuse.gloss: To allow to leave, or release from any obligation.

weakness.en: His incisive questions exposed the argument's weakness.
weakness.zh: 他犀利的问题暴露了论点的弱处。
弱点真的可以被混淆吗？

pig.en: A pig roots the earth for truffles.
Some religions prohibit their adherents from eating pig.
pig.gloss: The edible meat of such an animal; pork.
pig.zh: 有些宗教禁止其信徒吃猪肉。

pig.en: You can't train a pig to write poetry.
The black sow pigged at seven this morning.
pig.zh: 这头黑母猪今天早上七点生猪。

classical.en: The orchestra expanded its classical repertory.
classical.zh: 这支管弦乐队扩展了其古典保留曲目。

classical.en: The company's repertory includes several classical works.
classical.zh: 这个剧团的保留剧目包括几部古典作品。

unemployment.en: The closure caused unemployment and consequent hardship.
unemployment.zh: 关闭造成了失业和随之而来的困苦。

unemployment.gloss: The state of having no job; joblessness.

unemployment.en: Unemployment has been considered a cause of crime.
unemployment.gloss: The phenomenon of joblessness in an economy.
unemployment.zh: 失业被认为是犯罪的一个原因。

fold.gloss: To become folded; to form folds.

fold.en: He folded his arms in defiance.
fold.gloss: To double or lay together (one’s arms, hands, wings, etc.) so as to overlap with each other.

fold.en: He gave the napkins a double fold.

fold.en: The newspaper was folded under his arm.
fold.gloss: To bend (any thin material, such as paper) over so that it comes in contact with itself.

fold.en: The clothes were folded by the housekeeper.
fold.gloss: To make the proper arrangement (in a thin material) by bending.

rumour.en: The rumour went all around town.
I heard a rumour that they got married.

reverse.en: Reservior has its final vowels reversed.
reverse.zh: Reservior把词尾的两个元音颠倒了。

reverse.en: Division is the reverse of multiplication.

reverse.gloss: Pertaining to engines, vehicle movement etc. moving in a direction opposite to the usual direction.
To change totally; to alter to the opposite.
reverse.zh: 所有趋势最终都会逆转。

rumor.en: The rumor circled through the crowd.
That rumor is nothing but sheer poppycock.
rumor.zh: 这个谣言纯粹是胡说八道。

rumor.en: The bankruptcy rumor dried up his sales.
rumor.zh: 破产传闻使他的销售枯竭。

missing.en: They searched fruitlessly for the missing inscription.
missing.zh: 他们徒劳地寻找那块失踪的铭文。

missing.en: The car is missing essential features.
This jigsaw is missing several pieces.

flash.en: The lights flashed alternately red and blue.
flash.zh: 灯光交替闪烁着红色和蓝色。

flash.gloss: a bright patch of color used for decoration or identification

outer.zh: 只有支撑的外墙仍然矗立着。

ballot.zh: 人民将通过投票箱做出决定。

web.en: The spider wove a delicate web.
web.zh: 蜘蛛织了一张精致的网。

web.gloss: Alternative letter-case form of Web: the World Wide Web.

southeast.gloss: Towards or in the direction of the southeast; southeastwards.

southeast.gloss: Towards or in the direction of the southeast; southeastwards.

southeast.zh: 穆斯林商人将伊斯兰教引入东南亚。

intelligent.en: She is intelligent, and bookishly erudite.
intelligent.zh: 她很聪明，而且博学多才。

intelligent.gloss: Having at least a similar level of brain power to humankind.
intelligent.zh: 对外星智慧生命的搜寻仍在继续。

intelligent.zh: 我和我女朋友进行了一次明智的谈话。

wherever.en: Go home to wherever you belong.
wherever.gloss: The place (no matter where) in, at or to which.
wherever.zh: 回家吧，回到属于你的地方。

wherever.en: Wherever you go, I’ll find you.
wherever.gloss: Regardless of the place in, at or to which.
wherever.zh: 无论你去哪里，我都会找到你。

wherever.gloss: In, at or to any place (that); anywhere.

wherever.gloss: In, at or to all places or situations (that); everywhere.
wherever.zh: 在需要的地方添加报价。

wherever.en: Wherever have you been all my life?
wherever.gloss: Where ever; an emphatic form of where.

wherever.gloss: Used to show that one does not know where someone or something is located.
wherever.zh: 她住在帕德尔镇，无论那在哪里。

govern.en: Orbital motion is governed by gravitation.

govern.zh: 派系争斗削弱了执政联盟。

govern.gloss: To control the actions or behavior of; to keep under control; to restrain.
govern.zh: 像文明人一样管理自己。

govern.en: The old king governed the land wisely.
govern.gloss: To make and administer the public policy and affairs of; to exercise sovereign authority in.
govern.zh: 老国王明智地统治着这片土地。

govern.en: Chance governs the outcome of many card games.
govern.gloss: To exercise a deciding or determining influence on.
govern.zh: 机会决定了许多纸牌游戏的结果。

driving.en: Heedless driving puts other people at risk.
driving.zh: 不留心驾驶会使他人面临风险。

driving.en: The driving wind blew the rain sideways.
driving.gloss: If something is driving, it is moving quickly and strongly.

rhetoric.zh: 那位人文主义者拒绝仇恨言辞。

rhetoric.zh: 我无法理解伯克晦涩难懂的言辞。

convinced.en: His sworn statement convinced the judge.
convinced.zh: 他的宣誓陈述说服了法官。

vitamin.en: Vitamin supplementation corrected the dietary imbalance.
vitamin.zh: 维生素补充纠正了饮食失衡。

enthusiasm.en: The choir sang with lusty enthusiasm.
enthusiasm.zh: 合唱团充满活力地热情歌唱。

enthusiasm.en: His fervid enthusiasm impressed the committee.
enthusiasm.zh: 他热烈的热情给委员会留下了深刻印象。

enthusiasm.zh: 她装出来的热情未能说服他们。

enthusiasm.gloss: An intensity of feeling; an excited interest or eagerness.

accommodate.en: Interconnecting rooms accommodated the extended family.
accommodate.zh: 相互连通的房间安顿下了大家庭。

accommodate.en: The commodious hall accommodated the entire audience.
accommodate.zh: 宽敞的大厅容纳了全部观众。

accommodate.en: This venue accommodates three hundred people.
accommodate.gloss: To contain comfortably; to have space for.

wilderness.en: We were hunting deer in the wilderness.
wilderness.gloss: Places that are far from cities or farms; usually places where no people live.

wilderness.en: Adulthood enables us to survive in the wilderness.
wilderness.zh: 成年使我们能够在荒野中生存。

praise.en: The committee praised his estimable contribution.
praise.zh: 委员会赞扬了他可贵的贡献。

praise.en: The editor praised the report's conciseness.
praise.zh: 编辑赞扬了报告的简洁。

praise.en: Her account praised their manful resistance.
praise.zh: 她的叙述赞扬了他们勇敢的抵抗。

injure.en: I injured my ankle playing tennis.
injure.gloss: To wound or cause physical harm to a living creature.
injure.zh: 我打网球时扭伤了脚踝。

endless.en: Oh, come off it with the endless questioning.
endless.zh: 哦，别再无休止地提问了。
他们的争论似乎没完没了。

mandate.en: Company regulations mandate that workers use protective eyewear.
mandate.zh: 公司规定要求工人佩戴防护眼镜。

mandate.en: Company regulations mandate that workers wear safety glasses.
mandate.zh: 公司规定要求工人佩戴安全眼镜。

mandate.en: Until 1962, Algeria was a French mandate.
mandate.zh: 1962 年之前，阿尔及利亚一直是法国的托管地。

respectively.en: Matthew's siblings were three and four, respectively.
respectively.zh: 马修的兄弟姐妹分别三岁和四岁。

respectively.en: He and he love her and her, respectively.
Who and who goes where and where, respectively?
respectively.zh: 谁和谁分别去哪里和哪里？

chaos.en: She was unrattled, despite the chaos all around.
chaos.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，她却镇定自若。

mechanical.en: The device conventionally uses a mechanical switch.
mechanical.zh: 这种设备通常使用机械开关。

reserve.gloss: A restriction.; The act of reserving or keeping back; reservation; exception.

shame.zh: 真可惜，你这个可怜的东西，你一定很冷吧！

signature.zh: 他的签名以华丽的结束。

signature.en: He impressed his signature into the wax.
signature.zh: 他在蜡上留下了自己的签名。

signature.en: Rabbit in mustard sauce is my signature dish.
signature.zh: 芥末兔肉是我的招牌菜。

spouse.en: People should treat their spouses with respect.

devil.gloss: A thing that is awkward or difficult to understand or do.

sometime.gloss: At an indefinite but stated time in the past or future.

summary.en: Her succinct summary clarified the main argument.

diplomat.zh: 作为外交官，您可以免受起诉。

epidemic.en: The chronicle describes a pestilential epidemic.

scrutiny.zh: 一个异常数据点需要进一步审查。

scrutiny.zh: 这位学术编辑在审查下仍然持怀疑态度。

fracture.zh: 这种有延展性的合金抵抗了突然断裂。

fracture.gloss: breaking of hard tissue such as bone

quilt.en: My grandmother is going to sew a quilt.
quilt.gloss: A bed covering consisting of two layers of fabric stitched together, with insulation between, often having a decorative design.

quilt.en: I used primitive hearts to decorate the quilt.
quilt.zh: 我用原始的心来装饰被子。

turnover.en: Job dissatisfaction results in high turnover.
turnover.gloss: The frequency with which stock is replaced after being used or sold, workers leave and are replaced, a property changes hands, etc.
turnover.zh: 工作不满导致高流动率。

turnover.en: The company had an annual turnover of $500,000.
turnover.gloss: The amount of money taken as sales transacted in a given period.
turnover.zh: 该公司的年营业额为 500,000 美元。

sensible.en: Be sensible; you’re just frigging about now.
sensible.zh: 保持理智；你现在只是在胡闹。

bachelor.en: He'd been a bachelor all his born days.
bachelor.zh: 他一生下来就是个单身汉。

tract.en: This excerpt describes a vast forest tract.
tract.zh: 这段节选描写了一大片林地。

tract.en: We subdivide the tract into smaller plots.
tract.zh: 我们把这片土地细分成较小地块。

tract.en: They bought a tract of farmland.
tract.gloss: A tract is a large area of land.

operational.en: Short-range planning addresses immediate operational needs.
operational.zh: 短期规划处理眼前的运营需求。

operational.gloss: pertaining to a process or series of actions for achieving a result

operational.zh: 他们承担了各自的作战职责。

convincing.en: His tenuous argument failed to convince us.
convincing.zh: 他薄弱的论点未能说服我们。

convincing.en: His glib explanation failed to convince anyone.
convincing.zh: 他油嘴滑舌的解释没能说服任何人。

convincing.en: His ostensible concern failed to convince her.
convincing.zh: 他表面上的关心未能使她信服。

decoration.en: The gaudy decorations overwhelmed the small room.
decoration.zh: 花哨的装饰让小房间显得十分杂乱。

decoration.en: Fabergé eggs were covered with fine decoration.
decoration.gloss: Decoration is an attractive surface covering, or what makes something more beautiful.
decoration.zh: 法贝热彩蛋上覆盖着精美的装饰。

descendant.en: The elevator resumed its descendant trajectory.
This famous medieval manuscript has many descendants.
descendant.gloss: A thing that derives directly from a given precursor or source.
descendant.zh: 这部著名的中世纪手稿有许多后裔。

descendant.en: Dogs evolved as descendants of early wolves.
descendant.zh: 狗是早期狼的后代进化而来的。

lump.en: Don't just sit there like a lump.
lump.zh: 不要像个肿块一样坐在那里。

lump.en: He's taken his lumps over the years.
lump.zh: 多年来他已经克服了肿块。

lump.en: He had a conspicuous lump on his forehead.
lump.zh: 他的额头上有一个明显的肿块。

scarf.gloss: To cover as or like a scarf.
scarf.zh: 她的肩膀上围着一顶兜帽。
她的围巾拂过他的皮肤。

scarf.gloss: To dress with a scarf, or as with a scarf; to cover with a loose wrapping.

clash.en: The actors dramatize the clash of creeds.
clash.zh: 演员们演出了不同信条之间的冲突。

clash.en: The cymbals clashed loudly during the performance.
clash.zh: 演奏时，钹发出了响亮的撞击声。

clash.gloss: To play Clash Royale or Clash of Clans.
clash.zh: 老兄，我们今晚会吵架吗？

upward.en: Push the button beside the upward arrow.
upward.zh: 按下向上箭头旁边的按钮。

upward.gloss: In a direction from lower to higher; toward a higher place; in a course toward the source or origin.

mammal.en: The naturalist examined the arboreal mammal.
mammal.zh: 这位博物学家观察了这种树栖哺乳动物。

mammal.en: The text describes an edentate mammal.
mammal.zh: 文本描写了一种缺齿哺乳动物。

multiply.en: To multiply two numbers, add their logs.
multiply.zh: 要将两个数字相乘，请将它们的对数相加。

pumpkin.en: The kids wore pumpkin suits for Hallowe'en.
pumpkin.zh: 孩子们在万圣节时穿着南瓜套装。

imitate.en: The mockingbird imitated several other birds.
imitate.zh: 这只嘲鸫模仿了几种其他鸟的叫声。

imitate.en: The monkey imitated every action I made.
imitate.gloss: To imitate is to copy what someone else says or does.
imitate.zh: 猴子模仿我的每一个动作。
只要模仿他的做法就可以了。

configuration.en: The baseline configuration includes unsupported components.
configuration.zh: 基准配置包含不受支持的组件。

configuration.en: The mountain range has a unique configuration.
configuration.gloss: The form of a thing, as depending on the relative placement of the parts of a thing's shape.

configuration.en: Modern landing gear usually has a tricycle configuration.
configuration.zh: 现代起落架通常采用三轮结构。

velvet.en: The sapphire ring lay in a velvet box.
velvet.zh: 蓝宝石戒指放在一个天鹅绒盒子里。

velvet.en: The cuffs were faced with velvet.
Her top was of black crushed velvet.
velvet.zh: 她的上衣是黑色压花天鹅绒的。

notorious.en: His predecessor was a notorious martinet.
notorious.zh: 他的前任是个出了名的严苛管教者。

notorious.en: The tenderloin district was notorious for vice.

notorious.zh: 里脊肉区因罪恶而臭名昭著。
你是一个臭名昭著的骗子。

cough.gloss: Sometimes followed by up: to force (something) out of the lungs or throat by pushing air from the lungs through the glottis (causing a short, explosive sound), and out through the mouth.
To make a noise like a cough.
cough.zh: 发动机发出咳嗽声和噼啪声。

cough.en: He almost coughed himself into a fit.
cough.gloss: To cause (oneself or something) to be in a certain condition in the manner described in etymology 1 sense 1.1.
cough.zh: 他差点儿咳得咳嗽起来。

cough.en: Behind me, I heard a distinct, dry cough.
cough.gloss: A sudden, often involuntary expulsion of air from the lungs through the glottis (causing a short, explosive sound), and out through the mouth.
cough.zh: 我听到身后传来明显的干咳声。

cough.gloss: Used to represent the sound of a cough (noun sense 1), especially when focusing attention on a following utterance, often an attribution of blame or a euphemism: ahem.

stereo.en: I'll put blues on the stereo.
stereo.zh: 我会把布鲁斯放在立体声音响上。

stereo.en: Please turn down the volume on the stereo.

lethal.gloss: If something is lethal, it can kill a person or thing.
lethal.zh: 眼镜蛇的毒液是致命的。
这可能会产生致命的后果。

olive.en: The olive tree survived the onset of drought.
olive.zh: 橄榄树在干旱中幸存下来。

olive.en: Add a soupspoonful of olive oil.
A martini, please, and hold the olive.
olive.zh: 请来一杯马提尼酒，并握住橄榄。

roller.en: Disney has some insanely fun roller coasters.
roller.zh: 迪士尼有一些非常有趣的过山车。

entail.en: Sapience entails sound judgment, not mere knowledge.
entail.zh: 智慧意味着明智判断，而不仅是知识。

entail.en: This activity will entail careful attention to detail.
entail.zh: 这项活动需要特别注意细节。

toast.en: This toast and marmalade tastes heavenly.
toast.gloss: Bread that has been toasted (cooked lightly by browning).
toast.zh: 这吐司和果酱味道极好。

toast.en: He was the toast of high society.
toast.gloss: A person, group, or notable object to which a salutation with alcohol is made; a person or group held in similar esteem.

toast.en: I toasted my feet by the fire.

credential.en: May I see your credentials, please?
credential.gloss: documentary or electronic evidence that a person has certain status or privileges
credential.zh: 我可以看一下你的证件吗？
这位教授拥有令人印象深刻的资历。

swirl.gloss: Synonym of pinwheel (“food product with spiral layers”).
swirl.zh: 我正在烤一些奶酪漩涡。

swirl.en: I swirled my brush around in the paint.
swirl.gloss: To twist or whirl, as an eddy.

swirl.en: Adriano felt the wind swirl around him.
swirl.zh: 阿德里亚诺感到风在他周围旋转。

smoothly.en: The engine runs smoothly on diesel.
smoothly.zh: 发动机使用柴油运转平稳。

smoothly.en: This video player can rewind smoothly.
smoothly.zh: 该视频播放器可以平滑倒带。

ham.en: He wolfed down a ham sandwich.
ham.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了一个火腿三明治。

ham.en: Aunt Bessy's Easter ham is always lip-smacking good.
ham.zh: 贝西阿姨的复活节火腿总是令人垂涎欲滴。

distraction.en: The incessant nightmares drove him to distraction.
distraction.gloss: Mental disarray; a deranged state of mind; insanity.
distraction.zh: 连续不断的噩梦让他心烦意乱。

fling.en: The scold began to flout and fling.
fling.gloss: To utter abusive language; to sneer.
fling.zh: 责骂开始变得轻蔑和猛烈。

livestock.en: Good animal husbandry improves livestock health.
livestock.zh: 良好的畜牧管理改善牲畜健康。

livestock.en: Locoweed can be harmful to grazing livestock.
livestock.zh: 疯草可能危害放牧牲畜。

basin.en: She poured water into the basin.

roam.en: Gangs of thugs roamed the streets.
He has seen spirits roam the house.
roam.zh: 他曾见过鬼魂在房子里游荡。

heroic.en: To win while wounded was truly heroic.
heroic.gloss: If something you do is heroic is like something a hero would do; it is very brave or difficult to do.

heroic.en: The heroic soldier covered himself with glory.
heroic.zh: 这位英雄战士为自己披上了光荣。
这看起来不太英雄气概。

heir.en: Each heir received a moiety of the estate.
heir.zh: 每位继承人分得了遗产的一半。

foam.en: His specialty is a mango foam.
foam.gloss: A substance composed of a large collection of bubbles or their solidified remains, especially:; A food prepared in the form of a mass of airy bubbles.
foam.zh: 他的特色菜是芒果泡沫。

foam.en: He is in Europe, across the foam.
The foam panels had a blubbery texture.
foam.zh: 泡沫板具有润滑的质地。

foam.en: A foam mat can soften a hard seat.
foam.gloss: A material formed by trapping pockets of gas in a liquid or solid.

offset.en: I'll offset the time difference locally.
offset.gloss: To counteract or compensate for, by applying a change in the opposite direction.

offset.en: Today's victory was an offset to yesterday's defeat.
offset.gloss: Anything that acts as counterbalance; a compensating equivalent.
offset.zh: 今天的胜利弥补了昨天的失败。

offset.en: Is there any way to offset those costs?
offset.zh: 有什么办法可以抵消这些成本吗？

affiliation.en: We have a close affiliation with the college.
affiliation.zh: 我们与学院有着密切的联系。

affiliation.en: Do you have any religious affiliation?

insure.gloss: To provide for compensation if some specified risk occurs. Often agreed by policy (contract) to offer financial compensation in case of an accident, theft or other undesirable event.

insure.zh: 我的房子是完全保险的。

asteroid.gloss: An asteroid is an object that is smaller than a planet that most often orbits a star, but it can sometimes orbit big planets.

asteroid.en: The asteroid crossed over Jupiter's orbit.
asteroid.gloss: An asteroid is an object that is smaller than a planet that most often orbits a star, but it can sometimes orbit big planets.
asteroid.zh: 这颗小行星穿过木星轨道。
不要混淆彗星和小行星。

interface.zh: 让我们周三进行交流吧。

interface.en: The options are selected via the user interface.
interface.gloss: The connection between a user and a machine.
interface.zh: 这些选项是通过用户界面选择的。

interface.en: This interface is implemented by several Java classes.
interface.gloss: The connection between parts of software; also the public or published sections of an object or module.
interface.zh: 该接口由几个Java 类实现。

tomb.en: I'll go to the tomb unrepentant.
tomb.zh: 我将毫无悔意地走向坟墓。

abandoned.zh: 他们放弃了无益的争论。

abandoned.en: He was loth to abandon the project.
For quotations using this term, see Citations:abandoned.
abandoned.gloss: simple past and past participle of abandon
abandoned.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文：废弃。

bald.gloss: Having little or no hair, fur, or feathers.

bald.en: Your bald patch is starting to show.
bald.zh: 你的秃顶开始显露出来。

straightforward.gloss: If something is straightforward, it is simple. It is easy to understand and easy to know how to do it.

straightforward.en: What we need to do now is straightforward.
straightforward.gloss: If something is straightforward, it is simple. It is easy to understand and easy to know how to do it.
straightforward.zh: 我们现在需要做的事情很简单。

anticipation.gloss: The eagerness associated with waiting for something to occur.
anticipation.zh: 我满怀期待地头晕目眩。

frustrating.en: This case, while interesting, is a bit frustrating.
frustrating.zh: 这个案例虽然有趣，但有点令人沮丧。
今天的工作真是令人沮丧。
这是令人沮丧和困惑的。

glorious.zh: 我们度过了一段美好的时光。

glorious.en: Cossack glory has long been glorious.
glorious.zh: 哥萨克的荣耀早已辉煌。

glorious.en: Our country has a glorious history.
glorious.zh: 我们的国家有着辉煌的历史。

honesty.en: His remark cast an aspersion on her honesty.
honesty.zh: 他的话诋毁了她的诚实。

honesty.en: Honesty is the true measure of a man.
honesty.zh: 诚实是衡量一个人的真正标准。

crisp.gloss: Senses relating to brittleness.; Having a consistency which is hard yet brittle, and in a condition to break with a sharp fracture; crumbly, friable, short.
crisp.zh: 松脆的雪在脚下嘎吱作响。

crisp.en: The day broke crisp and clear.
He has a preference for crisp wines.

meditation.zh: 我通过冥想让自己扎根。

fearful.gloss: Fearful means a person who has a fear of someone or something; to be scared of someone or something.

fearful.en: A fearful thought entered my mind.
fearful.zh: 一个可怕的想法出现在我的脑海里。

sausage.en: Would you like bacon or sausage?
You need bread, sausage, and cheese?
sausage.zh: 您需要面包、香肠和奶酪吗？

sausage.en: I wonder how sausage is made.
sausage.zh: 我想知道香肠是怎么做的。

overturn.gloss: turn from an upright or normal position

transcript.zh: 笔录中注明了汤姆缺席。

standpoint.en: From her standpoint, exclusion seemed unfair.
standpoint.zh: 在她看来，排斥是不公平的。

standpoint.en: From a grammatical standpoint, that sentence is incorrect.
standpoint.zh: 从语法的角度来看，这句话是错误的。

standpoint.en: From a practical standpoint, his plan is lacking.
standpoint.zh: 从实际的角度来看，他的计划是缺乏的。

empower.zh: 工作应该赋予人力量，而不是奴役人。
工人将不会被赋予权力。

empower.en: I want to empower the people.

mainland.en: Boris took Melissa back to the mainland.
mainland.zh: 鲍里斯带着梅丽莎回到了大陆。

mainland.en: There is a pandemic on the mainland.
There was an epidemic in the mainland.

flourish.en: Mercantile activity flourished around the busy port.
flourish.zh: 繁忙港口周围的商业活动蓬勃发展。

flourish.gloss: To be known to have been alive at a particular time or in a particular period, where one's birth and death dates are not known; to have been active during a specified period; floruit.
flourish.zh: 约翰·史密斯（John Smith，鼎盛时期 1425-1432 年）...

flourish.en: His writing flourished before the war.
flourish.gloss: To be in a period of greatest influence.
flourish.zh: 他的写作在战前就很盛行。

flourish.en: His signature ended with a flourish.
flourish.zh: 他的签名以华丽的结束。

flourish.en: The barley flourished in the warm weather.
flourish.zh: 大麦在温暖的天气里茁壮成长。

tug.en: Someone was tugging on my sleeve.

shiver.gloss: To tremble or shake, especially when cold or frightened.

shiver.en: A shiver went up my spine.

shiver.zh: 她看到这一幕，浑身发抖。

lobster.gloss: A lobster is a red colored crustacean known for its meat.

lobster.en: A lobster has a pedunculate eye.
lobster.zh: 龙虾有一个有蒂的眼睛。

lobster.en: We served a lobster mayonnaise as a starter.
lobster.zh: 我们提供了龙虾蛋黄酱作为开胃菜。

solidarity.zh: 他们表现出了对穆斯林的声援。

solidarity.en: Algerians are known for their solidarity.
solidarity.zh: 阿尔及利亚人以团结而闻名。

solidarity.en: Solidarity is essential at this time.

discharge.gloss: To let fly; to give expression to; to utter.
discharge.zh: 他宣誓了一个可怕的誓言。

discharge.gloss: To give forth; to emit or send out.

discharge.zh: 我在没有通知的情况下被解雇了。

turning.en: Increasing torque improves the machine's turning force.
turning.zh: 增大扭矩可以提高机器的转动力。

turning.en: Turn the auger slowly to remove soil.
turning.zh: 慢慢转动螺旋钻以挖出泥土。

turning.en: Turn the handle counterclockwise to release pressure.
turning.zh: 逆时针转动手柄以释放压力。

turning.en: Take the second turning on the left.
turning.gloss: A turn or deviation from a straight course.

turning.en: The turnings get into your trouser turnups!
turning.gloss: Shavings produced by turning something on a lathe.

detection.en: Detection is hard on the feet.
detection.gloss: a police investigation to determine the perpetrator

detection.en: The rabbit avoided detection by keeping still.
detection.zh: 兔子通过保持静止来避免被发现。
她不知何故逃脱了检测。

saddle.zh: 这个马鞍装有生牛皮带。

saddle.en: His red bandanna lay beside the saddle.
saddle.zh: 他的红色花巾放在马鞍旁边。

saddle.en: The cowhand repaired the rawhide saddle strap.
saddle.zh: 牧牛工修补了生牛皮马鞍带。

lasting.en: The decree was promulgated last month.
She joined the local philharmonic last year.
lasting.zh: 她去年加入了当地交响乐团。

lasting.en: They retooled the assembly line last year.
lasting.zh: 他们去年对装配线进行了重新装备。

occurrence.en: Meeting her became a daily occurrence.
occurrence.gloss: An occurrence is one case of something happening.
occurrence.zh: 与她见面已经成了家常便饭。
这是每天都会发生的事情。

partisan.en: They were blinded by partisan zeal.
partisan.gloss: Adherent to a party or faction; especially, having the character of blind, passionate, or unreasonable adherence to a party.
partisan.zh: 他们被党派狂热蒙蔽了双眼。

partisan.en: Many partisans died in that battle.
partisan.zh: 许多游击队员在那场战斗中丧生。

abundant.en: The fertile topsoil supports abundant vegetation.
abundant.zh: 肥沃的表土养育着茂盛的植物。
澳大利亚矿产资源丰富。

prone.zh: 他有患糖尿病的遗传倾向。

hose.en: Why is the hose still running?
The water sprayed out of the hose.
I bought a hose to water my plants.
hose.gloss: A hose is a flexible tube that can carry water or other liquids.
hose.zh: 我买了一根软管来给我的植物浇水。

formidable.en: Climbing the mountain was a formidable task.
formidable.gloss: If something is formidable, it is very difficult or challenging.
formidable.zh: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
领导人发表了令人敬畏的声明。

miles.zh: 我们已经走了大约二十英里。
我可以看到数英里之外。

miles.en: His final shot missed the bullseye by miles.
miles.gloss: A great distance in space or time.
miles.zh: 他的最后一枪偏离了靶心数英里。

liberation.en: The divorce felt like a liberation.
liberation.zh: 离婚感觉像是一种解放。

liberation.en: Sometimes death is liberation from pain.
liberation.zh: 有时候，死亡就是从痛苦中解脱出来。

hammer.zh: 托尔挥舞着他强大的锤子。

hammer.gloss: To defeat (a person, a team) resoundingly.

hammer.en: I now exhibit this bloody hammer.
hammer.zh: 我现在展示这把该死的锤子。

hammer.en: St. Augustine was the hammer of heresies.
hammer.gloss: One who, or that which, smites or shatters.

planting.zh: 充足的营养可以影响植物的繁殖力。

charcoal.zh: 工厂会将这些木材烧成木炭。

charcoal.en: Lumberjacks who make charcoal live there.
charcoal.zh: 制作木炭的伐木工人住在那里。

intrinsic.zh: 这是伊斯兰教固有的吗？

intrinsic.zh: 我质疑虚无主义的内在价值。

intrinsic.en: Tom lacks intrinsic motivation to study French.

starve.en: The patient’s brain was starved of oxygen.
starve.gloss: To deprive of nourishment or of some vital component.

starve.gloss: To deprive of nourishment or of some vital component.

为饥饿的人们提供食物。

impatient.en: She dances when she becomes impatient.
impatient.gloss: Restless, short of temper, and intolerant of delays.
impatient.zh: 当她不耐烦时，她就会跳舞。

impatient.en: The airport was wall-to-wall with impatient passengers.
impatient.zh: 机场里挤满了不耐烦的乘客。

impatient.en: Jason is headstrong and impatient—like father, like son.
impatient.zh: 杰森任性且缺乏耐心——有其父必有其子。

reclaim.gloss: Material recovered from something that has already been used.

reclaim.zh: 我们正在恢复我们的柏柏尔身份。
大自然将夺回我们的星球。

sewer.en: Along the street ran an open sewer.
sewer.zh: 街道两旁有一条露天下水道。

sewer.en: The plumber came to fix the sewer hookup.
sewer.zh: 水管工来修理下水道连接。

prevalence.zh: 不同地区的疾病流行程度不同。

prevalence.en: Better screening revealed its true prevalence.
prevalence.zh: 更好的筛查揭示了它的真实流行程度。

prevalence.en: The study measured the prevalence of asthma.
prevalence.zh: 这项研究测量了哮喘的患病率。

cautiously.gloss: as if with kid gloves; with caution or prudence or tact

fertile.zh: 丰富的沉积物使洪泛区肥沃。

slab.gloss: To destroy (a structure) so completely as to leave only the foundation slab visible.
slab.zh: 多处房屋被巨型龙卷风夷为平地。

slab.en: We need a crane to lift this slab.
slab.zh: 我们需要一台起重机来吊起这块板。

timely.en: His assumption of secretarial duties was timely.
timely.zh: 他担任秘书职务是及时的。
德米特里及时交付了货物。

disgust.zh: 难闻的气味让我们感到恶心。

prose.en: The report's stodgy prose discouraged readers.
prose.zh: 这份报告枯燥的文字使读者失去了兴趣。

prose.en: His florid prose obscured the central argument.
prose.zh: 他华丽的文字掩盖了核心论点。

prose.en: Her limpid prose clarified the abstruse subject.
prose.zh: 她清晰的文字阐明了深奥的话题。

rancher.zh: 牧场主清除了草场里的疯草。
萨米是一位富有的牧场主。

niece.gloss: A daughter of one’s sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either the daughter of one's brother ("fraternal niece"), or of one's sister ("sororal niece").
niece.zh: 我的侄女刚刚庆祝了她的 15 岁生日。

rainy.en: Harvest is usually very damp and rainy.
rainy.zh: 收获时通常非常潮湿多雨。

rainy.zh: 下雨天和星期一总是让我情绪低落。

layout.zh: 建筑师展示了建筑物的楼层布局。

respiratory.zh: 婴儿的呼吸系统仍在发育。

hamburger.en: A pickle goes well with a hamburger.

accidental.gloss: Happening by chance, or unexpectedly; taking place not according to the usual course of things; by accident, unintentional.

accidental.zh: 我的保单涵盖意外损失吗？

accidental.en: He was killed by an accidental gunshot.
accidental.gloss: Happening by chance, or unexpectedly; taking place not according to the usual course of things; by accident, unintentional.

lever.en: He released his grasp on the lever.

lever.zh: 按下控制杆即可启动机器。

lever.en: Depress the upper lever to start the machine.
lever.zh: 按下上部控制杆即可启动机器。

upright.gloss: On one's feet (as opposed to in a wheelchair).
upright.zh: 截肢曲棍球是直立打的。

upright.en: The soldiers stood bolt upright for inspection.
upright.zh: 士兵们笔直地站着接受检查。

upright.en: The shores stayed upright during the earthquake.
upright.zh: 地震期间海岸保持直立。

upright.en: I was standing upright, waiting for my orders.
upright.gloss: In or into an upright position.
upright.zh: 我站直了身子，等待着我的命令。

abolish.en: Slavery was abolished in the nineteenth century.
abolish.gloss: To end a law, system, institution, custom or practice.
abolish.zh: 奴隶制于十九世纪被废除。

persistence.en: Persistence is the key to solving this problem.
persistence.zh: 坚持是解决这个问题的关键。

liberate.en: He liberated the people from bondage.
liberate.zh: 他把人民从束缚中解放出来。

yacht.zh: 那是一艘深龙骨的游艇。

yacht.en: Our yacht club has ten members.
yacht.zh: 我们的游艇俱乐部有十名会员。

feminism.zh: 这位女权主义学者讨论了女权主义和个人主义。
女权主义是令人厌恶的。

fort.en: I was stationed at Fort Richie.
Does this road go to Fort Smith?
fort.zh: 这条路通往史密斯堡吗？

autonomous.zh: 这个机器人是完全自主的。

liner.en: I threw out the trash can liner.
liner.zh: 我把垃圾桶内衬扔掉了。

liner.en: The liner glanced off the pitcher's foot.
liner.zh: 衬垫从投手的脚上擦过。

liner.en: Jones showed good leather to snare that liner.
liner.zh: 琼斯展示了良好的皮革来捕捉该衬垫。

librarian.zh: 图书管理员看上去病得很重。
鲍里斯是一名图书管理员。

inferior.gloss: Lower in rank, status, or quality.; Of low rank, standard or quality.

inferior.en: He feels inferior to his peers.
inferior.zh: 他感觉自己不如同龄人。

morale.en: What will be the effect on morale?
morale.zh: 对士气会产生什么影响？

morale.en: The mission's successful execution lifted the troops' morale.
morale.zh: 任务的成功执行极大地鼓舞了部队的士气。

morale.en: My morale is being corroded day by day.
morale.zh: 我的士气一天天被侵蚀。

diversion.zh: 我们需要转移注意力来吸引他们。

distortion.en: This recording sounds awful due to the distortion.
distortion.gloss: Noise or other artifacts caused in the electronic reproduction of sound or music.
distortion.zh: 由于失真，这段录音听起来很糟糕。

distortion.en: That is a distortion of justice.
Lukas saw a distortion in space.
distortion.zh: 卢卡斯看到了空间的扭曲。

announcer.en: The announcer is wearing a new piece.

subsidiary.zh: 这家子公司负责管理农业径流。

subsidiary.en: The conglomerate acquired a smaller subsidiary.
subsidiary.zh: 这家企业集团收购了一家较小的子公司。

subsidiary.en: The company is our wholly-owned subsidiary.
subsidiary.zh: 该公司是我们的全资子公司。

prophet.zh: 穆罕默德也是一位先知。

pragmatic.zh: 这是一种非常务实的文化。

higher.zh: 价格高得令人难以承受。

higher.en: Higher taxes affected the household pocketbook.
higher.zh: 更高的税款影响了家庭开支。

orphan.zh: 玛丽亚收养了一个孤儿。

graze.en: The sheep grazed on the windswept upland.
graze.zh: 羊在风吹拂的高地上吃草。

graze.en: Untamed horses grazed on the windswept plain.
graze.zh: 野马在风吹的平原上吃草。

graze.en: Locoweed can be harmful to grazing livestock.
graze.zh: 疯草可能危害放牧牲畜。

graze.gloss: To feed on; to eat (growing herbage); to eat grass from (a pasture)

reel.gloss: To back off, step away, or sway backwards unsteadily and suddenly.
reel.zh: 他被这一拳打得后退了一步。

reel.zh: 卷轴自动收紧松弛部分。

alleviate.en: This medicine will alleviate the pain.

alleviate.zh: 这应该有助于减轻疼痛。

protagonist.en: The true protagonist wasn't shot by anybody.
protagonist.zh: 真正的主角没有被任何人枪杀。

systematically.en: Environmentally damaging projects should be abandoned systematically.
systematically.zh: 破坏环境的项目应该被系统地放弃。

systematically.en: The Nazis systematically murdered 11 million people.
systematically.zh: 纳粹有计划地杀害了 1100 万人。

systematically.en: Systematically criminalizing opinions is incompatible with democracy.
systematically.zh: 系统地将意见定为犯罪与民主不相容。

mock.en: The impious character mocked the sacred rite.
mock.zh: 这个不敬神的角色嘲弄了神圣仪式。

escalate.gloss: To increase (something) in extent or intensity; to intensify or step up.
escalate.zh: 枪击事件加剧了现有的敌对情绪。

escalate.gloss: To increase (something) in extent or intensity; to intensify or step up.
escalate.zh: 一场小战斗升级为一场大战斗。

discretion.gloss: The freedom to make one's own judgements.
discretion.zh: 我将其留给您自行决定。

arbitrary.zh: 规范化的流程减少了随意决策。

arbitrary.en: We can't tolerate such an arbitrary act.
arbitrary.zh: 我们不能容忍这种任意的行为。

scrub.zh: 我们从团队中清除了表现不佳的人。

scrub.zh: 面试前一定要擦洗干净。

rubble.zh: 一排排房屋躺在废墟下。

rubble.zh: 拆除队将建筑物夷为废墟。

bathe.zh: 即将到来的潮水沐浴着珊瑚礁。

bathe.gloss: The act of swimming or bathing, especially in the sea, a lake, or a river; a swimming bath.

polished.zh: 不要把抛光地板蹭出划痕。

polished.en: The jeweler polished the aquamarine carefully.
polished.zh: 珠宝匠仔细打磨了这颗海蓝宝石。

polished.en: The musician polished his brass cornet.
polished.zh: 音乐家擦亮了他的黄铜短号。

polished.en: In a freshly ironed dress and polished shoes.
polished.gloss: perfected or made shiny and smooth

resemblance.en: You have a remote resemblance to my grandmother.
resemblance.zh: 你和我的祖母有一点点相似。
我没有看到任何相似之处。

avert.en: How can the danger be averted?
avert.gloss: To ward off, or prevent, the occurrence or effects of.

avert.zh: 这种危险是可以避免的。

cavity.en: The surgeon examined the cranial cavity.

cavity.gloss: A cavity is a hole in a decayed tooth.

cavity.zh: 史密斯医生用银汞合金填充了吉姆的空腔。

conjunction.zh: 关系代词表现为“连词+代词”。

conjunction.en: Did you see the Great Conjunction tonight?
conjunction.zh: 今晚你看到大合流了吗？

outdoors.en: Walking outdoors is a healthful habit.
outdoors.zh: 户外步行是一种有益健康的习惯。

outdoors.en: I prefer the indoors to the outdoors.
outdoors.zh: 比起室外，我更喜欢室内。

outdoors.en: They went outdoors to light up their cigarettes.
outdoors.gloss: Not inside a house or under covered structure; unprotected; in the open air.

troubling.zh: 令人不安的差异引发了调查。

troubling.en: My bad knee is troubling me.
troubling.zh: 我的膝盖不好让我很烦恼。

troubling.en: The opacity of these decisions is troubling.
troubling.zh: 这些决定的不透明性令人不安。

crave.en: A baby craves its mother's milk.

novice.en: Don't blame him, he's a novice.

compliment.en: An underhanded compliment is actually criticism.
compliment.zh: 不怀好意的赞美实际上是批评。

progression.zh: 该研究追踪了疾病进展。

progression.en: For quotations using this term, see Citations:'50s progression.
progression.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文：50 年代进展。

progression.en: For quotations using this term, see Citations:50's progression.
progression.zh: 有关使用该术语的引文，请参阅引文数：50 的进展。

pedestrian.gloss: Pertaining to ordinary, everyday movements incorporated in postmodern dance.
pedestrian.zh: 编舞者更喜欢行人的动作。

pedestrian.en: His manner of dress was pedestrian but tidy.
pedestrian.zh: 他的着装平淡无奇，但很整洁。

pedestrian.en: The side of the car contacted the pedestrian.
pedestrian.zh: 汽车的侧面接触到了行人。

residue.en: Gunshot residue was found on Dan's hands.
residue.zh: 丹的手上发现了枪弹残留物。

residue.en: Check the ovenware for any stuck-on residue.
residue.zh: 检查烤箱器皿是否有残留物。

residue.zh: 他们在受害者的手上发现了枪弹残留物。

shorten.en: You have to shorten this movie up.

hiring.en: The decision will doubtless affect future hiring.
hiring.zh: 这一决定无疑会影响未来的招聘。

hiring.en: Hiring practice is very bad in this company.
hiring.zh: 这家公司的招聘做法非常糟糕。

hiring.en: The antidiscrimination laws prohibit hiring based on race.
hiring.zh: 反歧视法禁止基于种族的招聘。

runoff.zh: 这家子公司负责管理农业径流。

runoff.en: Heavy runoff carried the topsoil away.
runoff.zh: 强劲的径流带走了表土。

runoff.en: Heavy runoff carried sediment into the lake.
runoff.zh: 大量径流把沉积物带入湖中。

runoff.en: The runoff of nitrates is poisoning the lake.
runoff.gloss: Dissolved chemicals, etc, included in such water.
runoff.zh: 硝酸盐径流正在毒害湖泊。

这条规则并不总是适用。

accustom.en: I got accustomed to living alone.
accustom.zh: 我已经习惯了一个人的生活。

accustom.en: Bob is accustomed to hard work.

deteriorate.zh: 肖邦的健康状况持续恶化。

collide.en: China collided with the modern world.
collide.gloss: To come into conflict, or be incompatible.
collide.zh: 中国与现代世界发生碰撞。

reap.zh: 我们种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

feasible.en: What you're suggesting doesn't seem feasible.

mastery.en: He seeks mastery in every skill.

mastery.zh: 使用示例可以加速语言的掌握。

arrogant.zh: 他的傲慢行为让我感到恶心。

arrogant.en: Her arrogant attitude alienated the team.
arrogant.gloss: Having excessive pride in oneself, often with contempt or disrespect for others.
arrogant.zh: 她傲慢的态度使团队疏远了。

arrogant.en: He was too arrogant to admit his mistake.
arrogant.gloss: Having excessive pride in oneself, often with contempt or disrespect for others.
arrogant.zh: 他太傲慢了，不愿承认自己的错误。

oneself.en: Teaching oneself to swim can be dangerous.
oneself.gloss: A person's self: general form of himself, herself, themselves or yourself.

oneself.en: To know oneself is not easy.

dubious.en: Processed foods are of dubious nutritional value.
dubious.zh: 加工食品的营养价值值得怀疑。

dubious.en: We screened out the dubious candidates yesterday.
dubious.zh: 昨天我们筛选出了可疑的候选人。

dubious.en: They were renowned as people of dubious morals.
dubious.gloss: Arousing doubt; questionable; open to suspicion.
dubious.zh: 他们因道德可疑而闻名。

facade.en: This facade has eight south-facing lights.
facade.zh: 该立面有八盏朝南的灯。

facade.en: His friendship was only a facade.
facade.zh: 他的友谊只是表面现象。

facade.en: This house has a new facade.
facade.zh: 这所房子有一个新的外观。

vigour.zh: 经常锻炼使他恢复了活力。

vigour.en: She attacked the task with renewed vigour.
vigour.zh: 她以重新振作的干劲投入工作。

vigour.gloss: Strength or force in animal or vegetable nature or action.

bypass.en: The rush-hour traffic crawled around the bypass.
bypass.zh: 高峰时段的交通在绕行道上缓慢行驶。

bypass.en: He will need a heart bypass to survive.

pastime.gloss: Something which amuses, and serves to make time pass agreeably.
pastime.zh: 聊天是一种愉快的消遣。

pastime.zh: 杂耍是一种有趣的消遣，但通常没什么成效。
